fdroid:com.defang.launcher.name: Defang
fdroid:com.defang.launcher.summary: Launcher that puts speed bumps between you and the apps engineered against you
fdroid:com.defang.launcher.description:
Defang is an Android launcher with an anti-dark-pattern friction layer. It is a speed bump, not a wall: you can still open Instagram, you can still override the timer. Nothing here is impossible to bypass — that is deliberate. A wall breeds circumvention; a speed bump breeds pause.
What it does:
• Intent gate — tapping a watched app shows a full-screen pause with a countdown before "Open anyway" activates. Declare what you came for, or go back.
• Session timer — a small overlay counts down your own preset limit. At zero, the end card appears. Extending costs friction: a 30-second wait, a written reason, and it works once per day. No "15 more minutes" button to tap into oblivion.
• Cool-down — after a session ends, reopening is locked for a period you chose in advance.
• Per-app grayscale — watched apps render colorless while your camera, maps, and photos keep their colors.
• Notification batching — pings from watched apps arrive as a muted summary at times you pick, not when an engagement model predicts you're vulnerable. Real contacts always come through.
• Awareness tidbits — short, specific, sourced facts about the machinery: variable reward schedules, notification timing optimization, what the algorithm selects for. They did this to you; the least you can do is know how.
• Offline prompts — when a session ends, a small physical suggestion. "Tidy the coffee table" is not a joke; it's a completable task with honest dopamine.
• Usage report — weekly time per app, per day, and how often "just checking a DM" became a 20-minute scroll. Evidence, not guilt.
Utility apps — camera, calculator, phone, maps — open instantly, always. The launcher never gets in the way of your life; it gets in the way of the loop.
No telemetry. All data stays on the device. English and Norwegian.
Requires the accessibility service (foreground app detection), notification access (batching), and display-over-apps permission (overlays). Per-app grayscale needs a one-time adb grant of WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS — the app works without it, minus that feature.

fdroid:com.github.dyhkwong.sagernet.name: Exclave
fdroid:com.github.dyhkwong.sagernet.description:
Exclave is a proxy client.
Features:
- Various proxy protocols
- Group and subscription
- Routing
- Proxy chain
Some supported protocols:
- Shadowsocks (with SIP003 plugin support)
- Shadowsocks 2022 (with SIP003 plugin support)
- Trojan
- Hysteria 2
- AnyTLS
- mieru
- NaïveProxy (as a standalone plugin)
- TUIC
- Juicity
- VMess (with various optional sub-protocols)
- VLESS (with various optional sub-protocols)
- WireGuard (TCP and UDP only)
- MASQUE (a.k.a. CONNECT-IP, TCP and UDP only)
- TrustTunnel (no ICMP echo support)
- Snell v4 and Snell v6
- ShadowQUIC
- SSH proxy ("dynamic port forwarding")
- HTTP CONNECT tunnel (HTTP/1.1, HTTP/1.1 with TLS, HTTP/2 and HTTP/3, with CONNECT-UDP support)
- SOCKS4, SOCKS4A and SOCKS5
Although it can take charge of the traffic through the VPN service provided by the system, it is a TCP and UDP proxy used as a "pseudo-VPN" rather than a VPN.

fdroid:com.noty.app.name: Noty - Notes in Notification
fdroid:com.noty.app.summary: Pin your notes to notifications — always visible, never forgotten.
fdroid:com.noty.app.description:
Never forget a task again. Noty keeps your notes exactly where you look dozens of times a day — your notification shade.
Write a note, and it instantly appears as a persistent notification in your status bar. It stays there until you're done with it. No need to open any app, set a reminder, or remember to check a list.
KEY FEATURES
📌 Persistent Notifications
Every note you create appears as a notification that stays in your status bar. Your notes are always one swipe away.
🔄 Survives Everything
Notes are restored automatically after a phone restart. The app runs a lightweight background service to keep your notifications alive even after you close the app.
✏️ Add, Edit, Delete — Instantly
Create notes with a title and optional description. Edit or delete any note with a tap. A confirmation step prevents accidental deletions.
📌 Pin or Unpin Anytime
Choose which notes appear as notifications. Pin a note and it shows up in your status bar, locked in place until you remove it. Unpin it and it quietly moves back to the app — no notification, no clutter. Switch between pinned and unpinned at any time, directly from the notification or from the app.
⚡ Quick Settings Tile
Add a "Quick Note" tile to your Quick Settings panel. Tap it to jump straight to the add-note screen, without hunting for the app.
🎨 Material You Design
Noty uses Material 3 with dynamic color — on Android 12 and above, the app automatically matches your wallpaper's color palette. Light, Dark, and System themes are all supported and persist across sessions.
⚙️ Make It Yours
Open Settings to switch themes, toggle wallpaper-based dynamic color on Android 12 and above, pick Noty's language separately from your phone's on Android 13 and above, and choose whether new notes start out pinned. Your choices are remembered between launches.
🔍 Search Your Notes
Quickly filter your notes by title or description with the built-in search bar.
⏰ Reminders
Set a one-time reminder on any note with a date and time picker. Noty fires a notification right on time using exact alarms, so you never miss it.
💾 Back Up and Restore
Export all your notes to a file, then import them on a new phone or after reinstalling. Importing merges with the notes you already have: nothing is overwritten unless the backup holds a newer edit.
🔒 100% Private
Noty is entirely local. No accounts, no cloud, no network access. Your notes never leave your device unless you export them yourself.
PERMISSIONS EXPLAINED
• Notifications — required to show your notes as persistent notifications
• Run at Startup — used to restore your notes and reschedule reminders after your phone restarts
• Foreground Service — allows Noty to keep notifications active in the background
• Exact Alarms — used to deliver note reminders at the exact time you set
No ads. No in-app purchases. No data collection.

fdroid:com.owen282000.lifedashboard.name: Life Dashboard Companion
fdroid:com.owen282000.lifedashboard.summary: Health Connect and screen time to Home Assistant, MQTT or webhooks. No account.
fdroid:com.owen282000.lifedashboard.description:
Send Health Connect and screen time from your Android phone to Home Assistant, MQTT or your own server. No account, and the developer receives none of your data. No analytics or tracking SDKs.
Pair by scanning one QR code, and get 34 Health Connect types and all your history.
Works with any app that writes to Health Connect, such as Samsung Health, Google Health (Fitbit and Pixel Watch), Garmin Connect, Oura, Withings and Gadgetbridge.
Your data goes only to the addresses you enter. The app contacts no other server.
Home Assistant:
- The Life Dashboard integration, installed through the Marketplace or HACS. Scan the QR code it shows and you're paired, with no broker and no YAML. Every synced day lands in Home Assistant's long-term statistics on its own date, so a backfill fills in about the last year.
- Receive, with the integration: a scale or blood pressure monitor connected to Home Assistant sends its readings to the app, which writes them into Health Connect (weight, height, body composition, blood pressure). You switch it on per type.
- MQTT Discovery, for a setup that already runs a broker: 25 of the 34 types plus screen time as sensors under one device, with optional TLS and login.
Health Connect:
- 34 types: steps, sleep with stages, heart rate, HRV, speed, blood pressure, blood glucose, VO2 max, skin temperature, cycle tracking and more.
- Every record carries its source app and a stable ID, so a duplicate is easy to drop. Daily totals come from Health Connect itself, so a walk recorded by both phone and watch counts once.
- Edits and deletions are sent too, not only new records. When a change can't be sent, the payload says so.
- Optional data resolution: send dense series such as heart rate as one summary per 1, 5, 15 or 60 minutes.
- Backfill of all your history runs in the background and picks up where it left off.
Screen time:
- Time per app, next to your health data, with a day boundary you choose.
- Send every app, all but some, or only the ones you pick. An app left out never leaves the phone, though the day's total still counts its time.
Webhooks:
- Your own webhook gets every record in full, including single meals, cycle tracking entries and workout details, which are events rather than sensor values.
- Several URLs, each with its own headers and optional HMAC-SHA256 signing secret, and client certificates (mTLS) for a server behind a reverse proxy.
- Automatic retries, plus an outbox that keeps undelivered syncs until your server is back.
Automation:
- Syncs every 15 minutes or more, or at fixed times, on the days you pick, with quiet hours.
- Widget (Sync Status), Quick Settings tile (Sync Life Dashboard) and an intent for Tasker and MacroDroid.
- A notification when syncs fail several times in a row.
See what happened:
- Logs of the last 100 deliveries, with filters.
- A preview of the payload before it goes out, a test per address, and an export as CSV or JSON.
Also: settings backup and restore (encrypted when secrets are included), in eleven languages.
GitHub releases are built by public CI and carry verifiable build provenance, and the build is reproducible, so F-Droid ships the same signed APK.
Optionally, the separate self-hosted Life Dashboard Stack stores your data in Postgres with Grafana dashboards, and its read-only MCP server lets an AI model that you run yourself read your history. The app itself contains no AI.
Health data needs Android 9 or newer with Health Connect (built into Android 14 and later, an app from Google Play on Android 9 to 13). Screen time works on Android 8.0 and newer.

fdroid:de.tu_darmstadt.seemoo.nfcgate.name: NFCGate
fdroid:de.tu_darmstadt.seemoo.nfcgate.developer: Secure Mobile Networking Lab, TU Darmstadt
fdroid:de.tu_darmstadt.seemoo.nfcgate.summary: An NFC research toolkit application for Android
fdroid:de.tu_darmstadt.seemoo.nfcgate.description:
NFCGate is an Android application meant to capture, analyze, or modify NFC traffic. It can be used as a researching tool to reverse engineer protocols or assess the security of protocols against traffic modifications.
 On-device capture : Captures NFC traffic sent and received by other applications running on the
device.
 Relay : Relays NFC traffic between two devices
using a server . One device operates as a "reader" reading an
NFC tag, the other device emulates an NFC tag using the Host Card Emulation (HCE).
 Replay : Replays previously captured NFC traffic in either "reader" or "tag" mode.
 Clone : Clones the initial tag information (e.g. ID).
 pcapng export of captured NFC traffic, readable by Wireshark.

fdroid:io.github.originalrecipe1.unfurli.description:
Unfurlit extracts media from supported social-media links locally and opens it in a

Images support zoom and pan, galleries support swiping, and videos support
portrait-aware sizing and immersive fullscreen playback. Videos can continue in
a picture-in-picture window, and videos and audio keep playing in the background
with notification and lock-screen controls.
Supported links and media:
- YouTube: videos and Shorts.
- Vimeo: videos, including unlisted links with an access hash.
- Instagram: videos, Reels, photos and carousels (no photo-post soundtracks).
- TikTok: videos and photo posts, including available photo soundtracks.
- Reddit: posts are currently blocked for signed-out apps; direct i.redd.it image links still open.
- X/Twitter: videos, photos and galleries.
- PeerTube: videos.
- Bandcamp: audio tracks.
- Tumblr: native videos, photos and mixed photo/video posts.
- Pixiv: public illustrations and multi-page artwork (no Ugoira animations).
- Imgur, Bluesky, Flickr and many other sites: photos and galleries.
Other sites may work too; audio and galleries depend on the source. Availability
varies by post, region and platform changes. Private, login-gated or restricted
posts may not open; signing in is not available.
Unfurlit has no ads, analytics, mandatory account, or project-operated backend. The
device still contacts the original platform and its media hosts, so viewing is
not anonymous. Some private, age-restricted, regional, or login-gated media may
require cookies and is not supported.

fdroid:se.bitcraze.crazyfliecontrol2.name: Crazyflie Client
fdroid:se.bitcraze.crazyfliecontrol2.summary: Control your Crazyflie quadcopter from your mobile device
fdroid:se.bitcraze.crazyfliecontrol2.description:
Connect to Crazyflie 2.x using Bluetooth low energy and both the original
Crazyflie and Crazyflie 2.x using the USB Crazyradio dongle connected with
a USB OTG cable.
Features:
* Control Crazyflie and Crazyflie 2.x using Crazyradio on a USB OTG compatible device
* Control Crazyflie 2.x using Bluetooth LE 4.0
* Control mode configurable
* Control sensitivity configurable
* Axis and button mapping configurable (only for game pad)
* Control Crazyflie using touch controls
* Control Crazyflie using game pad (connected via USB or Bluetooth)
* Control Crazyflie using the device's gyroscope
* Control LED ring effects (requires Crazyflie 2.x and optional LED ring deck)
* Play the Imperial March melody on the buzzer deck (requires Crazyflie 2.x and optional buzzer deck)
* Update Crazyflie using Crazyradio (experimental feature, update via BLE coming soon)
Please note:
This app is designed to control Crazyflie and Crazyflie 2.x. It requires
either a Crazyradio, Crazyradio PA or a Bluetooth LE 4.0 compatible
device running Android 4.4+. Only Crazyflie 2.x can be controlled with
Bluetooth LE. Do not pair the Crazyflie via Bluetooth settings!
Distributors for Crazyflie and Crazyradio can be found on our distributor
list: https://www.bitcraze.io/buy/local-retailers/ 
This app is using JoystickView Widget from mobile-anarchy-widgets
( https://code.google.com/p/mobile-anarchy-widgets/wiki/JoystickView ).
Contributions are welcome!
How to use the bootloader:
 The list of firmwares should automatically be filled (make sure you have a network connection!)
 Select a firmware (make sure you select the right one depending on which Crazyflie you want to update (CF1 or CF2))
 Flash firmware (For Crazyflie 1, click on "Flash firmware" and switch on the Crazyflie during the next 10 seconds. For Crazyflie 2, press the ON/OFF switch of the Crazyflie longer than 1.5 second until one blue LED blinks. Then release the button and both blue LEDs should blink. Then click on "Flash firmware")
 After a successful flash the Crazyflie will automatically restart in firmware mode and is ready to use.
It's nearly impossible to brick the Crazyflie. In case of any problems during flashing, you can always try again or use the PC client to re-flash.
Permissions:
* Photo/Media/Files: This is required to save the firmware files on the device.
* Bluetooth connection information: This is required for connecting to Crazyflie 2.x over Bluetooth.
* Location: This is required for Bluetooth LE scanning since Android 6.0.

apple-macos:443296130.name: Wx
apple-macos:443296130.description:
The venerable U.S. weather app Wx, named a Mac Gem by Macworld magazine, has been reinvented! Wx displays current conditions, forecasts, warnings, and radar for U.S. locations using high fidelity XML data from the U.S. National Weather Service. The app is designed for two specific types of customers: serious weather watchers who want detailed information and facts with no fuss, and casual users who want a fast, clean, and functional weather app.
Wx lets you set up locations on an embedded map, guiding you to choose nearby NWS observation sites (over 1700 available in the U.S. and its territories), nearby NEXRAD radar sites, and nearby city- and county-based alert zones. The app sets up a 7-day summary "point" forecast customized for the specific latitude and longitude of the location, and a 7-day “pro” forecast that graphs temperature (actual and apparent), dew point, relative humidity, cloud cover, wind speed, wind direction, gust speed, 12-hour probability of precipitation, 6-hour liquid precipitation amount, and 6-hour snow amount. Wx’s pro forecast is also latitude/longitude based, and is about as good as it gets if you need to plan work, sports, and outdoor activities based on upcoming weather. With their high spatial resolution, the point and pro forecasts are especially useful in coastal and mountainous regions where typical zone forecasts can be inaccurate. These forecasts are backed up by a regional text forecast bulletin for additional information.
Wx also lets you bookmark and setup weather maps for quick reference. Choose from over 40 default NWS maps and images, or provide the URL for any map of your choice and load it right in the app! If you have preferred weather providers or use a private weather service, you can load your favorite maps and images right in Wx and keep them handy. Other features of Wx include a display of weather conditions in the dock icon, seven day sun and moon phase information, and a high performance radar display with five types of radar on a zoomable live map. 
Wx is crafted with attention to detail by an award-winning professional software developer with 34 years of experience, 22 years focused on developing software for Macs and 17 years writing apps for iOS devices. Wx has been reinvented from the ground up. Under the hood, Wx has all new download and processing engines, and is faster than ever. It's more reliable than ever too, offering multiple levels of redundancy to handle severe weather events that can strain NWS servers.
Wx is also available for iPhone and iPad. For more info, see hrtapps.com or look in the iOS App Store.
For tech support, bug reports, feedback, and feature requests, contact the developer by e-mail. Use the "contact" link in Wx's help menu, or use the "support" link listed above right. Your direct feedback is encouraged, as it helps steer future development of Wx.

apple-macos:1057051963.name: Music Transfer for iTunes
apple-macos:1057051963.description:
Music Transfer for iTunes exports songs from iTunes / Music app to external devices like USB sticks, SD cards, NAS, and local or networked folders. You can transfer the whole Music Library, separate Playlists, or selected songs. Export of DRM-protected audio, available via Apple Music subscription and similar streaming services, is not supported.
PERFECT IN-CAR PLAYBACK
For comfortable in-car listening, you can automatically equalize loudness; cut silence; fade songs in/out for smoother transitions; make file names easy to read on the car screen; and organize folders by Genres, Artists, etc.
EQUALIZE MUSIC LOUDNESS
Enable Loudness normalization in Settings / Effects to level the volume of songs across exported Music Library or Playlist. Loudness normalization enhances music that is too quiet and softens loud songs. It ensures a pleasant listening experience in the car, on the streets, or in a noisy environment.
SMOOTH THE PLAYBACK
Enable 'Trim silence from start and end ...' in Settings / Effects to minimize gaps between songs during playback. Try 'Fade in' and 'Fade out' audio effects for a smoother transition between tracks.
BOOST VOICE RECORDS
Activate 'Peak normalization' along with 'Automatic Volume Control' in Settings / Effects to make podcasts, lessons, audiobooks, and other speech records sound clear and more balanced.
FILL UP SONG DETAILS
Music Transfer for iTunes can automatically search and download missing Artwork and song details, such as Genre, Artist, Album, Title, etc. 
Enable 'Load missing tags and artworks from network' in Settings / Tags if you have empty artworks or unknown song details in Music Library. 
CREATE M3U PLAYLISTS
The application creates M3U playlists out of transferred files by default. You can manage playlist creation and merging, and change the automatic playlist setting to a custom format, name, and sort order in Settings / General / Destination Files.
MAKE FILE NAMES READABLE
Set custom filename format in Settings / General / Destination Files. Apple Music app can name files using the 'Track # Title' pattern. While exporting with Music Transfer for iTunes, you can keep original filenames or auto-rename using a custom metadata pattern, for example, 'Artist - Title.'
ORGANIZE FOLDERS BY YOUR NEEDS
Music Transfer for iTunes creates a folder for an exported playlist by default. Music Transfer for iTunes replicates the directory structure if you add a folder directory from Finder for conversion to MP3 or M4A formats. 
However, if you want to sort songs in folders by Genres, Artists, Albums, BPMs, and such, enable and set 'Organize destination folders' in Settings / General / Destination Files.
AUTOMATIC MP3 and AAC SETTINGS
Music Transfer for iTunes can analyze Bit Rate and Channels of input files to apply optimal settings to output MP3 or M4A formats. As a result, it guarantees the best possible sound quality and saves your time and hard drive space.
If you want to convert to a specific Bit Rate, Channels, etc., select the required settings in Settings / Format. You can also choose AAC LC, AAC-HE v1, AAC-HE v2, or ALAC (Apple Lossless Audio Codec) from the MP4 codecs list.
CUSTOMERS SUPPORT
Please email support@amvidia.com about any problems or feature requests. If you like Music Transfer for iTunes, a review at the App Store would be very appreciated.
Terms of Use for "Music Transfer for iTunes" are available at https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/.
*Note: DRM-protected audio files (M4P-protected AAC audio files) downloaded with Apple Music, Spotify, or similar subscription services cannot be exported.

SHARE SHIFTS AND SCHEDULES

ENCRYPTED. EVERYTHING. ALWAYS.
Every profile, group, calendar, event, message, and file — end-to-end encrypted by default. ANSSI-certified. Not a feature. A foundation. Your data stays yours. No ads. No tracking. Ever.

WHAT PEOPLE ARE SAYING
"We haven't had a single fight about scheduling since." — Katelyn
"Kept our family safe and connected without sacrificing our privacy." — Cal

"OurCal has changed my life entirely." — Parker, dance team
"We were on the verge of breaking up. Now, we're incredibly happy." — Goe

apple-macos:6804044349.name: Neverlag: IPTV Player Live TV
apple-macos:6804044349.description:
Neverlag is the IPTV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that doesn’t reload when your stream hiccups. Live TV, TV guide (EPG) and catch-up with your own provider – via Xtream Codes or an M3U playlist.
If your provider drops out for a moment, Neverlag keeps playing from its reserve. If a channel delivers no picture, Neverlag switches the source instead of freezing.
PLAYS ON WHILE OTHERS RELOAD
Neverlag builds a reserve of the programme you’re watching – up to 45 seconds by default, adjustable up to 90 seconds. When your provider stalls, playback continues from that reserve while Neverlag reconnects in the background and picks up where the picture left off. The quality panel shows reserve, delay behind live, bitrate and picture.
SWITCHES THE SOURCE INSTEAD OF FREEZING
If the picture freezes or a channel fails at the provider, Neverlag takes another source of the same channel or the same channel from another of your lists. One line tells you what happened, one button takes you back. If 4K keeps stalling, Neverlag drops to Full HD and tells you.
YOUR IPHONE AS THE REMOTE
With Neverlag on iPhone or iPad you control Neverlag on Apple TV: a D-pad like the Siri Remote or a touch area, your channels as tiles, pause/live and 30 seconds back. From iOS 18 also from Control Center, without opening the app. Several Apple TVs at home: pair, name, switch.
PROFILES FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Every profile has its own favorites and history. The admin profile protects settings with a PIN; the kids profile shows only approved groups.
TV GUIDE, ARCHIVE AND CATCH-UP
A TV guide grid from your provider’s EPG data (XMLTV). Missed shows in the archive, by show or by channel, when your provider offers catch-up. Neverlag tags programmes like football, news or kids automatically. Pause, rewind and record live TV – stored locally on Mac, iPhone and iPad, on your network storage on Apple TV.
BIG LISTS UNDER CONTROL
Groups, favorites, search and a jump bar that gets you to the right letter even with more than 10,000 channels. Movies and series with resume, when your provider includes them. 4K playback; on Mac, Neverlag matches the display’s refresh rate to the programme in full screen.
NEW DESIGN
A calm, dark interface on every device. Settings in clear sections, with search and an explanation for every option.
SET UP APPLE TV WITHOUT TYPING
No server addresses typed with the remote: Apple TV shows a code, your iPhone or Mac sends the login over your home network.
PRIVACY
No account, no tracking, no analytics, no ads. Neverlag has no server of its own: your login stays in your device’s keychain, measurements stay on the device.
TRIAL AND SUBSCRIPTION
Free download and a free 7-day trial. After that, keep watching with a subscription, monthly or yearly, cancel anytime. One subscription covers iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV, with Family Sharing. Setup, channel list and TV guide stay free without a subscription.
Support: https://neverlag.app/support
Neverlag is a player. You need your own M3U playlist or credentials from an IPTV provider. Neverlag does not contain, deliver or broker any content.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PATTERN LIBRARY
Save and organize unlimited patterns — rename, duplicate, or delete anytime.
BEAD PALETTES
• MARD — 213 colors
• Artkal M — 220 colors (same codes as MARD)

SHOPPING LIST

PALETTE CONVERSION
Switch between bead brands and see exactly how well each color matches — exact, close, or approximate — before you commit. Export the conversion table as CSV.
DITHERING
Floyd-Steinberg, Atkinson, Burkes, or Stucki error diffusion, plus 4×4 or 8×8 Bayer ordered dithering — smooth gradients and clean, buildable transitions.
GRID & ZOOM
• Pinch to zoom, pan freely

• Tap any cell to see the exact bead code and color name
• Multi-board support for bigger designs, with board navigation and seam guides
• New board size presets: 30×30, 40×40, 48×48, and 57×57 (2.6mm mini beads), alongside 29×29 and 50×50
BUILD MODE
• Step through your pattern row by row, with the current row highlighted
• Tap beads as you place them and track your progress at a glance
• Color legend showing how many of each bead you need
• Bead codes displayed inside each cell at high zoom
• Designed for physical bead crafts — counts, not just pixels
PATTERN EDITOR
Touch up your pattern after converting — paint, fill, replace colors, or erase, with full undo/redo.
EXPORT & PRINT
Print your chart to any AirPrint printer, export as PDF, or save a PNG for reference while you build.
BEADIFY PRO
Every feature above is free. Beadify Pro is an optional one-time purchase that adds tools for bigger projects:
• Board-by-board PDF — one printable page per pegboard, with bead codes in every cell and a bead list for each board, plus an overview page showing where each board goes
• No banner ad on iPhone and iPad
• New Pro features as they arrive, in the same purchase
No subscription. Bought Remove Ads or Beadify 1.7? You already have Pro.
Perfect for bead artists, pixel art fans, and anyone who loves hands-on crafts.

flathub:com.endlessnetwork.tankwarriors.name: Tank Warriors
flathub:com.endlessnetwork.tankwarriors.summary: Program an AI to beat the enemy
flathub:com.endlessnetwork.tankwarriors.description:
Driving, shooting, explosions, and programming—all in one game! Take charge of your own personal tank to battle your way through multilevel arenas, defeating the enemy and completing objectives. Upgrade your tanks to be faster, tougher, and more powerful than your opponents. Hack your tank’s AI to outsmart the enemy’s tank to become reigning champion! Build your tank fleet, with real code… can you outsmart your own AI?
 Level up your coding skills by learning and practicing functions, parameters, syntax, and more.
 Players must use commands and keywords to create AI programs for their tanks. Each command/keyword has different requirements and will need either a conditional, a parameter, or nothing. The keywords expect players to guess their purpose and experiment; for example, turnTank is a function that requires a parameter, so it must need a turn angle to be given as a parameter. During battles, players can edit their tank’s code and view enemy’s AI, and the tank’s current line of code shows on the bottom of the screen to keep track. Your tank starts with a green ring of health that becomes lower and redder as the tank gets hit by bullets; in player-controlled mode, be sure to collect heart balloons to heal when your ring is low and red. In AI mode, be sure to program your tank with commands that move it out of enemy range.

flathub:com.georgefb.quickaccess.name: QuickAccess
flathub:com.georgefb.quickaccess.summary: A global menu giving you quick access to folders and custom commands.
flathub:com.georgefb.quickaccess.description:
QuickAccess is a program running in the background providing a global menu to quickly access user defined folders and their subfolders as well as creating and running custom commands. The menu can be opened through two dbus methods: showMenu and showDelayedMenu. Both methods can open the menu in a predefined fixed position or on mouse position.
 showMenu shows the menu instantly, but in certain circumstances there are problems with the menu not showing or not closing. In these cases use the showDelayedMenu, there is a default delay of 150 miliseconds, but can be changed (see example below).
 Open menu with dbus-send
 dbus-send --type=method_call --dest=com.georgefb.quickaccess /QuickAccess com.georgefb.QuickAccess.showMenu int32:x
 dbus-send --type=method_call --dest=com.georgefb.quickaccess /QuickAccess com.georgefb.QuickAccess.showDelayedMenu int32:200 int32:x
 Replace x with an int from 0 to 9 to set the preffered position to open the menu.
 Check the project page for more info https://github.com/g-fb/quickaccess.

flathub:com.github.gpuvis.Gpuvis.name: gpuvis
flathub:com.github.gpuvis.Gpuvis.description:
Gpuvis is a Linux GPU profiler similar to GPUView on Windows. It is designed to work with trace-cmd
 captures and help track down Linux gpu and application performance issues.
 Gpuvis is open-source, so feel free to contribute new features!

flathub:com.github.ztefn.haguichi.description:
Haguichi makes it a breeze to join, create and administer Hamachi networks.

 Sidebar for easy access to details and actions

 Desktop notifications to stay up to date of network events

flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indipdf.name: indiPDF
flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indipdf.summary: A powerful PDF editor for Linux
flathub:com.indomitusgroup.indipdf.description:
indiPDF is a comprehensive PDF editing application designed specifically for Linux.
 It provides all the tools you need to view, annotate, edit, and manage PDF documents
 with a native GTK-styled interface that integrates seamlessly with your desktop.
 Features include:
 View and navigate multi-page PDF documents
 Edit text in existing PDF documents
 Highlight, underline, and strikethrough text
 Add text annotations and sticky notes
 Draw freehand with customizable colors and stroke widths
 Insert shapes: rectangles, circles, lines, and arrows
 Add images to your documents
 Create and manage digital signatures
 Fill out PDF forms, including Adobe XFA forms that other readers show as a blank placeholder
 Merge multiple PDFs into one
 Split PDFs and extract pages
 Rotate, reorder, and delete pages
 Export pages as images (PNG, JPEG, WebP)
 OCR (Optical Character Recognition) for scanned documents
 Scanner support via SANE for digitizing paper documents
 Add non-PDF files (images, Office documents) to your PDFs
 Automatic update checking
 Built-in text search across documents
 Dark mode support following system preferences
 indiPDF respects your privacy and works entirely offline. Your documents never
 leave your computer.

flathub:org.astermail.Mail.name: Aster Mail
flathub:org.astermail.Mail.description:
Aster Mail is end-to-end encrypted email. Your messages are encrypted on your device before
 they reach the server, so only you and the people you write to can read them. Mail between Aster
 accounts also uses post-quantum encryption.
 With Aster Mail, you can:
 Keep your real address private with aliases
 Send and receive mail at your own domain
 Exchange encrypted mail with PGP users at any provider
 Import your mail and contacts from another provider
 The free plan includes 10 GB of storage, 5 aliases, and one custom domain. You need an Aster
 account to use the app.

flathub:org.jaspstats.JASP.name: JASP
flathub:org.jaspstats.JASP.description:
JASP is a cross platform statistical software program with a state-of-the-art graphical user
 interface. It offers standard analysis procedures in both their classical and Bayesian form.
 It was designed with the user in mind: APA-formatted tables can be copy-pasted in your word
 processor, output can be extensively annotated, adjustment of input options dynamically changes
 the output, and selecting old output revives the associated input choices for inspection and adjustment.
 JASP is also statistically inclusive, as it offers both frequentist and Bayesian analysis methods.
 Indeed, the primary motivation for JASP is to make it easier for statistical practitioners to conduct
 Bayesian analyses.

flathub:org.kde.merkuro.name: Merkuro
flathub:org.kde.merkuro.summary: Manage your tasks, events and contacts with speed and ease
flathub:org.kde.merkuro.description:
Merkuro is a calendar and contact application that allows you to manage your tasks, events and
 contacts. Merkuro supports both local calendars as well as a multitude of online calendars: Nextcloud,
 Google® Calendar, Outlook®, Caldav, and many more.
 Merkuro was built with the idea to be usable on desktop, on mobile and everything in between.

flathub:org.kde.peruse.name: Peruse
flathub:org.kde.peruse.description:
There are many ways to read comic books, and one of those that has become more common in recent
 years is on a computer. Peruse was created as a way to make exactly that as easy and pleasant as
 possible, and to simply get out of the way and let you read your comic books. One could say that
 it allows you to peruse your comic books at your leisure, but that would be a silly way of putting
 it - so, peruse your comic books at your leisure!
 One of the ways in which Peruse ensures your reading experience is as pleasant and effortless
 as possible is to allow you to simply pick up where you last left off. The welcome page in the
 application (first screenshot below) shows you your most recently read comics, and shows your progress
 through them. To pick up where you left off, simply tap the top left item and you will be taken
 right to the page you were reading before you had to stop.
 Features:
 Comic Book Archive (cbz, cbr, cb7, cbt, cba)
 Portable Document Format (pdf)
 ePub Books (epub)
 DeVice Independent files (dvi)
 DeJaVu (djvu)
 Compiled Help (chm)

flathub:org.siril.Siril.name: Siril
flathub:org.siril.Siril.description:
Siril is an image processing tool specially tailored for noise reduction and improving the signal/noise
 ratio of an image from multiple captures, as required in astronomy.
 Siril can align automatically or manually, stack and enhance pictures from various file formats,
 even images sequences (movies and SER files).

flathub:page.codeberg.jaerrib.RNGremlin.name: RNGremlin
flathub:page.codeberg.jaerrib.RNGremlin.description:
RNGremlin is a dice rolling application with a pixel art aesthetic intended for use with solo
 TTRPGs but isn't necessarily limited to that use case. It was originally built using Godot 3.6
 in order to support older hardware for anyone making use of a repurposed laptop, etc. but has been
 converted to Godot 4 in preparation of being packaged for flatpak.
 Features
 Generate up to five results simultaneously
 Select various die types (d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, d20 or d100) or leave a particular position
 off
 Select from various light and dark themes
 Auto save/load so that you can resume your session exactly as you left off
 UI sound effects, which can be toggled on/off
 Visual roll history, which can be cleared at any point
 Keyboard shortcuts if you don't / can't use a mouse
 Keyboard Shortcuts
 Number row keys 1-5: change the die type for that position
 R: "roll" / generate the results
 T: change the theme
 S: toggle the sound effects on/off
 C: clear the history and die results
 Escape: quit the application
 F1: opens the help menu
 X: closes the help menu

firefox-addons:819184.name: Gesturefy
firefox-addons:819184.summary: Navigate, operate, and browse faster with mouse gestures! A customizable mouse gesture add-on with a variety of different commands.
firefox-addons:819184.description:
Gesturefy is a pure mouse gesture extension, which means it's only suited for mice and not touchpads. "What's a mouse gesture?" you might ask yourself. Well, mouse gestures are like keyboard shortcuts, only for your mouse. Instead of pressing a bunch of keys, you simply move your mouse in a certain manner to execute commands and actions. Mouse gestures can be more natural and convenient than keyboard shortcuts and thus are also suitable for casual users. Wait, is that a mouse in your hand? Come and try it out :)
 Features: 
 Mouse gestures (moving the mouse while holding the left, middle, or right button)
 More than 80 different predefined commands
 Provides special commands like popup, user script, multi purpose and cross add-on command
 Customizable gesture trace and status information style
 Rocker gestures (left-click while holding the right mouse button and vice versa)
 Wheel gestures (scroll wheel while holding the left, middle, or right button)
 Multilingual, thanks to volunteers on Crowdin 
 Light, dark and highcontrast theme
 Limitations: 
 Gesturefy does not work on Mozilla related pages like addons.mozilla.org , internal pages like about:addons or other add-on option pages (e.g. moz-extension://*). This is because Firefox restricts add-ons from accessing these pages for security reasons.
 The page must be partially loaded to perform gestures.
 MacOS Sierra: Wheel gestures currently doesn't work (see this bug )
 If you want to support Gesturefy, please visit this page ! 
 Permissions explained: 
 Access your data for all websites: This is a key permission, because the complete gesture functionality is injected in every webpage you visit (which means a part of the code is running in each tab). This is necessary, because with the new API there is no other way to track your mouse movement or draw anything on the screen. It's also needed to perform page specific commands like scroll down or up. 
 Read and modify browser settings: This is required to change the context menu behaviour for MacOS and Linux users to support the usage of the right mouse button. 
 Display notifications: This is used to show a notification on Gesturefy updates or to display certain error messages.

firefox-addons:2782929.name: EuroSaver - Amazon Europe Price Comparison
firefox-addons:2782929.summary: Simplifies Amazon product price comparison between all european Amazon stores.
firefox-addons:2782929.description:
EuroSaver is the easiest way to find the best deals on Amazon! Automatically find the best prices, compare entire shopping carts, and save time and money on every purchase.
🔍 HOW IT WORKS
The extension runs discreetly in the background. As soon as you view a product on Amazon, EuroSaver compares prices across all European Amazon stores and instantly displays the cheapest offer available.
🚀 KEY FEATURES
🇪🇺 EUROPE-WIDE PRICE COMPARISON
Automatically searches all European Amazon stores (de, fr, it, es, nl, se, uk, be, ie) with EuroSaver for the best prices and deals. This saves you valuable time and money!
💵 CURRENCY CONVERSION
Foreign currencies are immediately converted into your local store currency. So you always know exactly how much you end up paying.
🚛 SHIPPING COSTS INCLUDED
EuroSaver also shows you potential shipping costs so that you can be absolutely sure to get the lowest total price.
📊 QUICK PRICE INDICATOR
Gives you an instant visual overview and indicates directly whether you have found the best price for the current product.
🛒 SHOPPING CART COMPARISON
Don't just compare single items—compare your entire shopping cart across different European Amazon stores!
🔍 AMAZON SELLER FILTER
Filter products in a flash to display only items that are directly sold and shipped by Amazon.
📋 EASY COPY BUTTON
Copy order numbers instantly with a single click using a dedicated, handy button.
🌙 AMAZON DARK MODE
Protect your eyes during late-night shopping with a built-in, fully optimized dark mode for Amazon websites.
⬆ SCROLL-TO-TOP FUNCTION
Easily and comfortably jump back up to the top of the page with a dedicated shortcut button.
🌐 8+ LANGUAGES
Fully translated into more than 8 languages for a seamless, barrier-free, and intuitive user experience.
✅ YOUR SAVINGS EXPERIENCE
Due to the different pricing and availability of these formats in different shops, our extension may display incorrect prices for some product types. We are aware of this issue and are working to improve our algorithms to provide more accurate pricing information for all product types.

firefox-addons:993711.name: Video Quality Settings for YouTube (HD/4K)
firefox-addons:993711.summary: Watch YouTube in your preferred video quality, such as 720p, 1080p, 1440p and 2160p.
firefox-addons:993711.description:
Video Quality Settings for YouTube is a Firefox extension that sets the preferred quality of YouTube videos, and remembers your video quality settings between sessions. Limiting the video frame rate to 30 FPS is also supported.
Video Quality Settings for YouTube is an open source project made possible thanks to a community of awesome supporters. If you'd like to support the continued development of the extension, please consider contributing with Patreon , PayPal or Bitcoin .
The video quality is set to 1080p by default when the extension is installed, and the option can be updated from the player settings on YouTube, or from the extension's options. Reload already opened videos for changes to take effect.
The extension is also available for Chrome and Edge .
The developer does not collect any personal data from this extension, visit the extension's privacy policy for more information.
 Reviews are not monitored for bug reports, please use GitHub for issues and feature requests. 
 https://github.com/dessant/youtube-video-quality

firefox-addons:353480.name: YouTube Video Replay
firefox-addons:353480.summary: YouTube Video Replay is a new tool that lets you replay YouTube Videos.
firefox-addons:353480.description:
YouTube Video Replay is a new tool that lets you replay YouTube Videos.
 YouTube Video Replay is a new tool that lets you replay YouTube videos when activated. All YouTube videos are looped automatically whenever the YouTube Video Replay button is clicked.
You can click on Replay button below the YouTube videos to activate the Replay. When the page loads the replay state is set to Off therefore YouTube Video Replay button says Replay :: OFF . Clicking on the button will activate the loop and the video will replay when it reaches the end of the playtime . The button will now say Replay :: ON . If you want to deactivate replay you can re-click on the button anytime.
 YouTube HTML5 compatible.

firefox-addons:893176.name: IIIF Download
firefox-addons:893176.summary: Allows user to download fullsize content from digital libraries serving content using IIIF technology.
firefox-addons:893176.description:
With this addon installed, you will be able to download the highest available resolution for files available on digital libraries compatible with the IIIF protocol.
Right now, ths plugin is working for the French national digital library (Gallica).

firefox-addons:2699822.name: Download All Images
firefox-addons:2699822.summary: Save all images in active tab as .zip file. Easily save photos from Instagram, Google Images, etc.
firefox-addons:2699822.description:
Download All Images is a popular extension with over 140K users world wide - now available on Firefox! 🎉
How it works: 
1. Click the add-on icon to start 
2. Add-on will search the active tab for images
3. Add-on downloads all discovered images and creates a zip file of those images
4. Unzip and do whatever!
Add-on needs permission to access URLs to be able to download images directly on your device. Please see privacy policy to understand the purpose and use of requested permissions:
 https://download-all-images.mobilefirst.me/privacy

firefox-addons:3005678.name: Accessibility Snapshot Auditor
firefox-addons:3005678.summary: Audit page accessibility locally: structure, labels, media, ARIA, keyboard, and contrast.
firefox-addons:3005678.description:
Accessibility Snapshot Auditor helps developers, designers, QA teams, and web agencies catch common accessibility issues before launch.
Run a local audit on the current page and review grouped findings for:
 Document title, language, H1, heading order, and main landmarks.
 Accessible names for links, buttons, and custom interactive controls.
 Form labels for inputs, selects, and textareas.
 Text alternatives for images and image-like elements.
 ARIA pitfalls such as focusable content hidden from assistive technology.
 Keyboard order issues such as positive tabindex.
 Approximate text contrast checks.
Reports can be exported as HTML or CSV. Audit history and language preferences are stored only in local browser storage. The extension does not upload page content, DOM, screenshots, or audit results.

firefox-addons:2963408.name: StayFocusd Quick Access
firefox-addons:2963408.description: Extension to quickly open StayFocusd from your browser toolbar. Instantly access site blocking settings, focus tools, and usage stats without switching tabs, helping you limit distractions, manage time better, and stay productive online.

firefox-addons:979598.name: Simply Shopping List
firefox-addons:979598.summary: Forget about handwriting your shopping list on pieces of paper. Forget about sending text messages with items to be bought. Also available for Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=eu.scislo.mobilenext.simplyshoppinglist

firefox-addons:2938252.name: Group Shopping Assistant
firefox-addons:2938252.summary: Coordinate group shopping lists with shareable carts.
firefox-addons:2938252.description: Group Shopping Assistant lets multiple users collaborate on shopping lists, making it perfect for planning groceries, gifts, or bulk orders.

firefox-addons:917354.name: KeePassXC-Browser
firefox-addons:917354.summary: Official browser plugin for the KeePassXC password manager (https://keepassxc.org).
firefox-addons:917354.description:
Official browser plugin for the KeePassXC password manager ( https://keepassxc.org ).
The thing computers can do best is storing information.
You shouldn't waste your time trying to remember and type your passwords.
KeePassXC can store your passwords safely and auto-type them into your everyday websites and applications.

firefox-addons:534640.name: Go to random tab
firefox-addons:534640.summary: Adds a shuffle button next to your tabs. Switches to a random tab when clicked.
firefox-addons:534640.description:
Switches between tabs in the same window in a random fashion.
The keyboard shortcut Alt-Shift-R can be used instead of clicking the button. This shortcut can be redefined in Firefox extension shortcuts menu.
This extension is open source and available on Github .
Bug reports and pull requests welcome.

firefox-addons:864283.name: Humble New Tab Page
firefox-addons:864283.summary: Redesigned new tab page featuring your bookmarks, most visited, recently closed, and weather in a custom layout.
firefox-addons:864283.description:
Features :
 Simple, clean design
 Highly customizable
 Fast loading and lightweight
This extension replaces the default new tab page. Drag and drop folders to create new columns or reorder them. The font, colors, spacing, and more can be customized from the options menu.
 Known issues :
 Settings are not shared across Multi-Account Containers
 file:/// and about: URLs will not open ( https://bugzil.la/1269456 )

firefox-addons:977548.name: Fix Dark Theme Input Boxes
firefox-addons:977548.summary: Sets default background and text colors to inputs, selects and buttons when using a dark theme for the OS shell.
firefox-addons:977548.description:
Notice: This bug has been fixed in Firefox 68+ finally. It may still be an issue for you if you're using Firefox ESR (currently 60.8esr). Next ESR release cycle (from 68.2esr) will fix this for everyone and will deprecate this extension.
When you are using a dark theme for the OS shell —like Adwaita-dark on a GNU/Linux distro with the GNOME desktop —, the background and text colors of inputs, selectors and buttons are inherited from the dark theme, which causes some texts to be illegible. This extension restores the default background and text colors to inputs, selects and buttons to fix this issue.
This extension is libre software (under the Unlicense license). You can check in GitLab the source code of the extension .

Get ready to be swept away by Fish Hunter: Sea Adventure, the ultimate survival game that takes you into the heart of the ocean’s mysteries. 
Craft your destiny on a humble raft, transforming it into a floating fortress among the vast expanse of the open sea.You are a solo diver stranded in the vast ocean, embarking on an exciting journey of survival and exploration surrounded by the crashing waves. Fish Hunter: Sea Adventure is more than a game; it’s a test of strategy, creativity, and the will to survive. With every new sunrise over the horizon, a new adventure awaits. Do you have what it takes to survive the vast and treacherous ocean? Download Raft Adventure 3D now and set sail on an unforgettable survival adventure!

bluejetty:00182634:ios.name: Shadow Fight 3 - RPG Fighting
bluejetty:00182634:ios.summary:
Legend has it that a hero will come to end the fight for shadow energy. He will have to learn three fighting styles, collect the best weapons and challenge the strongest warriors.
The world is on the edge of an epic war. The mighty force
bluejetty:00182634:ios.description:
Legend has it that a hero will come to end the fight for shadow energy. He will have to learn three fighting styles, collect the best weapons and challenge the strongest warriors.
The world is on the edge of an epic war. The mighty force unleashed by the Gates of Shadows many years ago has turned into a weapon, and now three war clans are fighting to decide the future of this force.
The Legion warriors want to destroy the dangerous energy. The people of the Dynasty want to use it for their own benefit. While the mysterious ninjas of the Heralds clan explore the darkest secrets of the shadow power.
Three clans, three world views, and three fighting styles. Which side will you join?
Shadow Fight 3 - is an online RPG fighting game that continues the story of the Shadow Fight universe with new characters in 3D. Get ready for action, cool brawls with powerful fighters, and an exciting adventure around the world, where mystical forces reign.
CREATE AN EPIC HERO
Ninja, knight, or samurai? Only you can choose who your hero will be. Win unique skins in battles and customize your equipment colors to create a unique look.
WIN BATTLES
Explore the fighting styles of each of the 3 clans to create your personal combat style. Your hero can fight like a cunning ninja or a mighty knight. Harness shadow energy to deliver powerful and impressive blows that can change the course of the battle.
COMPLETE THE STORY
Warriors around the world await the appearance of a hero who will end the struggle for the power of the shadows. Influence the storyline by choosing your clan. Defeat powerful bosses to challenge your nemesis, and then explore other worlds and travel back in time to learn new details of the story.
SHOW OFF YOUR SKILL
Even when the main story battle is over, the action continues. Win duels by fighting other players' heroes controlled by AI. Brawl with the strongest warriors to take a place at the TOP-100 leaderboard and become a legend of your region!
COLLECT SETS
Collect your personal arsenal of weapons and armor to experiment in battles and look cool in duels. After collecting a full set of equipment, you get unique abilities to make it easier to win in a brawl.
PARTICIPATE IN EVENTS
Fight in regular themed events where you can win rare skins, colors, weapons, and armor. In these battles, you will face new heroes and learn a lot of interesting details about the world of Shadow Fight.
ENJOY THE GRAPHICS
Colorful scenery and realistic combat animations can rival the best console games.
JOIN THE COMMUNITY 
Follow us on social media to learn the tricks and secrets of the game from fellow players! Share the stories of your adventure, get updates and participate in competitions to win great prizes!
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/shadowfightgames
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ShadowFight_3
Youtube: https://www.youtube.com/c/ShadowFightGames
KEEP FIGHTING! 
Note:
* Shadow Fight 3 is an online game and requires a stable internet connection
Requires iOS 11.0 or later
Compatible with iPhone 6, iPod touch 6th gen, iPad Air 2, iPad Mini 4, iPad Pro or higher

bluejetty:00155226:ios.description:
A Omni é uma inovação revolucionária no setor de saúde e bem-estar. Como o primeiro plano de medicamentos independente de farmácias e da indústria, a Omni coloca o beneficiário no centro de todas as decisões, oferecendo uma experiência única e personalizada.
Ao aderir à Omni, você terá acesso a um aplicativo intuitivo e fácil de usar. Basta baixá-lo em seu dispositivo móvel e seguir três etapas simples para começar a desfrutar dos benefícios:
1) Baixe o aplicativo: Acesse a loja de aplicativos do seu dispositivo e faça o download gratuito do aplicativo Omni.
2) Faça o upload do seu tratamento médico: com o aplicativo omni instalado, você poderá fazer o upload do seu tratamento médico. Basta digitalizar ou tirar uma foto de sua receita médica e enviá-la pelo aplicativo. Isso permitirá que o sistema acompanhe seu tratamento e forneça lembretes personalizados de quando tomar seus medicamentos.
3) Acompanhe seu tratamento e receba notificações: com todas as informações de seu tratamento médico no aplicativo omni, você poderá acompanhar facilmente sua medicação diária. O aplicativo enviará notificações e lembretes personalizados para garantir que você nunca esqueça de tomar seus medicamentos no horário correto.
Mas as vantagens não param por aí! Se você tiver o benefício Omni disponível em sua empresa, poderá utilizar esse plano para pagar seus remédios de forma ainda mais conveniente. 
Confira como funciona:
4) Envie a receita médica: Assim como no uso individual do aplicativo Omni, você precisará enviar sua receita médica pelo aplicativo da empresa. Isso permitirá que a equipe Omni processe seu pedido e forneça todas as informações necessárias.
5) Decida onde comprar seu medicamento: Com a omni, você tem o poder de escolha. Você pode decidir onde comprar seus medicamentos, seja em uma farmácia física ou online. A liberdade de escolha é um dos pilares da Omni, garantindo que você possa obter seus remédios de acordo com sua preferência.
6) Pague no caixa usando PIX com o seu saldo da Omni: A grande novidade é que você poderá utilizar o PIX como forma de pagamento no caixa da farmácia. Através do aplicativo omni, você terá acesso ao seu saldo e poderá efetuar o pagamento de forma rápida e segura.

bluejetty:00152792:ios.description:
Check your credit score, track your credit report, and improve your financial health — all in one secure app.
Instantly calculate your educational credit estimate, simulate possible changes, and monitor progress with interactive tools.
Credit Score Check & Report helps you understand your score, identify what affects it, and build stronger credit habits with confidence.
INSTANT CREDIT SCORE ESTIMATE
Calculate your credit score (300 – 900) in seconds with our proprietary algorithm.
Choose Quick Check for a fast result or Full Report for deeper insights.
View a clear rating gauge — Poor · Fair · Good · Very Good · Excellent.
Educational estimate only — no official bureau data required.
CREDIT REPORT & SCORE BREAKDOWN
Review a detailed score summary and understand core factors.
Analyze payment history, credit utilization, account age, and inquiries.
Track trends with the History Tracker to see progress over time.
Explore core tools like Simulator (Impact Analysis) and Financial Health Dashboard for transparent results.
SCORE SIMULATOR & COMPARISON TOOLS
Use the Score Simulator to test “what-if” scenarios.
Adjust parameters such as credit limit or utilization and see the projected score.
Compare results with averages using Score Benchmarking.
Educational product suggestions appear for learning purposes only.
FINANCIAL HEALTH DASHBOARD
Monitor credit health, debt health, savings health, and income health in one view.
Track key financial ratios — for example the debt-to-income ratio — to evaluate stability.
Identify strengths and weaknesses instantly with clear visuals.
ACHIEVEMENTS & PROGRESS
Earn badges such as Credit Expert, Quiz Champion, and Consistency King.
Measure overall progress and stay motivated through gamified milestones.
Build financial awareness step by step.
PRIVACY & SECURITY
No signup required — use the app privately and securely.
Your data stays on your device unless you choose to save history.
We never share or sell personal information.
Trusted as a fully private credit tracker and score analyzer.
GLOBAL SUPPORT
Works worldwide with multi-currency and region-aware support.
Designed for anyone seeking simple, transparent credit insights.
Ideal for students, professionals, and financial planners.
PERFECT FOR
Checking credit health before loan or card applications.
Learning how financial behavior impacts credit rating.
Monitoring and improving credit performance over time.
Strengthening financial literacy and responsible planning.
DISCLAIMER
Credit scores in this app are educational estimates generated by our proprietary algorithm and not official credit-bureau reports.
For official reports, please refer to recognized credit bureaus in your country.
This app is intended for educational and personal-finance use only.
GET STARTED TODAY
Download Credit Score Check & Report to calculate your score, analyze factors, and track your credit health securely.
Gain knowledge and confidence to make better financial decisions and build a stronger future — one score at a time.

bluejetty:00136587:ios.description:
OnePlayer is a professional offline music player for local files, lossless audio, and NAS libraries—built to keep you in control of your music.
• Optimized for iOS 27, watchOS 27, and CarPlay 27, with a new iPad design and iPhone Duo support
• 2,500+ five-star ratings worldwide
• Hundreds of thousands of users across 170+ countries
If you collect FLAC, APE, DSD, or MP3 files—or keep music on a NAS—OnePlayer plays them anytime on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and CarPlay.
PLAYBACK ENGINE & LOSSLESS AUDIO
• 20+ formats, including FLAC, APE, DSD, WAV, ALAC, MP3, and AAC
• Upsampling to 96 or 192 kHz, with source and output sample rates shown live
• Native DSD output with a USB DAC
• Gapless playback and crossfade
• CUE support: single-file albums split into tracks on import
• Variable speed without pitch change, for audiobooks and courses
• Sleep timer, intro/outro skipping, and position memory
SOUND CENTER
• 10-band EQ with 20 presets
• Filters to bring out vocals or cut bass
• Loudness normalization evens out volume between songs
• Reverb and delay for the feel of a room or hall
• Vinyl Warmth, Classic Tape, Clean Tape, and Radio sound styles
• Direct mode bypasses all effects; press and hold to hear the original
IMPORT & NAS ACCESS
• Wi-Fi, USB, the Files app, AirDrop, iTunes/iPod library, and drag and drop on iPad
• SMB, WebDAV, NAS, and shared computer folders, with network discovery
• Remote libraries with streaming, offline caching, and batch downloads
MUSIC VISUALIZER
• Full-screen visuals when you turn iPhone or iPad sideways or stand iPhone Duo half-folded
• Spectrum Bars, Aurora, Magic Keys, Stardust, and 6 lyric scenes that light up as lines are sung
• VU meter player style with backlit stereo needles
LYRICS
• Word-by-word lyrics, floating lyrics, and translation
• LRC, TTML, SRT, VTT, and more, including TTML duets with background vocals and pronunciation
• On-device AI lyric recognition (iOS 26+), automatic in the background and saved to the file
MUSIC LIBRARY MANAGEMENT
• Browse by songs, albums, artists, folders, and playlists
• Regular and smart playlists, with M3U import and export
• Edit tags, artwork, and lyrics, with AI-assisted matching
APPLE WATCH STANDALONE PLAYBACK
• Play music without iPhone—through the speaker, with variable speed and sleep timer
• Cover Flow browsing with the Digital Crown
• Direct downloads from SMB and WebDAV
CARPLAY, SIRI & WIDGETS
• Browse your library, queue, and lyrics in CarPlay
• Play with Siri and Shortcuts, or automatically when CarPlay connects
• Lyrics, mini player, iPod-style, CD-style, and other widgets
LISTENING STATS & LAST.FM
• History stays on your device: Today, a listening calendar, and 18 charts
• Weekly, monthly, and yearly reports to share
• 100 listening badges in 10 series
• Last.fm scrobbling and loved-track sync
RINGTONE MAKER
• Turn up to 30 seconds of a song, audio file, or video into an iPhone ringtone (iOS 26+)
OnePlayer provides no audio or video streaming content or music download service. It plays files you import or access from your own servers.
Some features require Premium, compatible external hardware, or a newer OS version.
One-time purchases and subscriptions are available; prices vary by region. Subscriptions renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage them in App Store settings.
CONTACT US
oneplayer_app@outlook.com
PRIVACY POLICY
https://oneplayer.cn/about/privacy.html
TERMS OF USE
https://oneplayer.cn/about/terms.html

bluejetty:00156039:ios.summary:
The Inito Fertility Monitor tracks 4 key fertility hormones, identifies your fertile days, and confirms if you have ovulated in 10 minutes. It comes with a standalone wireless reader that brings lab-grade hormone values to your home.
Get a
bluejetty:00156039:ios.description:
The Inito Fertility Monitor tracks 4 key fertility hormones, identifies your fertile days, and confirms if you have ovulated in 10 minutes. It comes with a standalone wireless reader that brings lab-grade hormone values to your home.
Get accurate results of Estrogen, LH, PdG (urine metabolite of progesterone) & FSH with Inito, the all-in-one fertility monitor.
Why Inito?
1. Identify up to 6 fertile days by measuring real-time changes in Estrogen (E3G) and Luteinizing Hormone (LH) (3x more than ovulation kits).
2. Confirm if you have ovulated by detecting PdG, the urine metabolite of progesterone.
3. Delivering the most precise fertility hormone readings¹ at home, with Inito's patented Spectral Mapping Technology.
4. A smooth, wireless experience. Start your test and get your results in just 10 minutes.
5. Backed by 20+ patents, Inito's algorithm is powered by 40M+ hormone data points, interpreting your hormone changes relative to your own baseline, not population averages.
6. Recommended by OBGYNs and trusted by 200,000+ couples
How to Use Inito?
Getting started with Inito is simple. Just click on Test on the Inito App and follow the simple instructions:
1. Dip the Fertility Strip in urine.
2. Remove the strip cap and place it on the sampling end.
3. Insert the Fertility Strip into the reader.
4. Get personalized results automatically synced to the App.
Get the full picture of your cycle with Inito!
Please note that while Inito provides valuable insights into your ovulation cycle, it is not intended to diagnose, treat, or cure any medical condition, including infertility or hormonal disorders. If you have concerns about your fertility or reproductive health, please consult a qualified healthcare professional.
¹ "Most precise" refers to system-level precision measured in controlled laboratory testing, based on lower between-device variability across key hormones, concentrations, operators, days, and strip lots. Compares Inito to other U.S. over-the-counter at-home fertility monitors that provide numeric or graded hormone values and measure the same hormones as Inito.

bluejetty:00064054:ios.name: Sea Battle 2
bluejetty:00064054:ios.summary: Sea Battle 2 is everyone's favorite board game from their childhood with new abilities and an expanded arsenal! Millions of people around the world play this game. You will have battleships, airplanes, submarines, mines, and radar at your d
bluejetty:00064054:ios.description:
Sea Battle 2 is everyone's favorite board game from their childhood with new abilities and an expanded arsenal! Millions of people around the world play this game. You will have battleships, airplanes, submarines, mines, and radar at your disposal — and that's not all. Place your battleships on the battlefield and launch attacks on your opponent's field. Use various types of weapons to sink the enemy's naval fleet and win the battle. 
Fight against players from all around the world online in real time! Build your game strategy, improve your tactics, and don't give your rivals a chance! Increase your rank and become the admiral of your fleet!
Build your port city and collect rewards! Win in epic arenas and unlock new buildings. Build military bases, shipyards, factories, skyscrapers, landmarks, and much more!
Game features:
• ONLINE BATTLES
Fight against players from all around the world through the internet!
• ONLINE GAME WITH FRIENDS
Send invitations and play online with your friends
• RANKS
Win battles to raise your rank and title from sailor to admiral!
• ARENAS
Take part in battles in epic arenas, unlock new ones, and get rewards! 
• PORT CITY
Become a hero in your own city that you design and build!
• PLAY VIA BLUETOOTH
Set up battles with your friends, colleagues, or just acquaintances over Bluetooth.
• PLAY WITH A FRIEND
Play with friends on one phone (tablet), take turns placing your ships, choose your arsenal, and fight!
• TRAIN WITH A BOT
Choose the appropriate level of difficulty and try to defeat the AI (artificial intelligence).
• CUSTOMIZATION
Customize your war fleet and arsenal equipment and unlock various skins from the World War I era to modern times. Choose a formidable name for yourself, a cool avatar, and the flag of your fleet.
• CHAT
Interact with players during battle with chat and emojis.
• MULTIPLE GAME MODES
Select advanced mode or classic mode without additional weaponry.
• TOURNAMENTS AND TROPHIES
Participate in tournaments and win trophies. Fill your trophy room!
• GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS
Increase your ranking and become the best player on the global leaderboards based on your number of wins!
Sea Battle 2 is a game with beautiful graphics in the style of a notebook and effects that lend the game originality and an unforgettable atmosphere.
Sea Battle 2 is a free game, but some game elements can be purchased for real money.
*****
The time has come to find out who is the strongest in a sea battle!
Like Sea Battle 2? Find out more!
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/byril_games/

bluejetty:00087892:ios.description:
Your adventure, all in one place 
The Macs Adventure app is your complete digital companion for self-guided 
travel. 
Plan, navigate, and experience your trip with everything you need in your 
pocket, even when offline. 
Everything for your trip 
Access your full itinerary and travel details in one place, with no need for 
printed documents or searching through emails. 
• Day-by-day itinerary 
• Accommodation details and directions 
• Luggage transfers and transport information 
• Equipment hire and key travel details 
Everything is kept up to date, so you always have the latest information.
Navigate with confidence 
Follow your route using easy-to-use GPS navigation designed specifically for 
self-guided adventures. 
• Clearly mapped routes for each day 
• Real-time location tracking 
• Off-route alerts to keep you on track 
• Elevation profiles and route data 
Whether you’re walking or cycling, you’ll always know where you are. 
Works offline 
No signal? No problem. 
Download your trip before you go and access everything without mobile data: 
• Offline maps and routes 
• Full itinerary and trip details 
• Reliable navigation in remote areas 
Perfect for trails, rural destinations, and anywhere off grid. 
Track your journey 
Record your progress and relive your adventure: 
• Track daily distance and routes 
• Review and share your experience on the trail 
Expert insight, built in 
Get more from your trip with curated information from our expert team: 
• Route and destination insights 
• Practical tips and guidance 
• Points of interest along the way 
Travel independently, with confidence
The Macs Adventure app is designed to support you every step of the way — 
giving you the freedom to explore at your own pace, with everything you need 
in the palm of your hand. 
A note on battery usage 
Continued use of GPS can reduce battery life. We recommend carrying a power 
bank, especially on longer routes or when using the app as your primary 
navigation tool.

bluejetty:00150547:ios.description:
Totally Radio is Australia’s biggest independent streaming radio station.
Whatever your favourite music is, you’ll find it here, uninterrupted by DJ’s, traffic or weather, so scroll down, find your music choice and press play.
We have 11 channels to choose from (12 at Christmas), so whatever mood you’re in, there’s something for you.
On weekdays you’ll get headline news at breakfast and drivetime (South East time). The rest of the time we shut up and play your favourite music. Oh, apart from when we interrupt to tell you we have fewer interruptions. That’s really pissed people off, for some reason.
So there you go, great music, news when you want it, not when you don’t, and a questionable sense of humour.
You’re welcome, Australia.

CAT -> COT -> DOT -> DOG

Worph has:
+ A clean interface and a simple design
+ 15 puzzle packs
+ More than 100 free puzzles
+ Soothing music and sound effects
Worph does not have:
- Time limits - too stressful!
- Ads - too annoying!

Welcome to Sortlands: Fairy Tales — the puzzle adventure where sorting meets fairy tales!

bluejetty:00165296:ios.description:
Tap to sort the bus jam and send passengers to their home. Get ready for Car Escape, the colorful yet challenging bus parking puzzle game!
Are you looking for an ultimate parking jam game, where you can relax with satisfying gameplay while still exercise your brain with strategic puzzles? Try out Car Escape: Traffic Jam Puzzle to see this game is everything you’re looking for! Tap to move the buses, cars and minivans to the parking slots, and passengers will go on the cars that match their colors. Continually sort the buses and cars to help escape the traffic jam and send all passengers home.

The number of car parking slots and the number of seats on each one are limited, each bus or car can only contain 4 - 10 seats. Strategize your moves to find the right solution to this chaotic sorting bus puzzle.

- Vibrant & colorful design: Take a quick break with beautifully designed levels and enjoy sorting colorful bus out.
Are you ready for endless experience of colorful parking lot chaos? Jump right into Car Escape: Traffic Jam Puzzle and untangle the traffic jam puzzle as fast as you can. Download Car Escape and let the escaping journey begin!

bluejetty:00069084:ios.description:
WX Aviation Weather gives pilots fast aviation weather for 50,000+ airports worldwide — METAR, TAF, NOTAM, SIGMET and PIREP, both raw and fully decoded.
Built by and for pilots, it turns raw reports into clear, easy-to-read information: runway wind components, ceilings and visibility at a glance, and PDF or text reports you can share in seconds.
ROUTE BRIEFING (Premium)
- Save your regular routes: departure, waypoints (navaids or any point on the map), destination and alternate
- Advisory go/no-go for each airport at its own time — departure at ETD, destination and alternate at ETA — against your minimums, crosswind and runway-closure NOTAMs
- En-route SIGMET/AIRMET and PIREPs along the route, with flight time corrected for winds aloft
- Possible departure windows over the next 24 hours, with a push when a GO window opens
- Route map, alternate finder, saved offline briefings and PDF export
WEATHER ALERTS (Premium subscription)
- Push notifications the moment conditions change at the airports you monitor: flight category, personal minimums, crosswind, TAF go/no-go and NOTAM (runway closures, ILS, lighting or navaid outages).
WEATHER & REPORTS
- METAR, TAF, NOTAM and SIGMET — raw and decoded
- Weather timeline — METAR history and the TAF forecast on one time axis with a NOW marker
- Personal minimums — set your own ceiling, visibility and crosswind limits; periods below them are highlighted right on the timeline
- TAF verification — see how the previous TAF actually verified against the observed METARs, with a match rate
- NOTAM timeline — every NOTAM on one time axis with the TAF and the crosswind on the best open runway; pick your departure time to see what is in force. Filter by category, critical NOTAMs highlighted
- METAR, TAF and NOTAM in plain language — flowing prose summaries, no shorthand required
- Pilot reports (PIREP) on the map — turbulence and icing reported by other aircraft, color-coded by severity, with a full decoded detail view
- Runway wind components for every runway, plus a per-runway crosswind timeline — a color-coded severity bar for recent and forecast crosswind, with your personal limit marked
- Adaptive weather map: runway layout, flight category and wind barbs; zoom in for more METAR detail

PULSEY: Your Pregnancy Sound Journal
Listen to, record, and save the gentle sounds of your pregnancy. Pulsey uses advanced audio enhancement to help you amplify subtle belly sounds using only your iPhone microphone—no extra accessories needed.
HOW IT WORKS Pulsey acts as a sound amplifier for expecting parents. By using sophisticated audio processing, it highlights quiet sounds from your surroundings. Create a beautiful audio keepsake of your journey and build a personal pregnancy sound journal.
KEY FEATURES • Belly Sound Amplifier (Premium): Listen to quiet, subtle sounds with sound enhancement. • Record & Save (Premium): Capture audio sessions and build a library of memories. • Pregnancy Countdown: Track your progress with a due date countdown. • Mindful Listening: Designed for relaxing, quiet moments between parent and baby. • Private & Secure: All audio is stored 100% locally on your device.
Note: Amplification and Recording features require an in-app purchase.
TIPS FOR THE BEST EXPERIENCE • Remove your phone case for better microphone contact. • Find a very quiet room (background noise will be amplified). • Use headphones to hear the enhanced audio clearly. • Be patient—gentle movements and sounds take time to find.
PRIVACY & SAFETY Pulsey is for entertainment and wellness purposes only. It is NOT a medical device and is not intended to replace professional medical advice or provide clinical data (such as heartbeat monitoring). For any health concerns, always consult your doctor.

bluejetty:00166734:ios.description:
Welcome to Solitaire Tile, the relaxing free-to-play Solitaire card game! Train your brain and keep your mind calm by playing.
Test your strategy and skill by pairing cards of the same rank and suit and eliminating all.
Solitaire Tile is the perfect solitaire experience that combines the best features of classic Solitaire card games, Tile Matching games and Solitaire Mahjong games.
Match 3 solitaire cards of the same rank and suit.
Each level starts with a board of beautifully arranged cards.
Tap on a card on the board to move it to the bottom bar, with room for up to 3 sets of cards.
When you successfully match 3 cards of the same rank and suit, they disappear, clearing space for new cards.
Avoid tapping on cards randomly. Strategically plan your moves carefully to avoid filling up the space.
Match Joker to earn exciting rewards.
