bluejetty:00083871:ios.name: MelodEar: Perfect Ear Training
bluejetty:00083871:ios.summary: Welcome to MelodEar – A music learning tool that is designed to help musicians and singers where they can understand and hear harmonic progressions and sing their favorite melodies. It is an advanced tool to help singers and instrumentalist
bluejetty:00083871:ios.description:
Welcome to MelodEar – A music learning tool that is designed to help musicians and singers where they can understand and hear harmonic progressions and sing their favorite melodies. It is an advanced tool to help singers and instrumentalists by connecting their voice and music instruments to make them more expressive.
+ Experience different piano chords and scales 
+ Watch music theory videos and practice daily with music reading exercises
 + Recognize music intervals and notes with ear training and understanding harmonic progression
Whether you want to understand and improve harmonic progressions and improvisation skills or want to create your own melodies then MelodEar has got you covered ! Here you learn how to sing along with instrumental music.
DAVID ESKENAZY VISION:
MelodEar is designed by David Eskenazy, a musician, singer, and a facilitator who spent 15 years in developing real-life teaching methods and music theory exercises focused on helping musicians and vocalists to understand and improve their harmonic progression and melodic skill.
Why and for Whom MelodEar is designed?
For Musicians: It is a tool that’s designed to help instrumentalists connect their fingers with inner ear. The only aim of the tool (specifically for musicians) is to help them sing with their music instruments to improve their ability of improvising and creating melodies.
For Singers: It allows singers to engage with jazz harmony and melodic modes in a more creative way. Improve pitch accuracy and melodic creativity. Improve your sight reading skills and engage in the vocal training to improve vocal agility and understand the flow within and between different harmonic structures. 
+ Learn piano scales to improve understanding of scales and intervals 
+ Enter the training mode to develop improvisation skills and increase  
+ Learn piano chords and build strong connection between what you hear and what you play!
How does MelodEar work?
MelodEar provides an intuitive and easy-to-use interface to help musicians and singers understand and improve their musical skills. Following is step-by-step method of how it works:
+ Edit Window: Start creating and editing your song including selecting and modifying chords. Customize the structure of your music by choosing melodic modes that match the harmonic progression of the song.
+ The Library: Once the song is created, it gets stored in the library which also contains pre-filled smooth jazz standards. You can access, modify, or use them as templates for learning purposes.
+ Session Window: It is the core of MelodEar where you start the real practice. Here you view the harmonic progression of a song with a visual display of the melodic modes that are connected to each chord. 
See how notes and intervals relate to each other
Play with chords (jazz chords, guitar chords), scales, and melodies in real-time using the chord player and vocal keyboard which plays the piano notes of the chosen mode.
“Pitch recognition” feature allows you to highlight the notes you’re singing to hit the right pitch. You can also adjust the pitch with a “fine tuner” and focus on specific sections of song with a “looper” for repeated practice.
+ See It, Hear It, Sing It: See the musical structure visually, hear the melodic intervals, and sing. Get real-time feedback to check your accuracy.
+ Learning and Skill Building: Learn music notes from tutorials and get a guidance through music reading exercises to improve your pitch, ear training, and improvisational skills. Develop deep understanding of harmony and melodic patterns to improve your musical creativity.
+ MelodEar Tutorial Pack: Get detailed guidance and comprehensive learning resources to improve your musical skills. Get step-by-step instructions, skill-development exercises, improvisation training, understanding music theory, and improving musical creativity.
Terms of Use: https://vocal-improv.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://vocal-improv.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00119964:ios.description:
Improve mental organization skills. Practice categories in a versatile speech therapy app.
When you struggle with categories due to stroke, brain injury, or autism, simple tasks can be impossible. But there’s a way to heal the broken networks of meaning.
GET CATEGORY THERAPY, an app designed for both speech therapists and home users to help restructure the brain and let the ideas flow.
- Take control with evidence-based exercises designed by experts
- Improve word-finding and sorting skills with 4 engaging activities and unlimited practice
- Get an app that works in both home and clinical settings
- Interact with clear photos and a simple interface that's easy for everyone to use
- Adjust settings to target your goals and suit your needs
- Use reports and customization to seamlessly fit the app into your therapy program
** Download Category Therapy Lite for FREE to see how it can help! **
When you lose the ability to group items and identify what they have in common, it gets in the way of your ability to understand, learn, and communicate. But with the right kind of practice, it’s possible to strengthen the connections between words and concepts and navigate your world more easily.
“It will be a LONG time before you run out of content to use with one patient, and the app’s fantastic settings options will allow you to use it with a variety of individuals, regardless of cognitive abilities.”
- Aubrey Klingensmith, MS, CCC-SLP, Speechie Apps
GET THE RIGHT ACTIVITY - FOR EVERY BRAIN.
No two people are the same. With 4 activities ranging from simple to complex, there's something in Category Therapy to match your needs. Work through them gradually or focus on the activity that best suits your needs.
1) FIND: Start with the basics. You'll hear and see a photo of a category (let's say "Fruit"). Tap the item that matches (for example, a banana).
2) CLASSIFY: Switch it up. Now you start with an item and choose the category that matches. This tests your ability to apply categories to what you see.
3) ADD ONE: Train yourself to recognize common features of items – to categorize them – and then choose one item that fits the category you’ve identified.
4) EXCLUDE: Challenge yourself. By choosing an item that doesn't belong, you learn how to independently identify categories. As things get harder, you can always tap Hint for some help.
ALL DONE? Share your progress. The app makes it easy to quickly view, share, or e-mail detailed reports to a therapist or loved one.
GET EVERY FEATURE YOU NEED IN ONE EASY APP.
• 70 categories and nearly 700 words in one package
• 3 difficulty levels ranging from simple objects to more abstract concepts
• Great for aphasia, brain injury, autism, and other cognitive & language impairments
• Switch to Pictures Only to practice naming or Words Only to practice reading
• Customize the number of trials, choices, and more – it’s yours to control
• Designed with adults in mind but easy enough for children to use 
• No subscriptions, no monthly bills, no Wi-Fi needed
THERE’S HOPE. With Category Therapy in your corner, you can build stronger connections between words – and learn to speak and think more easily.
** DOWNLOAD NOW to get started – or try it for FREE with Category Therapy Lite! **
Looking for something different in a speech therapy app? We offer a wide range to choose from. Find the right one for you at https://tactustherapy.com/find

bluejetty:00180625:ios.description:
Have you ever been photobombed? Yes? Bummer! If not, we bet you’ve got plenty of pics that look really awesome but… something or even somebody in these photos kind of spoils everything and you wish you could edit them. True?

- Smart & fast object removal: eliminate any unwanted object(s) with one tap.
- Adjustable retouch brush: adjust the brush to any size you need for every pic.

- Shareable feature: instantly share your tuned pics with others on social media.
Use our Photo Retouch app anywhere and even on the go! Introducing OMT Pay: Your Ultimate Mobile Wallet
OMT Pay is not just another mobile wallet app - it's your all-in-one solution for seamless financial transactions. Download now and experience financial freedom like never before!

- Balances at a Glance: Easily check the balance and statements for both your wallet and OMT Visa Card.
- Simplify your financial life with OMT Pay. Download now and enjoy a new level of convenience and control over your finances. Say hello to a smarter way to pay!

bluejetty:00022781:ios.name: One For All Setup
bluejetty:00022781:ios.summary: The One For All Setup app is used to set up devices on the One For All Smart Control (URC 7980). The app uses Bluetooth Low Energy (also known as Bluetooth Smart) to communicate with the remote control, giving access to the full online data
bluejetty:00022781:ios.description:
The One For All Setup app is used to set up devices on the One For All Smart Control (URC 7980). The app uses Bluetooth Low Energy (also known as Bluetooth Smart) to communicate with the remote control, giving access to the full online database of over 7,000 brands and 335,000 individual models of Audio/Video devices. Devices can be set up by model search, function search or directly selecting the code. The app also gives you access to the Remote Finder functionality, allowing you to locate your remote by simply pressing a button and listening for the beep.
Features:
• Online access to Universal Electronics’ database of Infra-Red Device Control codes
• Search by brand, model, function or code
• Automatic setup on the One For All Smart Control
• Ensures compatibility with your Home Entertainment devices, now and in the future
• Remote finder – locate your remote using your phone
• Requires a Bluetooth Smart capable phone
The One For All Setup app is powered by QuickSet Cloud from Universal Electronics. For more info see http://quicksetcloud.com/.

【こんな方におすすめ】
・通勤・移動のスキマ時間をビジネス学習に変えたい
・投資・NISA・資産形成について基礎から学びたい
・キャリアアップ・転職・副業のヒントを得たい
・経営者のリアルな成功・失敗談を聞きたい
・経済ニュースを深く、わかりやすく理解したい
・AI・テクノロジーなど最新トレンドを押さえたい
・YouTubeにはない質の高いビジネスコンテンツを探している
・無料でビジネスの学びを始めたい
【番組カテゴリ】
▼ 経済・投資
NISA・株式投資・不動産・保険など、資産形成に必要な知識を一流のプロが解説。初心者から経験者まで幅広く対応します。
代表番組：MONEY SKILL SET / PIVOT TALK MONEY
▼ ビジネス・経営
CEO・創業者が成功と失敗のリアルを語ります。起業・新規事業・マーケティング・組織づくりなど、現場で使える実践知識が満載。
代表番組：9 questions / TOP TALK
▼ キャリア・働き方
転職・副業・リスキリング・リーダーシップなど、これからの働き方を考えるヒントを提供。20代から50代まで、すべてのビジネスパーソンに。
代表番組：PIVOT TALK CAREER / 企業超分析
▼ テクノロジー・AI
生成AI・半導体・宇宙・エネルギーなど、ビジネスの未来を左右するテクノロジーの最前線をわかりやすく解説。
代表番組：PIVOT TALK TECH / PIVOT TALK SCIENCE
▼ 社会・政治・地政学
政策・地政学・教育・健康など、ビジネスパーソンとして知っておくべき社会の動きを多角的に分析。
代表番組：政策超分析 / PIVOT TALK POLITICS / EDUCATION SKILL SET
▼ ランキング・データ分析
話題のランキングやデータを専門家と読み解き、時代の潮流を可視化。
代表番組：ランキング超分析 / 業界超分析
【主な機能】
・バックグラウンド再生：画面を閉じても再生が続く
・音声モード：動画を音声だけで楽しめる
・オフライン視聴：ダウンロードして通信量ゼロで視聴
・倍速再生：0.5倍〜2.0倍まで速度調整
・マイリスト：気になる番組を保存
・視聴マイル：視聴でマイルが貯まり特典と交換可能
・毎日更新：新しい番組を毎日無料で配信
【利用者の声】
「電車で毎日観ています。仕事の勉強にもなるし、いい息抜きにもなっています」
「無料でこのクオリティの動画が観られるのは本当にありがたい。広告もほとんどなく快適です」
「バックグラウンド再生ができるのが最高。動画を聴きながら家事ができるので、時間を有効活用できるようになった」
「課題に直面した時の勉強ツールとして活用しています。いろんな角度からのアプローチが面白く、新しい発見ばかりです」
【PIVOTについて】
PIVOTは、映像番組を軸としたビジネスメディアです。
テレビ・新聞・雑誌では届きにくい「経営者の本音」「専門家の深い分析」「現場のリアル」を、プロの制作チームが高品質な映像でお届けしています。
無料でダウンロード。
まずは1本、今日から始めてみませんか？

bluejetty:00023694:ios.description:
بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم
"الذَّاكِرِينَ اللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَالذَّاكِرَاتِ أَعَدَّ اللَّهُ لَهُمْ مَغْفِرَةً وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًا"
 أخبرنا بكر بن محمد بن حمدان الصيرفي بمرو ، ثنا عبد الصمد بن الفضل البلخي ، ثنا مكي بن إبراهيم ، ثنا عبد الله بن سعيد بن أبي هند ، عن زياد بن أبي زياد مولى ابن عياش ، وأبي بحرية ، عن أبي الدرداء رضي الله عنه
 قال
 : قال النبي صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم : " ألا أنبئكم بخير أعمالكم ، وأزكاها عند مليككم وأرفعها في درجاتكم ، وخير لكم من إعطاء الذهب والورق ، وأن تلقوا عدوكم فتضربوا أعناقهم ، ويضربوا أعناقكم ؟ " قالوا : وما ذاك يا رسول الله ؟ قال : " ذكر الله عز وجل " . " . "
برنامج تسبيح المسلم هو برنامج يساعدك على ذكر الله عز وجل فهو يحتوى على مجموعه من الاذكار الصوتيه والتى يتم تشغليها كل مده معينه من الوقت بناء على رغبتك فى الذكر
- تم اضافه مجموعه متنوعه من الاذكار الصوتيه والمختلفه
- ايقاف الاذكار فى وقت معين 
- تم اضافه القرآن الكريم بصوت ٦٤ قارىء
- تم اضافه آيات الدعاء فى القران الكريم
- تم اضافه قسم الأوائل
- تم اضافه أذكار اليوم
- تم اضافه جميع الأحداث الأسلاميه مقسمه حسب الشهور الهجريه
- تم اضافه المفضله
- التحويل من التاريخ الهجرى الى التاريخ الميلادى والعكس
ملاحظات هامة
========
- من فضلك قيم التطبيق اذا حاز على اعجابك
- اذا حاز البرنامج على اعجابك فساعدنا فى نشره 
- نحن لا نستطيع الرد على التعليقات على الاستور لذلك نرجو منكم التواصل معنا

bluejetty:00121322:ios.description:
"Adventuring at its best." – TouchArcade
"It's a bit like The Room, only with more rooms." – Pocket Gamer
"Creepy, welcomely old-fashioned iPhone adventure game." – Kotaku
The epic conclusion to the Forever Lost saga.
The truth is finally within reach.
Your search leads you to the abandoned Hawthorne Asylum, a place with a dark history of mysterious experiments, forgotten patients, and secrets that refused to stay buried. Every corridor, every room, and every clue brings you closer to uncovering the truth behind your past—and the mystery that has haunted you from the very beginning.
Explore the abandoned asylum, collect useful items, uncover hidden clues, and solve challenging escape room-style puzzles in the thrilling final chapter of the acclaimed Forever Lost series.
If you enjoy first-person point-and-click adventures, escape room games, mystery puzzles, hidden object exploration, and atmospheric storytelling, Forever Lost: Episode 3 delivers the unforgettable conclusion to the trilogy.
New to the series? We recommend playing Episodes 1 and 2 first to experience the complete story.
Features
• The thrilling final chapter of the Forever Lost trilogy.
• Immersive first-person point-and-click puzzle adventure.
• Explore the abandoned Hawthorne Asylum and uncover its dark secrets.
• Solve challenging escape room-inspired puzzles.
• Search every room for hidden clues and useful items.
• Use the unique Glitch Camera to reveal secrets and document your discoveries.
• Atmospheric visuals paired with an unforgettable soundtrack.
• Built-in hint system whenever you need a helping hand.
• Signature Glitch Games humour hidden throughout the adventure.
• Auto-save ensures you never lose your progress.
• No ads or in-app purchases.
Some mysteries should stay buried.
This one won't.
–

bluejetty:00089392:ios.description:
OhMD is a HIPAA-compliant omni-channel patient communication platform built for physician practices struggling with high inbound patient call volume. It brings AI-driven and human-led conversations together across phone, text, and web in one unified inbox, allowing practices to manage all patient communication from a single system.
OhMD uses a hero-in-the-loop model. AI handles routine patient requests such as appointment scheduling, call deflection, voicemail transcription, and common questions. When staff expertise is needed, teams can step into, respond to, or take over conversations instantly from the same inbox. This ensures automation never replaces visibility or control.
Unlike messaging-only platforms or standalone voice AI tools, OhMD combines secure texting, calling, and AI voice in one platform. All patient conversations remain centralized, searchable, and assigned to the right teams, reducing phone interruptions and front desk overload.
Practices use OhMD to:
- Deflect inbound patient calls into text and AI-assisted conversations
- Answer calls, texts, and web chats from one unified inbox
- Automate scheduling and routine requests without removing staff from the loop
- Reduce front desk interruptions and staff burnout
- Improve patient access without hiring or outsourcing
Practices using OhMD report:
- Fewer staff-handled calls
- Lower communication costs
- Improved practice revenue and growth
Core capabilities include:
- AI-assisted call answering and scheduling
- Secure texting and call-to-text deflection
- Unified inbox for calls, texts, and web chat
- Smart routing and assignments based on patient intent
- Human takeover of AI conversations when needed

bluejetty:00035050:ios.summary: Get ready for an epic strategy game that takes you to the heart of feudal Japan! Step into the world of "Samurai Lords" and assume the role of a powerful daimyo striving to unite the land under your leadership. In this meticulously crafted
bluejetty:00035050:ios.description:
Get ready for an epic strategy game that takes you to the heart of feudal Japan! Step into the world of "Samurai Lords" and assume the role of a powerful daimyo striving to unite the land under your leadership. In this meticulously crafted strategy game, you'll face challenging tasks, build your empire, and lead your armies to victory.
Key Features:
1. Historical Accuracy: The game is set in the Sengoku period, a time when Japan was divided among warring clans. Immerse yourself in an authentic historical setting with detailed maps and iconic Japanese Oda and Takeda clans.
2. Sandbox Mode: For those who crave creative freedom and endless possibilities, the Sandbox Mode allows you to craft your own unique scenarios. Build, experiment, and strategize without the constraints of the story, giving you the ultimate control over your empire's destiny.
3. FPS Mode: Immerse yourself deeper into the battlefield by switching to FPS mode at any time. Take direct control of any soldier in your army and experience the intensity of combat firsthand, adding a thrilling new dimension to your strategic gameplay.
4. Intense Battles: Lead your armies into battle in real-time combat. Combine different units like samurai, archers, and ninjas to gain a tactical advantage over your enemies. Utilize terrain and weather to achieve strategic objectives.
5. Rich Story Campaigns: Experience thrilling story missions that guide you through key events of the Sengoku period. Each mission is full of twists and challenges that will test your strategic skills and decision-making.
6. Stunning Graphics: Enjoy breathtaking graphics and detailed animations that bring the world of feudal Japan to life. Every aspect of the game is meticulously designed to provide an authentic and immersive experience.
7. Development and Customization: Develop your characters and units, acquire new units and upgrade them. Customize your play style and create an army that suits your tactical preferences.
Join the Battle Today!
Dive into the world of "Samurai Lords" and carve your name into history. Strategize, fight, and negotiate your way to the top as you aim to become the most powerful shogun. The path to glory is fraught with challenges, but with cunning and strength, you can conquer all.
Become a Legend
Embrace the call to arms and download "Samurai Lords" now. Lead your clan to greatness and secure your legacy in the annals of Japanese history. The battlefield awaits your command—are you ready to seize your destiny?

- Company profile and business summary

- Commodity prices for gold, silver, oil and more
- Currency converter for global exchange rates
BUSINESS NEWS
- Market news linked to the shares on your watchlist
- Local and international business headlines

bluejetty:00013635:ios.description:
KWL Series contains an exciting platform of interactive and engaging religious education content based on the highly popular series, ‘To Know, Worship & Love’ (KWL). Based on the Catechism of the Catholic Church, the Scriptures and liturgy, this development is a synthesis of methods derived from 50 years of Religious Education experience, and is in line with The General Directory of Catechesis, 1997. ‘To Know, Worship and Love’ has the Imprimatur of the Catholic Archdiocese of Melbourne, Australia.
Building on the original “KWL Digital: Secondary Series” app, this app further reconceptualises the digital possibilities with a more substantial interactive core enabling students to engage on a deeper level with the religious educational resources. This is done by providing visually rich and interactive content that facilitates modern pedagogy allowing new ways of exploration and discovery learning. 
This app offers functionality that feels like a ‘study desk’ for Religious Education comprising of helpful features such as search, link, zoom, bookmark and annotations.
The Catholic Archdiocese of Melbourne, in collaboration with other dioceses remains committed to the ongoing development and transformation of these religious education resources.

Window has everything you need (and more) to create a healthier lifestyle!

• Personal statistics – Track your own statistics like weight, water intake, and more.
• Healthy challenges – Build new habits, like consuming less sugar, with small tasks.

bluejetty:00096446:ios.description:
Step into the world of "Enchanted Stories: PAWisoned Kingdom", where royal intrigue and feline valor collide. When treachery poisons the throne, only a fearless blade and a cunning rogue can uncover the truth. Explore a magical land in the gripping adventure games, filled with secrets, suspense, and heart-pounding quests. Sharpen your skills in thrilling hidden object games, uncover clues in immersive search and find games, and rise as the hero Castelia needs. Dare to find hidden objects where loyalty is scarce and shadows whisper betrayal. Perfect for fans of finding object games who crave mystery and fantasy!
The great feline kingdom of Castelia stands on the brink of disaster. Its beloved monarch, King Leonard III, lies mysteriously ill. The palace whispers treason. The royal healer evades questions. Someone in the court wants the king dead. When duty no longer offers answers, Felicia - the king's fiercest protector and master swordswoman - must seek help from the shadows. Here comes Diego, the infamous and roguish truthseeker with a sharp tongue and an even sharper blade. To uncover the truth, this unlikely duo must trade their titles for disguises and sneak through both back alleys and pompous hallways. But as they scratch beneath the surface, a deeper plot emerges - one that threatens not just the King, but the delicate balance between cats and humans across the realm. Will they save Leonard before his final breath? Or will Castelia fall to the claws of conspiracy?
· A Kingdom on the Brink!
Immerse yourself in the ultimate blend of adventure games and hidden object games, where every choice shapes the fate of the feline kingdom. Test your courage in perilous quests while solving puzzles in the tricky finding object games.
· Secrets in Every Shadow!
Train your eye and intuition with engaging search and find games! Sneak through lavish halls and gritty alleys, piecing together clues to unravel royal secrets. If you love find hidden objects and finding object games, this story will captivate you.
· An Unlikely Alliance!
Join Felicia and Diego in our unforgettable adventure games. Collect items, solve puzzles, and conquer challenges across the land. Fans of hidden object games and finding object games will discover a richly woven plot full of danger and magic.
· Mystery Awaits the Brave!
Challenge yourself with clever mini-games and puzzles while indulging in richly illustrated search and find games. Master the art of find hidden objects to reveal the truth behind the poisoned crown. Perfect for enthusiasts of hidden object games.
Step into Castelia, sharpen your blade, and open your eyes—because in this free trial, only the sharpest minds and the bravest hearts can triumph!

bluejetty:00061985:ios.summary:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
***** A title from our extremely successful Abby series -- all TWELVE (!) RA
bluejetty:00061985:ios.description:
***** Developed by an award-winning education studio, 22learn, the creator of the best-selling Abby Basic Skills app, in cooperation with educational specialists. 
***** A title from our extremely successful Abby series -- all TWELVE (!) RANKED #1 APP FOR KIDS on APP Store in many countries. 
Let's come and play with me! 
This new user-friendly wonderful Abby's Magic Laptop for Preschool and Toddlers welcomes you to the colorful world of exploration and learning! This adorable learn and play laptop teaches children letters, numbers, colors, shapes, animals, toys, fruits, musical instruments, and more. Kids will love switching between categories. Actions lead to learning!
The application offers you in total the possibility of choosing from 12(!) thematic categories. Children will be thrilled to play with this laptop and learn new things. The numerous buttons the laptop offers invite exploration and enable children to determine their own pace of learning according to their individual needs.
The laptop includes two game modes: 'Let's Play!' and 'Let's Learn!' The switching between the modes is made easy by two large red buttons. Children typically do not experience problems learning to activate these two modes, but in case they do, we encourage parents to switch the mode
for their children.
*Let's Play!*
The 'Let's Play!' mode is designed primarily for children unfamiliar with the objects included, or those who want to refresh and enhance their knowledge of the already acquired vocabulary. To activate the mode, simply press the 'Let's play!' button, and choose a desired thematic category from one of the blue buttons in the upper half of the gaming space. For instance, after pressing a blue button with a picture of a ball, there are going to appear buttons with toys theme on the lower half of the gaming screen. When pressing the individual picture buttons then, the pictures are going to appear enlarged on the laptop monitor, the pronounced name and the written form of the word as well as its authentic sound and small animation follows afterwards.
*Let's Learn!*
Do you want some practice too? Don't forget to try the 'Let's Learn!' mode! To activate this mode, tap on the 'Let's Learn' button. Afterwards, choose one of the twelve thematic categories and let the challenge begin! When the category has been selected, an enthusiastic monkey Abby appears on the laptop monitor and gives tasks to a child. The task is always to select the picture of the correct item that she pronounced. Of course, after each correct answer, the cute monkey provides words of praise and
encouragement.
To make the laptop more engaging, we also included four colorful buttons in the lower half of the game screen. These simulate the functions of a videophone and include such funny effects such as entertaining sound effects and melodies.
Thank you for selecting our app! We sincerely hope your children will enjoy it!
Your 22learn team!
For the Terms of Use (EULA), see https://22learn.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00123709:ios.description:
Ballistic Baseball has a new HR-hitting contest! Can you hit more home runs than your opponent? This HR-hitting contest requires hitting balls well, WITH accuracy! Earn bonus points by hitting targets, consecutive HRs, and random bonus pitches. Have you got the bat skills necessary to top the Game Center leaderboard in our new Ballistic Bash home run contest?!
Put your baseball strategy to the test in live head-to-head matches where you’ll choose the perfect pitch to strike out opponents, or swing for the fences on your way to becoming a champion. Ballistic Baseball is a celebration of the Great American Pastime realized in a fun, larger-than-life art style.
Email your feedback or questions: ballistic-support@gameloft.com
For news, advanced help, and more, visit our official site at ballistic-baseball.com
REAL-TIME SHOWDOWNS
- Square off against real opponents in a real-time PvP baseball game!
- With just a tap, you can direct every pitch, using a wide selection of pitching styles.
- Step up to the plate and swing with easy-to-learn tap controls.
- Challenge friends to private player-versus-player matches anytime!
- Congratulate, amuse or taunt your opponents with fun animated emotes.
CAREER MODE
- Take your team all the way to the Big Leagues in a new Career mode!
- Each win gives you Training Points that can be spent to improve your players’ Power, Contact, Speed, Fielding or pitching attributes.
- Then take that team online to challenge your friends and the world!
- Unlock Bronze-, Silver- and Gold-tier players, each with their own strengths and weaknesses, to create a unique team.
A WINNING PLAN
- Strategically pick your pitchers, batting order and field positions to make quick work of each opponent that steps up to you in the ballpark.
- Earn XP for every achievement in your baseball games.
- Customize the look of your players with a range of bats, helmets, uniforms and more to make your team unique.
BIG MOMENTS
- Feel the anticipation as the batter gets ready to hit the ball and run, or as the catcher’s mitt edges closer to the runner sliding into home plate.
- Witness each amazing strikeout, close call, and home run that gets the entire ballpark cheering!
- Ballistic Baseball captures and amplifies these moments in a visually dramatic style.

bluejetty:00095487:ios.name: Dominoes Tour: Classic Game
bluejetty:00095487:ios.summary:
DOMINATE AT DOMINOES
Everyone loves a classic game of dominoes, but this online version makes your favorite board game even better! All sorts of domino games await, each with their different objectives, and you can either play on your own
bluejetty:00095487:ios.description:
DOMINATE AT DOMINOES
Everyone loves a classic game of dominoes, but this online version makes your favorite board game even better! All sorts of domino games await, each with their different objectives, and you can either play on your own to up your skills, or test your skills by playing with friends, both new and old. No matter what options you choose, playing dominos online is sure to please.
CLASSIC GAMES MADE BETTER
From casual gamers to domino masters, all are sure to enjoy climbing the leaderboards in addition to working out their brains thanks to this online board game. Exciting tournaments will keep you on your toes, while the smooth graphics and intuitive controls make this free online dominoes game great for all ages.
What you have to look forward to:
- Brain training: Dominoes might seem like an unlikely candidate in this regard, but this board game is actually great for working on your strategy skills! Sit back and relax as your brain puzzles through the different levels in this classic game, and see how long it takes to reach the leaderboards.
- Friendly competition: Sure, sometimes you just want to play by yourself. Other times you might want the fun and competition of going head to head with friends or strangers – playing dominos online with Dominoes Tour will get you the best of both worlds! Plus we’ve added lots of fun daily rewards and challenges to keep the domino fun going.
- Great graphics: Part of the joy of the original game of dominoes was the simplicity of the tiles, and we’ve made sure to keep that here. No crazy graphics or colors that will distract you from your goals here! Enjoy the best of the classic game, but with none of the cleanup or lost pieces that come with playing offline.
- Easy playing: In addition to the perfect graphics, we’ve made sure that our online dominoes game has simple controls and immersive play, making it perfect for all ages and levels of players. Plus, thanks to it being online, Dominoes Tour is free to play! As you align your domino tiles, you’ll feel your stress melt away.
THE DOMINO EFFECT
It starts with just one game of dominoes, and goes from there! Pretty soon you won’t want to stop as you reap rewards, compete against friends, and improve your strategic thinking skills with every game. 
This classic board game has been given an update that brings it into the modern online world, without losing that great feeling we all came to know and love as kids. Play Dominoes Tour free now to hone your skills and scale the leaderboards – victory is but a move away!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

Every dog has its own set of mini-games that you unlock with progress.
There are 3 games per pet (12 total).
Customize whole game using colors you like.
All this and more in consistent eye-candy retro style!

bluejetty:00143445:ios.name: Typology Paris - Skincare
bluejetty:00143445:ios.summary:
Typology is a French skincare brand. Formulas are designed around what matters: fewer ingredients, each chosen for a clear purpose, with no fragrance or colorant added for effect.
THE SKIN DIAGNOSTIC
The Skin Diagnostic takes about four mi
bluejetty:00143445:ios.description:
Typology is a French skincare brand. Formulas are designed around what matters: fewer ingredients, each chosen for a clear purpose, with no fragrance or colorant added for effect.
THE SKIN DIAGNOSTIC
The Skin Diagnostic takes about four minutes and identifies your skin type, concerns and sensitivities. Based on the results, the app recommends a routine and the products suited to it. The diagnostic can be retaken at any time.
OUR PRODUCTS
The range covers serums, facial oils, day and night creams, cleansers, toners, masks, sunscreen, body care and haircare, organized by ingredient rather than by category.
YOUR ORDERS
Orders can be tracked in the app from confirmation to delivery, with order history and invoices available at any time.
PERSONALISED VIDEO CONTENT
After completing the diagnostic, the app provides video content on how and when to use each recommended product.
THE LIBRARY
The Library contains articles on ingredients, active compounds and skin topics, covering the reasoning behind Typology's formulation choices.
TYPOLOGY PREMIER
Typology Premier is an annual subscription including free standard shipping with no minimum order, a 10% discount on every online order, and early access to a selection of new launches.
OUR FORMULATIONS
Formulas are built around what matters: fewer ingredients, each with a clear purpose, with no added fragrance or colorant. Most contain well above 80% naturally-derived ingredients, and several are certified organic under COSMOS Organic. The ingredient blacklist goes further than EU regulation already requires, excluding anything where safety is in doubt.
MADE IN FRANCE
Every formula is researched, developed and manufactured in France, from Typology's laboratory in Paris to partner sites around the country.
OUR COMMITMENTS
Typology is a certified B Corp. Products are vegan and cruelty-free, and packaging favors recycled and recyclable materials, including glass, aluminum and FSC-certified paper.

bluejetty:00120506:ios.name: Proloquo4Text AAC
bluejetty:00120506:ios.summary: Proloquo4Text™ is a text to speech app for those who cannot rely on their voice to speak. The app is laid out on a single screen to reduce the effort of typing. The layout enables easy, daily conversation and quick access to your most commo
bluejetty:00120506:ios.description:
Proloquo4Text™ is a text to speech app for those who cannot rely on their voice to speak. The app is laid out on a single screen to reduce the effort of typing. The layout enables easy, daily conversation and quick access to your most common phrases. Personalize it to your needs and preferences, whether that’s through choosing from the many voices available, or through customizing your screen layout. 
Proloquo4Text is the leading AAC solution for literate adults, teens and children. It is used by people with a wide range of diagnoses, including developmental disabilities (like autism, apraxia, and cerebral palsy) and acquired disorders (like laryngectomy, ALS, stroke, or traumatic brain injury). Proloquo4Text can be used to produce speech by anyone who can type and spell.
Communicate with ease
• Use the single screen for easy access to words, phrases and keyboard
• Switch easily between conversations, making it easy to answer a question in another conversation, without disrupting what you typed in the first conversation. 
• Decide when you speak with play, pause and speak-as-you-type
• Adjust appearance (font, color, text size) to your preference and needs
Reduce typing effort
• Create, save and organize commonly used phrases 
• Make typing quicker with advanced, self-learning PolyPredix™ word prediction 
• Show what you typed with the fullscreen view and flip text features 
• Type once, then say it again with history and sentence prediction
• Use keyboard shortcuts for quick access when using an external keyboard 
Choose your voice
• Download, natural-sounding voices within Proloquo4Text. All premium Acapela voices are included in Proloquo4Text with no in-app purchase.
• Add personality and humor to your conversations with free specialty voices
• Choose from over 100 voices in 18 languages, so you can find the one that sounds most like you. Switch easily between languages. 
• Use my-own-voice, a voice-banking technology, to preserve and capture the essence of your own voice in synthetic speech.
Share your world
• Send email, messages, and tweets from Proloquo4Text
• Write in Proloquo4Text and copy your text into another app
• Listen to text by pasting into Proloquo4Text
• Make phone and FaceTime video calls with Proloquo4Text.
Take your voice anywhere
• Proloquo4Text is available on both iOS and macOS. With iOS, you can use the app on your iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch. The Mac version is a separate purchase on the Mac App Store. 
• Smoothly transition between devices, thanks to Proloquo4Text’s consistent navigation on iPhone and iPad
• Easily access your commonly used phrases on Apple Watch, and just tap to show or speak them. You can customize the contents shown on the Watch from your iPhone. 
Accessibility features 
• Follow words as they are spoken with optional sentence or word highlighting
• Optimized for Switch Control and VoiceOver 
• Communicate without an internet connection
• Use multitasking functionality to run another app side-by-side on supported devices
• Keep your devices in sync by easily backing up and restoring your customizations and stored phrases. 
AssistiveWare® is the developer of Proloquo2Go®, an award-winning symbol-based communication app that provides a voice to over 200,000 individuals around the world.
Additional note:
Educational institutions can get a 50% discount if they purchase 20 or more licenses through Apple’s Volume Purchase Program for Education.

bluejetty:00042285:ios.description:
Looking for a powerful barcode scanner? Want to scan multiple barcodes and QR codes at once? Tired of annoying ads and in-app purchases? Try Barcode Scanner powered by Dynamsoft SDK right now.
Dynamsoft Barcode Scanner allows you to extract barcode information from camera video stream, screenshots and image files. It is a simple and free application developed for retail, financial, logistics, and healthcare industries. With Dynamsoft Barcode Reader SDK and Dynamsoft Camera Enhancer SDK, the application provides efficient performance for end-users and portability for developers.
Key Features:
- Supports decoding multiple barcodes in one image
- Reads barcodes from different orientations and positions
- Reads barcodes without a quiet zone
- Supports barcode decoding for passports, ID cards, driver’s license, boxes, VIN (Vehicle Identification Number) on vehicles, High-Density QR Code, DPM codes, etc
- Flexible and user-friendly settings
- No annoying ads and in-app purchases

- 2D: QR Code (including Micro QR Code), Data Matrix, PDF417 (including Micro PDF417), Aztec Code, MaxiCode (mode 2-5), DotCode
- Patch Code
- GS1 Composite Code
- GS1 DataBar (Omnidirectional, Truncated, Stacked, Stacked Omnidirectional, Limited, Expanded, Expanded Stacked)
- Postal Codes: USPS Intelligent Mail, Postnet, Planet, Australian Post, UK Royal Mail

- Premium Tech Support - Bronze Stevie® Award
- ComponentSource Top 25 Publisher for 2019

bluejetty:00022993:ios.description:
This app is a great mobile app for creating unique looks for your characters from the game universe.
Forget about boring, gray models and immerse yourself in the virtual world of your own creativity! Now you have the opportunity to make your dreams come true and completely transform your characters. Start from scratch or pick from hundreds of pre-made templates!
~~~ Features ~~~
– Hundreds of clothing templates;
– A wide variety of bright textures and stickers;
– Easy and intuitive 3D preview mode;
– Import your designs directly to the mobile version of the game.
~ 3D outfit editor for your skin ~
Create your look in 3D with ease! Use all necessary tools to make original clothes for game characters in a few clicks. Color your appearance with a brush and use the eraser to turn pixels to their original color. And the undo and redo functions allow you to revert and repeat any recent changes you made.
~ Multiple-layer system ~
This system will allow you to work on multiple layers while creating the style of your avatar. Use the first layer to fill your outfit with a single color or texture, the second – to design your look in your own way, and the third – to add some emotions with bright stickers. Let your fantasy run wild!
~ Use an extensive template gallery ~
Stand out among other players! In our app you will find a library with hundreds of amazing template options to create your own appearance. Choose the template you want and use the tools you need to edit the look you've created, then add cool textures and stickers to add even more creativity and color to your work. Turn a gray silhouette into a bright and beautiful look!
~ View avatars in 3D ~
Use the convenient 3D view mode to see your unique skin style directly on the character model. Try to look at the character from different angles, you may want to make changes.
~ Import your designs to the game ~
In our application, detailed instructions are available for transferring the images you created directly into the game.
~ Export character for PC version ~
Create the clothes for your avatars and use them for both the mobile version and the standard PC versions, because our app conveniently allows you to save your designs in PNG format.
Put aside doubts! Download our app and design the perfect look for your character!
ATTENTION:
1. You need an internet connection to download the content!
2. To download materials correctly, you will need to have the official mobile version of the game on your device!

bluejetty:00186963:ios.description:
The AASTMT Student Portal app is an innovative and comprehensive academic tool designed for students of the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport. With its range of features, the app has quickly become an essential resource for students looking to enhance their academic performance and streamline their academic experience.
One of the most significant advantages of the AASTMT Student Portal app is its ability to provide students with easy access to their academic results, schedules, and attendance records. These features allow students to track their academic progress and ensure they stay on top of their coursework.
Moreover, the app provides students with access to course news and updates, enabling them to stay informed about any changes or updates related to their academic program. Students can also communicate with their professors directly through the app's private messaging feature, promoting collaboration and engagement within the academic community.
Another standout feature of the AASTMT Student Portal app is its integration with Moodle, a popular online learning platform. By integrating with Moodle, the app allows students to access course content, quizzes, and other resources directly through the app, making it easier for students to keep up with their coursework.
The app's secure QR code-based student identity system is another valuable feature. This system eliminates the need for physical identification cards, reducing the risk of identity theft and improving campus security. The system also allows students to access campus services and facilities with ease, such as libraries, labs, and sports centers.
Additionally, the AASTMT Student Portal app enables students to receive announcements from the Head of Department and Dean. This feature ensures that students are always up to date on the latest developments in their academic program, promoting transparency and accountability within the academic department.
In conclusion, the AASTMT Student Portal app is a valuable academic tool for students at the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport. With its range of features, the app enables students to streamline their academic experience, enhance their academic performance, and stay connected with their academic community. If you are a student at AASTMT, we highly recommend downloading the AASTMT Student Portal app today and taking advantage of its numerous benefits.

bluejetty:00114357:ios.description:
AI Interior Design Assistant - Redesign Your Home in One Click
Simply snap a photo, select your preferred style, and watch AI instantly redesign your space. Whether you're planning a quick room refresh or a full renovation, Roomera AI helps you generate complete interior design ideas in seconds. Beyond design, Roomera AI also helps you discover real furniture and decor inspired by your AI-generated spaces, making it easier to turn inspiration into a practical home setup.
Key Features
AI Interior Design
Upload a photo of your room and instantly generate a new interior design with AI. Explore different styles, layouts, and color palettes to visualize how your living room, bedroom, kitchen, or workspace could look after renovation. Compare design ideas before making real changes to your home.
Find Products from Your Design
Love the look of your redesigned space? Instantly discover furniture and decor inspired by your AI-generated design. Browse recommended products and access convenient links to explore real items that match your style and space.
AI Exterior Design
Redesign the exterior of your home with AI-powered visualization. Upload a photo of your house and explore fresh ideas for facades, materials, and outdoor styles. Instantly see how your home could look with different architectural styles and exterior renovations. 
AI Garden Design
Upload photos of your yard, patio, or outdoor space and let AI generate personalized garden designs. Explore different landscaping styles, plant arrangements, pathways, and outdoor seating ideas to create the perfect garden environment.
Style Transfer
Apply the style from inspiring reference images directly to your own space. Simply upload a style image and a photo of your room to transform the overall look and atmosphere of your space.
Wall & Floor Replacement
Experiment with different wall textures, paint colors, and flooring materials. Instantly preview how new walls or floors would transform your room without any real renovation.
Local Editing
Make targeted changes to specific areas of your image. Replace furniture, adjust details, or redesign selected elements while keeping the rest of the space unchanged.
Start Designing Today
Download Roomera AI, try the basic model free, upgrade to Pro when you need perfection. Your dream interior is just one photo away！

The FlowGarage App at a glance:
• Add all your cars to your FlowGarage Account
• Schedule your next Service Appointment in minutes
• View your Sales and Service History in one place
• Find out what your car is worth with Flow Offer to Purchase and receive a real offer on your vehicle
• Find the nearest Flow Dealership ( 10 Cities | 45 Locations)
• Receive live updates during your service visit
• Organize your vehicle documents with the FlowGarage wallet
• Receive and manage your vehicles’ recalls from your fingertips
Find out how FlowGarage makes owning your cars(s) EASY. TRANSPARENT. FUN.
FLOWGARAGE
Store details of all the cars you own in one place.
SALES and SERVICE HISTORY
Track the sales and service history of your cars in your Flow Garage.
FLOW OFFER TO PURCHASE
Receive a real offer for your car in minutes. All you need is your license plate or VIN#.
FLOW REWARDS - COMING SOON
Earn points redeemable for discounts on future service visits.
VEHICLE RECALLS
Receive up-to-date recall notifications for your car.
SCHEDULE SERVICE APPOINTMENT
Schedule your next service appointment with a Flow certified service technician.
FLOWGARAGE WALLET
Organize your vehicle documents in one place.
SERVICE VISIT UPDATES
Receive live updates during your service visit. View your visit status, personalized service recommendations, and videos of your car in service.
FLOW LOCATIONS
Locate and view hours for any of our 45 dealerships in the 10 cities we service.
Download the FLOWGARAGE APP now and experience how Flow can be easy, transparent and fun.

bluejetty:00068220:ios.name: AI App Builder Appy Pie
bluejetty:00068220:ios.summary:
Describe the app you want, and AI builds it for you. In about a minute, AI turns a sentence or two into a native mobile app - it plans the pages, writes the content and lays out every screen around your idea.
Everything behind your app co
bluejetty:00068220:ios.description:
Describe the app you want, and AI builds it for you. In about a minute, AI turns a sentence or two into a native mobile app - it plans the pages, writes the content and lays out every screen around your idea.
Everything behind your app comes ready too. The backend, database and hosting are built in, so there are no servers to rent, no databases to configure and no third-party services to connect. Describe it, and it's ready to test on your phone.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with Apple.
2. Describe your app in a sentence or two - a restaurant ordering app, a booking app for your studio, a community app for your club.
3. Subscribe for that app. One App Store subscription covers one app, and you can build and pay for up to five apps here.
4. AI builds it. Your app's pages and content are generated from your description in about a minute.
5. Test it on your phone. Tap "Test your app" to open your app in App Test Lab, our free companion app on the App Store.
WHAT YOU GET
- A native mobile app created by AI from your description, with its pages and content written for you
- Backend, database and hosting included - nothing to install, configure or maintain
- The same account on appypie.com, where you can keep refining your app in the full Appy Pie builder and publish it to the app stores
- Restore your purchases on a new phone, and manage your apps and account from the avatar menu
PRICING
Each app is a monthly auto-renewing subscription billed to your Apple ID. The price is shown in the app before you subscribe, and you can cancel anytime in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.
WHO IT'S FOR
Anyone with an app idea and the ambition to launch it - a business of one or a company of thousands. If you can describe it, AI can build it.
- Startup founders: launch your product as a real native app, put it in front of users and show investors something they can hold, before you hire a development team.
- Restaurants, cafes, bakeries and food trucks: put your menu, specials, hours and location in your customers' pockets and keep them coming back.
- Salons, spas, studios, gyms and personal trainers: give clients your services, class schedules and prices in an app with your brand on it.
- Retailers and online stores: show off your products, launch offers and stay one tap away from your customers.
- Real estate agents and property managers: present listings, neighborhoods and contact details in an app clients keep on their phone.
- Clinics, dentists and wellness practices: share your services, team, hours and appointment details with patients.
- Teachers, tutors, schools and course creators: bring lessons, schedules, resources and announcements into one app for students and parents.
- Creators, podcasters and influencers: build a home for your audience that you own, beyond any single social platform.
- Churches, clubs, nonprofits and associations: keep members connected with events, news and updates.
- Event, conference and festival organizers: put the agenda, speakers, venue details and announcements in one app.
- Hotels, travel and tourism businesses: give guests a digital guide to your property, your services and the best local spots.

bluejetty:00031012:ios.description:
Counting your cash has never been easier.
If you’re a cashier, doing the count again and again is time-consuming. Cash Counter helps you total bills and coins fast with a calculator built for real cash counting accuracy.
Count coins and notes with a simple tap, or enter the amount directly to get an instant total. Perfect for end-of-shift balancing, quick drawer checks, and when you just need a reliable number in seconds.
FEATURES
• Count Coins and Notes
Tap to tally each denomination and build your total accurately, or enter the amounts directly.
• Copy and Clear
Copy the grand total to paste into your reports, messages, or spreadsheets. Clear all denominations instantly to start the next count.
• Many Currencies
Works with multiple currencies, including USD, EUR, GPB, and more.
• Widgets
View your current grand total right from your home screen and lock screen. Jump into the app anytime to keep counting.
• Multi-Device Sync
Your counters sync across your devices using iCloud, including iPhone, iPad, and Apple Watch, so you can continue where you left off.
PRO FEATURES
Some Pro features require a paid subscription.
• Multiple Counters
Create multiple counters for different drawers, days, or people.
• Summary
Get a full overview of notes and coins, plus the grand total amount.
• Export
Export your counts to CSV or text, then share or save to your files.
OTHER

bluejetty:00020995:ios.name: Slow Eats for Weight Loss
bluejetty:00020995:ios.summary:
*Apple Watch not required, works for iPhone or Apple Watch*
Slow Eats is a timer app designed to help you slow down and stay mindful during meals, fostering a healthier connection with food and supporting weight loss. With its simple funct
bluejetty:00020995:ios.description:
*Apple Watch not required, works for iPhone or Apple Watch*
Slow Eats is a timer app designed to help you slow down and stay mindful during meals, fostering a healthier connection with food and supporting weight loss. With its simple functionality and clean design, Slow Eats offers a user-friendly experience that is both easy to navigate and highly effective. 
Slow Eats works in the background which means you can set your timer and then keep your phone in your pocket for the rest of the meal while it discreetly vibrates you to alert you when to eat or take a break. 
Slow Eats works with just your iPhone or you can download the Apple Watch app for an even more low-profile and seamless experience. 
Eating slowly has many possible benefits:
 ● Promotes weight loss by giving your brain more time to receive fullness signals
 ● Helps you better absorb the nutrients in your food
 ● Improves digestion
 ● Makes you feel calmer and more in control
 ● Increases your enjoyment of food
Choose between three types of timers:
 ● Bite Timer: Slow down how fast you eat by creating a set pause between each bite.
 ● Meal Timer: Slow down how fast you eat by defining set eating and break windows during your meal.
 ● Seconds Timer: Create a mindful pause before you get more. Give yourself time to feel full before deciding you need more.
______________________________________
~ What users are saying about the app ~
"I’ve never written an app review before, but I need to write one for this app. I got an Apple Watch and was determined to use it to lose weight. Between closing my rings and using this app, I have lost over 25 lbs. Even more important than any one accomplishment: it helped heal my unhealthy relationship with food."
"I eat way too fast. I get hungry and just smash my dinner every day and then often feel bad from over eating. This app is exactly what I was looking for. It’s simple, it’s easy to use, and it works. I love how I don’t have to watch a timer I just wait for the tap on my wrist. I’m already building healthier eating habits by using this app. THANK YOU!!"
"Have been trying to slow down and be able to better listen to my fullness cues when I eat! This watch app does the trick!"
"I tell anyone who will listen how much I love this app. I have the icon on my watch face and I use it for every meal and snack. So easy to use and it has helped me so much as I’ve been trying to slow down while eating. Another bonus is that the developers are so responsive and helpful! Hands down my favorite app!"
"I enjoyed dinner tonight utilizing the bite timer. It was amazing how quickly I got full and how easy it was to stop when I was comfortable and not when I had pushed my pouch to its limit and felt sick for an hour or so as I have in the past. Just bringing my awareness to how I was eating has me starting out from a great place as I try to lose my regain."
_______________________________________
Start building a healthier relationship with food today by simply slowing down.
Learn More:
- https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/eating-slowly-and-weight-loss#thorough-chewing
- https://www.healthline.com/nutrition/mindful-eating-guide

bluejetty:00083934:ios.description:
Paraphrase AI – Smart AI Writing & Rewriting Assistant
Paraphrase AI is an all-in-one AI writing assistant that helps you rewrite, paraphrase, summarize, and improve any text instantly. Whether you’re writing essays, emails, reports, or social media posts, this AI-powered tool transforms your words into clearer, more natural writing in seconds.
Designed for students, writers, professionals, and content creators, the app helps you produce polished, human-sounding content without spending hours editing.
What is Paraphrase AI?
Paraphrase AI is a productivity app that rewrites text while preserving its original meaning, improves tone, and helps users create better writing faster using artificial intelligence.
You can paste any text or use voice-to-text and instantly generate improved versions tailored to different styles and writing needs.
What can you do with Paraphrase AI?
1. PARAPHRASE AND REWRITE TEXT
Instantly rewrite sentences, paragraphs, or full documents while keeping the original meaning intact.
2. HUMANIZE AI-GENERATED CONTENT
Convert robotic AI text into natural, human-like writing suitable for essays, emails, and professional communication.
3. VOICE-TO-TEXT WRITING ASSISTANT
Use built-in voice typing to speak your ideas instead of typing. The app converts speech in your native language into text and instantly improves or paraphrases it in English, making writing faster and more convenient.
4. SUMMARIZE LONG CONTENT
Turn lengthy articles, research papers, or reports into clear summaries and key takeaways in seconds.
5. ADJUST TONE AND WRITING STYLE
Choose from multiple writing styles such as:
- Professional
- Academic
- Casual
- Friendly
- Conversational
- Funny
- …and many more
This makes it easy to adapt content for different audiences.
5. IMPROVE CLARITY AND GRAMMAR
Enhance readability, fix awkward phrasing, and produce more polished writing.
Who should use this app?
STUDENTS
- Rewrite essays and assignments
- Summarize research material
CONTENT CREATORS & MARKETERS
- Repurpose blog posts
- Rewrite social media captions
PROFESSIONALS
- Improve emails and reports
- Create polished business communication
WRITERS
- Generate alternative wording and ideas quickly
ChatGPT vs Paraphrase AI
Why choose Paraphrase AI?
- AI-powered rewriting engine
- Multiple writing tones and styles
- Fast paraphrasing results
- Simple and intuitive interface
- Perfect for essays, emails, and reports
- Helps create natural, human-sounding writing
The app is designed to make writing clearer, faster, and more effective, allowing users to focus on their ideas instead of editing.
How to use Paraphrase AI?
- Paste or type your text or use voice-to-text
- Select a writing tone or style
- Instantly generate a rewritten version
Within seconds, you get a clearer, improved version of your content ready to use.
Subscription and Terms
When you download the app you can opt into a 7-day free trial, Paraphrase AI offers auto-renewing monthly/yearly/weekly subscription options for access to the app's features and content. Your subscription will automatically renew at the end of each term and payment will be charged through your iTunes account. You can turn off auto-renew at any time from your iTunes account settings but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. To avoid renewal, you must cancel at least 24 hours before your subscription or trial ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited if you purchase a subscription.
Terms of Use: https://appmasters.com/terms/

bluejetty:00023382:ios.description:
Looking for new car racing games?
Car games that will not bore you after 2-3 minutes and offer multiple driving game modes?
Welcome to Traffic Tour, a new endless arcade racing game that takes you to another level of smooth driving simulation games and high graphic quality.
Instead of offering you just traffic rider driving with an exciting traffic run, our dead race car game differs from the similar highway rider car racing games by offering you multiple game modes, including multiplayer highway racing with friends and other Traffic Tour traffic racers.
Drive your car on the endless highway roads, overtake traffic in challenging career missions, collect blueprints, unlock new cars, upgrade them, and challenge your friends in real-time racing with different camera modes to give you a unique driving experience. Our car racing game 3d offers it all, from exciting street racing, to relaxing free run highway driving with regular car traffic.
►5 IN 1 CAR RACING
Compared to the new auto racing games that offer one category of road racing, we give you tons of options to choose from. Start with the career racing mode and become the best traffic racer. Collect blueprints, complete missions, and upgrade your car’s speed, handling, wheels. Additionally, unlock super-fast cars and other types of vehicles.
For relaxing driving during your commute or chill leisure time try the time trial or free run in different fast racing environments. Our good racing game can offer truly indulging CSR racing.
When you want more excitement with car traffic driving, go on the Endless mode, and collect blueprints while avoiding crushes. But that’s not it, the most exciting is our racing multiplayer mode described below.
►CASH QUEST (United States only)
- Race in Cash Quest mode and collect WZCoins after every level
- Reach the cash-out goal and redeem for Amazon gift cards or bitcoin through ZBD, a licensed rewards partner
- Requires an Internet connection and a ZBD account
►REAL-TIME MULTIPLAYER RACING (PVP)
Sometimes it is not about how good a traffic racer you think you are. Sometimes you need to prove it in real racing competitions online. Try the super-thrilling Traffic Tour racing battles:
- Choose your best sports car and challenge other players in a real-time
- Join 100 different online missions and get prizes by beating your opponents
- Send requests and challenge your friends with an exciting traffic race
►KEY FEATURES
- Unlimited play - No fuel or time limits
- Different camera modes: first person, third person, driver camera, and more
- Multiple control modes: tilt, buttons, or steering wheel
- 5 gameplay modes: Multiplayer, Endless, Career, Time Trial, Free Run
- 100 missions in career mode
- 5 realistic environments: Highway, City, Desert, Rain and snow with a day or night times
- Our customize car game features give you 40+ different cars with the ability to customize colors and wheels
- Unlock cars by collecting or buying blueprints
- Upgrade cars features: Speed, Handling, and Brakes
- Variety of traffic vehicles: Trucks, Buses, Vans, Pickups, SUVs
- Multiplayer racing, challenging friends, and players from all around the world.
- Ability to use the Nitrous feature in multiplayer mode
- Smooth and realistic driving
===
TIPS
- Unlock new cars by collecting more Blueprints in endless mode
- When driving over 100 km/h, try to overtake traffic cars to get bonus scores and cash
- Get extra cash when playing evening and night in endless mode
- Driving in opposite direction in two-way gives extra score and cash
- Use Nitrous in the right time in multiplayer mode to get the most out of it
- Share your results with friends to get extra cash
This game requires a persistent Internet connection (network fees may apply)

https://twitter.com/TrafficTour
https://www.instagram.com/traffictour/
https://www.youtube.com/c/Wolvesinteractive
http://www.wolvesinteractive.com/legal/term-of-use

bluejetty:00068955:ios.description:
Stay informed without losing sanity. A feed curated by you, not the social-media mob.
with feeeed, you can build your own ad-free news feed, on your own terms:
• subscribe to any website and get the latest stories in your feed
• view articles in a fast, focused, customizable reader mode 
• see local weather, flashbacks from your photo library or birthdays from your contacts
• no ads or purchases
• free ai summaries of articles
• offline mode: download dozens of stories to read when you're offline
• subscribe to communities from reddit, youtube channels, tiktok profiles, mastodon or threads accounts
• add your own custom reminders, or flashcards
• see your step count for the day, and your progress towards 10k steps. (powered by an optional integration with the Health)
• browse a curated catalog of suggested news feeds for any topic
• full dark mode, including auto-dark mode for any site
• a built-in chatbot that can recommend feeds and channels for any topic
• customize your app icon, tab bar, algorithm and more
• see news on your homescreen with a customizable widget
• create and share lists of feeds
• groups feeds into folders and pin your favorite folders to the tab bar for one-tap access
• a lot more!
it's 100% private and on-device (no servers, no accounts, nothing leaves your device). don't worry — it's still as fast, smooth and addicting as your favorite Mark Zuckerberg app. it includes a built-in reader mode and reading list. it's fast!
take back your news feed ~ scroll on your own terms :)

bluejetty:00138831:android.summary:
Introducing Cloud AI, your ultimate companion for enhanced productivity and seamless communication. Let's explore the standout features that set Cloud AI apart:
Advanced AI Assistance:
Cloud AI harnesses the cutting-edge Claude 3.5 Sonnet
bluejetty:00138831:android.description:
Introducing Cloud AI, your ultimate companion for enhanced productivity and seamless communication. Let's explore the standout features that set Cloud AI apart:
Advanced AI Assistance:
Cloud AI harnesses the cutting-edge Claude 3.5 Sonnet API to provide you with unparalleled AI assistance. Engage in dynamic conversations, brainstorm ideas effortlessly, and obtain instant answers to your queries, all with the power of advanced artificial intelligence.
Hands-Free Voice Input:
Stay productive on the go with Cloud AI's voice input feature. Dictate your messages effortlessly, and witness them materialize on your screen in real-time, offering unmatched convenience and efficiency.
Insightful Document and Image Analysis:
Gain valuable insights from documents and images with Cloud AI's analysis feature. Simply upload your files and receive comprehensive analysis and answers tailored to your content.
Video and Webpage Summarization:
Effortlessly summarize videos and webpages with Cloud AI. Obtain concise overviews of content without the need to watch or read through the entire material.
Effortless Writing Support:
Say farewell to writer's block with Cloud AI's intuitive writing support. Whether you're crafting emails, articles, or social media posts, Cloud AI offers lightning-fast, plagiarism-free content generation, empowering you to express yourself with ease.
Concise Summarization:
Streamline your reading experience with Cloud AI's summarization feature. Instantly condense lengthy texts into digestible summaries, enabling you to grasp key information quickly and efficiently.
Seamless Translation:
Break language barriers effortlessly with Cloud AI's real-time translation capabilities. Powered by Claude 3 API, translate content accurately across multiple languages, facilitating global communication and expanding your reach.
Creative Paraphrasing:
Ensure your content remains unique and engaging with Cloud AI's paraphrasing tool. Discover creative alternatives while retaining the essence of your message, effortlessly enhancing your communication.
Precision Grammar Check:
Elevate your writing to new heights with Cloud AI's grammar check feature. Detect and rectify grammar mistakes swiftly, ensuring your content maintains clarity, professionalism, and coherence.
Experience the future of productivity and communication with Cloud AI. You can connect with a diverse range of personas, which are crafted to guide, inspire and entertain you. Exciting personas of Cloud AI are:
1) Content Creator Assistant: You can spark your creativity and craft compelling content with expert strategies.
2) Gift Advisor: Find gift ideas for every occasion with personalized recommendations.
3) Fitness Buddy: Achieve your health goals with daily workout guidance and fitness tips.
4) Travel Guide: Uncover the wonders of the world with bespoke travel insights and recommendations.
5) Study Companion: Elevate your learning experience with best study tips and educational resources.
6) Cooking Companion: Explore the art of cooking with new recipes and culinary tips to enhance your skills.
7) Financial Advisor: Navigate the complexities of personal finance and investments with ease.
8) Meditation Guide: Find your inner peace with mindfulness and relaxation techniques.
9) Dating Advisor: Discover the secrets to successful dating with tips and advice.
10) Career Assistant: Propel your career forward with customized job search advice and resources.

bluejetty:00000542:ios.description:
Are you looking for a fun and challenging game? Experience the best bubble shooter game with over 5,000 levels. Join to pop now.
Farm Bubbles is easy to play, extremely fun and requires no special skills to play. In the relaxing farm atmosphere of Farm Bubbles, all you have to do is rescue trapped cute farm animals. And how? You need to match at least three bubbles of the same color to burst them and remove them from the board. But remember that you only have a limited number of moves at each level, so you have to make smart moves. Keep popping the bubbles until you run out and experience the challenge of achieving a three-star rating in each level.
Please remember that levels get harder as you progress in the game, and these are the times for boosters. Use them at the right moment, because they can help you solve the puzzle.
Farm Bubbles is the best pastime with its special effects and colorful images that appeal to all ages. Stay tuned for upcoming challenges and fun new levels.
Now it's time to match, pop and rescue all the beautiful animals.

• View leave balance 
Attendance

Payroll

• View/contribute to employee feeds

PULS 24 – Always stay informed!
Austria's news app with all the latest information around the clock.
The PULS 24 app presents all relevant news and events of the day in a modern and unique way, packaged in an innovative and free app with videos, surveys on cutting-edge topics and AI-based summaries. Get the latest news and breaking news on your smartphone!
Always receive all the latest news on the top topics that affect Austria and the world. The PULS 24 app offers you comprehensive and reliable reporting including the fastest push notifications on breaking news.
These are the top features of the PULS 24 app:
+ Don't miss anything on the go with the 24/7 live stream! Follow current events with the PULS 24 live stream for precise information on the pulse of the times as well as breaking news whenever it is important
+ PULS 24 Top News: The latest and selected top news from Austria and the world can be found directly below the live stream. + AI news reports from all over the world: the PULS 24 app is rounded off by AI-based news from the best news sources at home and abroad, which are prepared with the most important facts in the form of 3-6 bullet points.
+ With the PULS 24 media library you always have all interviews, news and documentaries from the past at your fingertips.
+ PULS 24 surveys: Share your opinion with us and vote in the latest surveys.
+ PULS 24 Podcast: Listen to your favorite shows as a podcast!
Enable push notifications to never miss anything.
Download now!

bluejetty:00042407:ios.description:
Host and manage all your events, networking, and conversations on EKOS.AI. Meet your new teammates, coworkers, event attendees, community members, investors, and mentors seamlessly with AI-powered networking.
Simply tell us what your networking goals, interests, hobbies, and roles are and our AI will connect you with the right people locally or even across the world! EKOS.AI helps your employees, community members, and event attendees feel more connected.
Remove the countless cold calls, emails, and introductions from your workflow, and use EKOS.AI to create the network that matters to you.
Sign-up is easy! Join as a part of a community or company space or as an individual.
Make Meaningful Connections:
AI-Powered Matchmaking and Networking
Set up calls and meet in seconds to collaborate
1:1 and Groups Calls and Messaging
Create or attend In-person and Virtual Events
Experience Real-time Networking pre, post and during live events
Post announcements and share updates with your members
Meeting the right people can help you feel more connected to your communities. Make your connections count with EKOS.AI.

 اپنے پروفائل کا منفرد نام یا تخلیقی عبارت کسی بھی سوشل میڈیا ایپ پر Kaaf کی بورڈ سے آسانی سے لکھیں۔
اب اردو اور پشتو کی بورڈز کی مکمل سپورٹ
 بہتر اور جدید یوزر انٹرفیس ڈیزائن
 روزمرہ کاموں کو آسان بنانے کے لیے اسٹوریز میں نئی تخلیقی ایپس کو ہائی لائٹ کیا گیا ہے
استعمال کی مثالیں:
انسٹاگرام پروفائل اور بائیو
انسٹاگرام کی کہانیاں، جھلکیاں اور کمنٹس
اسنیپ چیٹ پروفائلز
ٹویٹر بائیو، پوسٹس اور ریپلائیز
واٹس ایپ پروفائل، بائیو، اسٹوری اور چیٹس
ٹک ٹاک
نوٹس ایپ
تمام فوٹو ایڈیٹنگ اور ڈیزائن ایپس
Kaaf ہر اس ایپ میں کام کرتا ہے جہاں آپ لکھ سکتے ہیں۔
ایپ عربی، فارسی، اردو اور پشتو زبانوں کو سپورٹ کرتی ہے۔
سبسکرپشن کی معلومات:
 تصدیق کے بعد iTunes اکاؤنٹ سے چارج کیا جائے گا۔ سبسکرپشن خودکار طور پر تجدید ہوتی ہے جب تک کہ 24 گھنٹے پہلے بند نہ کی جائے۔ سیٹنگز سے سبسکرپشن کا انتظام کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ اگر مفت آزمائشی مدت دی گئی ہو تو، خریداری کے بعد وہ ختم ہو جائے گی۔

bluejetty:00182916:ios.description:
A new mobile "Fate RPG," presented by TYPE-MOON!
With an impressive main scenario and multiple character quests, 
the game features millions of words of original story!
Packed with content that both fans of the Fate franchise and newcomers will be able to enjoy.
Summary
2017 A.D. 
Chaldea, an organization tasked with observing Earth's future, has confirmed that human history will be eliminated at 2019. 
Without warning, the promised future of 2017 disappeared.
Why? How? Who? By what means?
AD. 2004. A certain provincial town in Japan.
For the first time ever, a region that could not be observed appeared.
Assuming that this was the cause of humanity’s extinction, Chaldea carried out its sixth experiment - time travel into the past.
A forbidden ceremony where they would convert humans into Spiritrons and send them back in time. By intervening in events, they would locate, identify, and destroy the space-time Singularities.
The mission classification is an order to protect Humanity: Grand Order.
This is the title for those who would take a stand against human history and battle fate in order to protect mankind.
Game Introduction
A command card battle RPG optimized for smart phones! 
Players become Masters and together with Heroic Spirits, defeat enemies and solve the mystery of human history's disappearance. 
It's up the players to form a party with their favorite Heroic Spirits - both new and old. 
Game Composition/Scenario Direction
Kinoko Nasu
Character Design/Art Direction
Takashi Takeuchi
Scenario Writers
Yuichiro Higashide, Hikaru Sakurai
Required operating system: OS compatible with iOS 10.0 or higher.
Enabled devices: iPhone 5 and higher, iPad 3rd generation and higher, iPad Mini 2 and higher, iPod touch 6th generation
*Please confirm system requirements on home page instead of from the App Store compatibility.
*Incompatible with iPod touch 5th generation and lower, iPhone 4S and lower.
This application uses "CRIWARE (TM)" from CRI Middleware Co. Ltd.

bluejetty:00021521:ios.description:
здесь всё, что связано со связью — и больше. баланс, eSIM, виртуальный номер, тарифы, роуминг, расходы, смс, семейные группы, нейросети и круглосуточная поддержка — всё на месте
управляйте связью так, как удобно именно вам:
— пополняйте баланс номера и оплачивайте покупки
— подключайте есим Россия за несколько минут
— покупайте сим-карты или esim для близких и умных устройств
— меняйте тариф, добавляйте ГБ, минуты на звонки, SMS и безлимит на интернет

— проверяйте расходы и скачивайте детализацию

пробуйте — всё покорится вашей фантазии прямо на главном экране приложения
и вообще, мы любим, когда всё нужное оказывается под рукой — поэтому создаём не личный кабинет, а вашего личного ассистента. так мы выводим цифровую заботу о себе на новый уровень

bluejetty:00177409:ios.description:
Try yourself as a prison warden. You start with a small prison made of just a few barracks, and only you decide how it will grow.
Maintain order to prevent fights, manage the economy and constantly make sure hunger riots never begin.
But that’s not all. In this prison simulator, you must constantly balance between greedy officials focused on profit, mafia bosses running shady deals, and inmates who only dream of getting out as soon as possible.
Every decision has consequences: increase security and inmate dissatisfaction will rise; make a deal with the mafia and risk losing government trust. Develop infrastructure, open new cell blocks, improve living conditions, hire staff and set the rules behind prison walls.
Can you maintain the fragile balance of power, prevent riots and turn a rundown prison into an efficient and profitable correctional facility? The choice is yours.
For any questions, contact us at: support@appscraft.am
