bluejetty:00135425:ios.name: Plus42
bluejetty:00135425:ios.summary: Plus42 is an advanced scientific programmable calculator, based on Free42. Free42, in turn, is a complete re-implementation of the HP-42S scientific programmable RPN calculator, which was made from 1988 until 1995 by Hewlett-Packard. Free42
bluejetty:00135425:ios.description:
Plus42 is an advanced scientific programmable calculator, based on Free42. Free42, in turn, is a complete re-implementation of the HP-42S scientific programmable RPN calculator, which was made from 1988 until 1995 by Hewlett-Packard. Free42 is a complete rewrite and contains no HP code whatsoever.
Plus42 builds on Free42 and adds: Algebraic expressions modeled after those used on the HP-27S and HP-17B/19B; attached units and unit conversions modeled after those used on the HP-48/49/50 series; directories for more organized storage of programs and variables; a larger display, with 8 rows and 22 columns (131x64 pixels) by default, which the user may resize at will; time value of money and amortization schedules; and two-dimensional plotting of functions, with ability to zoom and pan, and find integrals and roots from points in the plot.

bluejetty:00140209:ios.name: Relief: Get out of debt
bluejetty:00140209:ios.summary:
Relief is for people dealing with debt collectors — not just debt. Credit cards, personal loans, and some medical debt. If collectors are calling, sending letters, or threatening action, this is the app for that moment.
SILENCE THE CALLS
bluejetty:00140209:ios.description:
Relief is for people dealing with debt collectors — not just debt. Credit cards, personal loans, and some medical debt. If collectors are calling, sending letters, or threatening action, this is the app for that moment.
SILENCE THE CALLS
Relief drafts and delivers cease & desist letters to your collectors. Under the FDCPA, collectors may be required to stop certain communications after receiving your request. No confrontation. Just your rights in action.
CATCH COLLECTOR VIOLATIONS
Collector contacts may matter. Log calls, texts, and letters in the app and Relief helps identify potential FDCPA violations that may strengthen your position.
RESPOND TO LAWSUITS
Served with a debt collection lawsuit? Relief helps you understand response options, filing deadlines, and next steps so you're not caught off guard.
ASK THE AI DEBT ADVISOR
Not sure what to do next? Ask Relief’s AI Debt Advisor questions about collections, settlement offers, lawsuits, collector communication, and debt options. Get guidance based on your situation before moving forward.
SETTLE WHEN YOU'RE READY
When you're ready to resolve, Relief helps you understand available options and request savings on your terms.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add your debt accounts and start monitoring
2. Cease & desist letters are drafted and delivered
3. Log collector contacts and track potential violations
4. Explore your available resolution options
YOUR MEMBERSHIP
One flat monthly membership. Support starts from day one.
FAQ
What is the FDCPA? The Fair Debt Collection Practices Act is a federal law that limits how debt collectors can communicate and collect. Relief is designed to help users understand and act on those protections.
Will this affect my credit score? Relief uses a soft pull only. No credit impact to get started.*
Who is Relief for? People dealing with unsecured debt in collections (90+ days overdue). Eligibility requirements apply.
KEY FEATURES
• Cease & desist letter generation and delivery
• Collector contact logging and monitoring
• FDCPA education and violation tracking
• Lawsuit response guidance
• AI Debt Advisor
• Debt reduction support
• Secure member dashboard
• Welcome call with rights overview
DISCLOSURES
Relief is not a law firm and does not provide legal, financial, tax, or credit advice.
The AI Debt Advisor provides informational guidance only and may not reflect all available options.
Cease & desist requests and collector protections depend on applicable law and may not stop all communications.
Potential collector violations identified in the app do not guarantee compensation or legal outcomes.
Debt reduction estimates are not guaranteed. Results vary by creditor, account status, eligibility, and user circumstances. Creditor review may take up to 60 days or longer.
Soft credit checks do not impact your credit score. If you enter into and complete an agreed debt reduction arrangement, creditors may report the account as settled for less than the full balance.

bluejetty:00114362:ios.description:
TrackCal AI - Your Smart Nutrition Companion
Transform the way you track your nutrition with TrackCal AI, the most advanced AI-powered calorie and macro tracking app. Simply scan your food, and our intelligent system instantly recognizes what you're eating and calculates accurate nutritional information.
KEY FEATURES:
AI-Powered Food Recognition
Take a photo of any meal, and our advanced AI instantly identifies ingredients, portions, and nutritional values. Our cutting-edge technology analyzes food photos in seconds, providing accurate calorie counts and macro breakdowns. Works with prepared meals, packaged foods, and ingredients.
Complete Macro Tracking
Track calories, protein, carbs, and fats with precision. Set personalized goals based on your body type, activity level, and health objectives. Visualize your journey with charts and progress indicators tracking daily macros and long-term progress.
Smart Photo Analysis
Our advanced AI technology analyzes food photos instantly, providing accurate nutritional data. Simply point and shoot - our system recognizes portion sizes, cooking methods, and ingredients automatically.
Text Input Analysis
Describe what you ate in plain English, and our AI understands natural language to log your meals accurately. Just type "I had 2 eggs and toast" and we'll handle the rest. No need to search through databases or calculate manually.
AI Recipe Generation
Get personalized recipe suggestions powered by artificial intelligence. Our AI analyzes ingredients in your pantry and generates custom recipes tailored to your dietary preferences, macro goals, and available ingredients. Reduce food waste and discover new meal ideas based on what you already have.
AI Inventory Tracking
Keep track of ingredients in your pantry with intelligent inventory management. Our AI recognizes food items from photos, tracks expiration dates, and helps you organize your kitchen. Get smart suggestions for recipes based on your current inventory, making meal planning effortless.
Progress Screen and Analytics
Comprehensive progress tracking with detailed analytics and visualizations. View your nutrition journey through interactive charts showing daily macro intake, weekly trends, weight tracking, and goal achievement. Monitor your consistency and make data-driven decisions about your nutrition.
Personalized Goals
Set custom macro targets for weight loss, muscle gain, or maintenance. Our intelligent system calculates optimal nutrition goals based on your profile, activity level, and objectives. Adjust goals dynamically as your needs change.
Smart Reminders
Never miss a meal log with intelligent notifications. Stay consistent with your nutrition goals and build healthy habits. Customizable reminders help you maintain tracking consistency.
Perfect For:
Weight loss and management
Muscle gain and bodybuilding
General health and wellness
Macro-based diets including keto, low-carb, and high-protein plans
Meal planning and preparation
Nutrition education and awareness
Kitchen inventory management
Recipe discovery and meal inspiration
WHY TRACKCAL AI?
Unlike traditional calorie counting apps that require tedious manual entry, TrackCal AI uses the latest advanced artificial intelligence to make nutrition tracking effortless. Our AI understands context, recognizes portion sizes, provides accurate nutritional data in seconds, and even helps you discover new recipes based on your pantry.
Download TrackCal AI today and take control of your nutrition with the power of AI.
All app features require a subscription, for more information on Apple's Terms of Use (EULA) visit: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00152142:ios.description:
Get personalized, connected care anytime, anywhere. With Mass General Brigham Care Connect, you choose how and when you get care, with 24/7 access to trusted virtual primary care providers through video visits on the app. Whether it’s managing diabetes, controlling blood pressure, or getting help for a cold or flu, our providers and dedicated care team are here for you.
Why Patients Choose Us:
Care on your terms: Connect with a provider 24/7 through video visits on the app
Comprehensive care: From everyday issues to chronic condition management, get the help you need, when you need it
Seamless experience: Your care is fully connected within the Mass General Brigham system for smooth transitions between virtual and in-person visits
Smart, personal treatment: We use the latest technology and your medical history to create tailored care plans just for you
Team support: A dedicated care team guides you before and after every visit, helping with scheduling, prescriptions, follow-ups, and more
Features:
Video visits that fit your schedule, 24/7
Treatment for hundreds of conditions, including cold and flu, mental health needs, diabetes, hypertension, and more
Chronic care management and wellness visits (ages 18+)
Medication refills, lab orders, and referrals to specialty care
Symptom checker that helps your provider get the full picture before your visit
Mass General Brigham Care Connect—making healthcare simple, personal, and always within reach.

bluejetty:00146879:ios.summary:

Punch above your weight in this super-fun and completely original match 3 fighting game where matching is the way to land blows on your opponents – the more of one type of junk food you can c
bluejetty:00146879:ios.description:
► Match Hit – Street fighting with street food!
Punch above your weight in this super-fun and completely original match 3 fighting game where matching is the way to land blows on your opponents – the more of one type of junk food you can connect together, the harder you hit. Scarf down strings of hotdogs, burgers, donuts, and potato chips to put some real power behind your punch and knock the stuffing out of an endless stream of challenges. Follow the way of the sumo wrestler and get serious about your eating to give your opponents a serious beating!
► A game with terrible table manners!
• Who needs a varied diet? Match as many foodstuffs of the same type as you can in a single string to do maximum punching damage to your opponent. Long strings will give you multipliers for your next attack. But remember, you’ll have to beat multiple opponents to get to the end of the level, and some are just as well-fed as you, so you’ll need to ration your treats and strategize to break down match 3 barriers and build the ultimate combo attacks at just the right moment if you want to survive.
• Don’t spend all your pocket money on junk food! Collect coins for completing levels and for particularly artful combo attacks, and use them to level up your hero’s abilities, ensuring they have the strength and stamina to take on strings of ever more powerful opponents and super-tough bosses. Work out the best way to apportion your winnings between three parameters—health, damage, and coins—and find the perfect balance in the game for your street-fighting foodie.
• Junk food’s bad for your skin! Well then, just get another one! In Match Hit there are dozens of awesome outfits to collect as you progress through the game, so get munching and punching to win more levels and keep your heroes in tasty new threads.
• Don’t play with your food! Take out your chronic indigestion on a range of entertaining opponents, from street thugs to cops to transport staff to office workers, all of whom are surprisingly buff and astonishingly aggressive. You’ll need a gargantuan appetite to keep matching and take them all out!
► Everybody was junk food fighting!
Grab a pizza the action in this awesome and entertaining fighting game that’ll really satisfy your match 3 cravings. When the chips are down, get matching foodstuffs fast to send a flurry of blows at your hungry opponents, and just make sure you’ve got something left in the food truck for when you reach the really weighty bosses. Have you got the stomach for some real street fighting action? 
Then download Match Hit now!

Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00137017:ios.name: ColorRing・Adult Coloring Book
bluejetty:00137017:ios.summary: Color Ring is a free coloring game that will help you relax by using effective and pleasant color therapy! You will really enjoy this free art game if you love coloring. You do not need to buy expensive paper coloring books anymore, try thi
bluejetty:00137017:ios.description:
Color Ring is a free coloring game that will help you relax by using effective and pleasant color therapy! You will really enjoy this free art game if you love coloring. You do not need to buy expensive paper coloring books anymore, try this fun app that has over a 1500 coloring images and more always coming!
So what makes this app special? This painting app is indeed not like any other. 
1) We have community that will publish the art works of our lovely entertainment app users. Your artworks will be enjoyed, rated and commented on by many others. 
2) But that is not the only entertaining perk this coloring game offers you. We also often organize different contests that can result in real rewards from Apple. Do not miss out on this wonderful opportunity with this free coloring book for adults. 
3) And if you are looking for the best possible anti-stress therapy coloring book experience you will be glad to find out that the app also includes different types of music to help you relax and enjoy yourself while you are painting. 
4) Check out the amazing coloring images from more than 100 illustrators from all over the world.
The interface of this coloring app for adults is very intuitive and enjoyable. When you first enter you will see that there are different tabs you can access. 
- The gallery tab displays categories and images to choose from. Pick any image and get inspired! 
- You will also have a create tab which will allow you to express your artistic abilities in different ways. You can import an image from your device’s gallery, crop it, rotate it, add and remove lines, adjust details and then color it any way you want. You can also take a photo by giving this free art game permission to access your camera and then work your magic. If you are feeling especially creative, you can of course start with just a blank page and get the most of this entertainment app. 
- You will notice there also is a contest tab which you will be able to enter once you list your Instagram account. To see every contest entrant’s work of art you can copy the hashtag under the images and search it directly on Instagram. There are always new creative contests going on. You can also look through all the concluded contests to get some inspiration. 
- Finally, you can save all your beautiful paintings in the my works tab. There you also enter your Instagram username to be able to participate in the contests and win amazing gifts from Apple. 
Coloring for adults is a great way to relax and explore your creative abilities. Color Ring is one of the best games for adults on the market that will offer you a fun and rewarding experience. When you install and open it you might just say “this is a coloring book for me!”.
We are constantly working to make the ColorRing better, please share your feedback: support@martingrey.app

bluejetty:00169913:ios.description:
Rate is a next‑generation mortgage, auto, and wellness app that connects your home, finances, and daily wellbeing in one seamless experience. With fast approvals, intuitive tools, and a growing library of wellness and lifestyle content, Rate helps you move confidently through every part of life — from buying a home to improving your health.
Homeownership & Lending:
-Apply in minutes for a mortgage, refinance, HELOC, personal loan, or auto loan. 
-Explore homes for sale and check your home’s estimated value. 
-Track every step of your loan through the Loan Center with real‑time updates. 
-Connect with dedicated mortgage advisors and access insurance options for home, auto, pets, umbrella, and more.
Auto Loans:
-Browse vehicles by make, model, and body style. 
-Get instantly pre‑qualified and receive a printable voucher to bring to the dealership. 
-Compare financing options and shop confidently with clear terms.
Wellness, Lifestyle & Performance:
-Explore Yoga Yard flows, Zen Den meditations, Sleep Sanctuary soundscapes, and the 7‑Day Sleep Harmony series. 
-Train with athlete‑led programs including Train Like a Champ and Outdoor Studio workouts filmed in Miami and Chicago. 
-Build healthier routines with Nutrition Kitchen meal plans and Guru Garden mindfulness sessions. 
-Shop RateFit — premium performance apparel designed for movement, comfort, and everyday wear. 
-Discover Rate Outdoors for saunas, cold plunges, outdoor showers, and backyard wellness essentials. 
-Plan your next trip with Rate Travel, offering flights, hotels, and experiences directly within the app.
Your Life, Connected  Rate brings together your financial tools, wellness routines, lifestyle products, and daily decisions to help you live more balanced every day.

bluejetty:00086805:ios.description:
Welcome to the Matterhorn App - The official app of Zermatt – Matterhorn.
Home
You can access the webcams, weather forecast and live panoramic map on the home page. It’s possible to view the live e-bus timetable, reserve a table in the online restaurant reservation system or look for an event you’d like to attend.
LIVE
Want to know which lifts and runs are open, the weather forecast for your stay or when the next train leaves? You can find all this information on the live page, alongside webcam images and the latest warnings from Zermatt Bergbahnen.
EXPLORE
Looking for ideas for activities, restaurants or bars? Maybe you'd rather relax in a spa? Let the app inspire you! It’s easy to find the places you want on the map using the filter function.
TICKETS
You can book your cable car or travel ticket in the Ticket Shop, avoiding long queues at the ticket counter.
PEAK TRACK
Get even more out of your skiing day: Save your ski pass and track your personal skiing statistics. Create groups, compete with friends or take part in the public ranking list and see who has collected the most vertical meters
PROFILE
Create your own profile and enter your interests to receive personalized content. You can also sign up to receive warnings about cable cars and runs or push notifications about the Visp–Zermatt route. There is also an overview of purchased tickets, table reservations and saved favourites in your profile.

bluejetty:00135672:ios.description:
Have you been naughty or nice this year? Santa’s about to find out.
Answer honestly, let Santa check his list, and get your verdict: a halo for the Nice list or horns for the Naughty list, plus your score on the Nice-o-meter. Then pass the phone and see who in the family is really getting presents this Christmas.
HOW IT WORKS
1) Pick a quiz and answer 10 quick questions about chores, manners, sharing, homework and all the other things Santa keeps an eye on
2) Every answer counts. Santa adds them up while you wait
3) Get your result: Nice or Naughty, with a percentage so you can see how close it was
4) Try to climb the Nice-o-meter on the next quiz
11 QUIZZES TO PLAY
Each quiz has a different set of questions, so there’s always another chance to redeem yourself or get caught out. Your results are saved on the home screen so the whole family can compare.
PERFECT FOR CHRISTMAS
A great way to keep kids entertained in the run-up to the big day

bluejetty:00089035:ios.name: AHA Knowledge Booster
bluejetty:00089035:ios.summary: The AHA Knowledge Booster app was created to reinforce critical CPR and emergency care knowledge in an effort to save more lives. Users can choose the topics appropriate for their level of knowledge – Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Card
bluejetty:00089035:ios.description:
The AHA Knowledge Booster app was created to reinforce critical CPR and emergency care knowledge in an effort to save more lives. Users can choose the topics appropriate for their level of knowledge – Basic Life Support (BLS), Advanced Cardiovascular Life Support (ACLS), Pediatric Advanced Life Support (PALS), First Aid, and CPR Basics. This booster app is ideal for those who have completed American Heart Association courses and are looking to keep this lifesaving information top of mind.
The quiz-based application will feature different types of questions with topics including:
* CPR Basics
* First Aid Basics
* Emergency Preparedness
* BLS
* ACLS
* PALS
* Heartsaver
* Opioid
* Ventilator Reskilling
* Choking
* Signs of Heart Attack and Stroke
Our adaptive learning algorithm analyzes a users’ interaction with various topics, and
dynamically builds a proficiency map on what a user does and does not know. This proficiency map is used to generate personalized quizzes to help them build mastery. This whole process is 100% automated based on the neuroscience-based technique of retrieval practice. The more you engage with the app, the more tailored the quizzes will be!
Play today to help keep your critical lifesaving knowledge top of mind. AHA Booster makes it easy to engage learners, increase long-term knowledge retention, and measure and improve learning effectiveness.

bluejetty:00166149:ios.name: Screenwise Meter
bluejetty:00166149:ios.summary: The Screenwise Meter iOS app enables registered panelists' participation in Google’s meter-based market research programs. A panelist is a member of a recruited group of people who have opted to participate in Google research and have conse
bluejetty:00166149:ios.description:
The Screenwise Meter iOS app enables registered panelists' participation in Google’s meter-based market research programs. A panelist is a member of a recruited group of people who have opted to participate in Google research and have consented to install meters and share their internet usage with Google. In return for their participation, panelists receive rewards.
When a panel includes physical meters, like Router Meters or TV Meters, this app helps panelists interact with those meters. For example, the app handles checking in to the router meter, so panelists won’t be interrupted when they connect to Wi-Fi at home. It may include a TV Meter Remote so panelists can check in and out from the comfort of their chair.
The Screenwise Meter iOS app also provides panelists with the convenience of answering our occasional surveys and agreeing to (or rejecting) terms and privacy policy updates in the app instead of visiting our online portal.
For information about your own panel, refer to your research panel membership page. For more information about Google and market research panels in general, go to http://www.google.com/landing/panelresearch/

bluejetty:00023395:ios.description:
Couples Quiz Game is the Mr & Mrs game you play on one phone. Answer 10 quick questions about your relationship, pass the phone, let your partner answer the same ones and then find out how many you matched.
Who’s the better cook? Who takes longer to get ready? Who’s the biggest spender? Pick a name, pass it over, and see if you’re on the same page. Match on all 10 and you’re soulmates. Match on 3 and, well… you’ve got some talking to do.
How it works
- Enter both your names
- Player one answers 10 questions
- Pass the phone. Player two answers the same ones
- See your score and every answer side by side
Why couples love it
- 100+ questions across 14 free quizzes
- No account, no setup. Just two names and go
- Works for date night, long car journeys, or settling an argument once and for all
- A hit at hen parties, bachelor and bachelorette nights, bridal showers, engagements and anniversaries

Duplicate Photos Fixer is an easy-to-use application to delete duplicate photos on iPhone. It runs a quick scan to search duplicate photos, including exact and similar-looking images. This duplicate photo finder automatically marks the duplicates and saves time. Remove duplicate photos from the iPhone using this amazing duplicate image finder.
Highlights :
 • Delete duplicate photos seamlessly.
 • Similar photo finder will also select similar images.
 • Customize scan settings for similarity level.
 • Preview before removing duplicate photos on iPhone.
 • Duplicates are shown in groups for easy to understand.
 • Automark all copies leaving one in each group.
 • Delete all marked images at once.
Get this Duplicate image finder for your iPhone now and avail all the features!
Duplicate Photos Fixer from Systweak Software will fix all your duplicate-related photo issues in a flash. Check out all of the awesome features of this best duplicate photo finder app -
Scan Criteria -
This duplicate photo cleaner provides you with three scan criteria to find duplicate images- 
 • Normal: Searches for photos that are similar.
 • Aggressive: Searches only for similar and exact copies.
 • Custom: To search with the customized scan settings.
Customize Scan Settings-
Get customized results with this similar photo cleaner. Set the criteria with these options-
 • Pixels - Pictures with similar pixels.
 • Matching Level - Set the similarity level of pictures.
 • Time Difference - Pictures taken at the same time.
 • GPS - Pictures taken at the same location.
Duplicate photos Scan -
 • One-click on ‘Search for Duplicates’ scans your iPhone to find duplicate images.
 • Preview available for you to check all the duplicate images found.
 • It groups the duplicates to make it easy for you to identify. 
Two methods to mark the duplicates in this similar photo finder app- 
Automark -
 • The Magic wand will automatically mark all duplicates at once. 
 • This will help you in quickly removing duplicate photos from the iPhone. 
 • All copies except one image in each group will be marked. 
OR
Mark manually- 
 • Select each image manually.
Remove Duplicate Photos -
Tap on the ‘Trash’ icon and delete all marked images and remove duplicate photos on iPhone at once. 
Steps to remove duplicate images - 
 • Download Duplicate Photos Fixer.
 • Give permissions for Photos access. 
 • Select scan criteria to search duplicate images.
 • Preview images in the groups of duplicates.
 • Automark the duplicates for quick selection.
 • Delete marked images to remove them permanently.
For any queries email us at support@systweak.com. We would appreciate your suggestions and look forward to improving the experience for our users. bluejetty:00085226:ios.summary: Dreaming of your next trip? Looking for cheap holidays, flights and package holidays all in one place? The Jet2 holiday app makes it easy to search, book and manage your next getaway, whether you're planning a summer holiday, beach holiday,
bluejetty:00085226:ios.description:
Dreaming of your next trip? Looking for cheap holidays, flights and package holidays all in one place? The Jet2 holiday app makes it easy to search, book and manage your next getaway, whether you're planning a summer holiday, beach holiday, family holiday, city break or last-minute escape. 
Searching for flights and holiday deals? Need a holiday planner to organise every part of your trip? The Jet2 app helps you discover great flight deals, compare package holidays, track your holiday countdown and manage your booking from start to finish. Choose from beach holidays, family holidays, city breaks, villa getaways and luxury escapes across our wide range of destinations. Whether you're looking for cheap holidays to Spain, Greece, Italy and beyond, or searching for last-minute holiday deals, you'll find plenty of options in our easy-to-use holiday app. 
As the UK's largest tour operator and a Which? Recommended Provider, we offer great-value package holidays with ultra-low £60pp deposits*, flexible Pay Monthly* options, 22kg baggage, return flights and transfers included as standard. From summer holidays in the sun to spontaneous getaways, booking your next trip has never been easier. 
Plus, we're proud to be Tripadvisor's Best Airline (UK), giving you confidence when booking flights and package holidays through the Jet2 app. 
Why you’ll love the Jet2 app... 
Before you book: 
• Search and book flights, package holidays, family holidays and trips all in one place 
• Filter your search results to find your ideal getaway, from specific destinations to All Inclusive hotels 
• Looking for holiday inspiration? Explore beach holidays, city breaks, summer holidays and more 
• Quickly revisit your recent holiday and flight searches • Search family holidays and find Free Child Places with ease* 
• Sign up to push notifications to get holiday deals, flight deals, travel news and inspiration straight to your phone 
• Get exclusive discounts and rewards with a myJet2 account 
• Save, compare and share your favourite shortlisted holidays 
Manage your booking: 
• With a myJet2 account, save your booking details and see trip details quickly whenever you need them 
• Track your holiday with our handy holiday countdown clock 
• Check in online and access your boarding passes in the app or via Apple Wallet 
• Add Travel Essentials such as seats, in-flight meals and extra baggage 
• Upload and manage your travel documents in one convenient place 
• Get important trip and flight updates through handy notifications 
• Need to speak to us? Alongside WhatsApp, you can use our in-app messaging service to get answers to your questions quickly 
On holiday: 
• Find out when your Customer Helper is due to visit your hotel 
• Use our handy translator tool to help you communicate while travelling. Type words or scan menus, signs and more for instant translation, plus practise useful travel phrases 
• See your pick-up time from your hotel and track your return transfer to the airport with live transfer status (available in selected resorts) 
• Keep track of your flights with real-time flight updates and travel information 
• Need help during your trip? Access 24/7 support while you're away, including easy contact through WhatsApp or our in-app messaging service
*Terms and conditions apply

Quick levels, Theme packs and Daily challenges will give you different gaming experience, and make sure you will never feel bored in the game.

NEED SOME HELP?
Well, not everyone can be good at puzzle games. Sometimes we need help when we're stuck. So that's where Hints come in handy.
SEE ALL PUZZLES YOU HAVE DONE
Achievements can be exciting and motivate one to keep going. That's why we made the Collection. You will find all pictures you have completed in the game. Every picture witnesses your hard work in the process of becoming a Nonogram master!
Now challenge yourself and enjoy the Nonogram fun! And don't forget to do the tasks! Trust me, you will love this game soon!

bluejetty:00128869:ios.name: Bibi Drawing & Color Kids Game
bluejetty:00128869:ios.developer: Bibi.Pet - Toddlers Games - Colors and Shapes
bluejetty:00128869:ios.summary:
Bibi.Pet presents a new collection of 72 fun and educational Puzzles and Patterns to Color.
There are two new types of games besides the classic Puzzles and Colors: the Color Pixel and the Puzzle Tangram, with lots of animals to discover.
bluejetty:00128869:ios.description:
Bibi.Pet presents a new collection of 72 fun and educational Puzzles and Patterns to Color.
There are two new types of games besides the classic Puzzles and Colors: the Color Pixel and the Puzzle Tangram, with lots of animals to discover.
6 different ways to play and 72 activities to further stimulate children’s curiosity and desire to learn.
With drawings to color in, children can express their creativity and develop their artistic abilities.
Using the puzzles and stickers, children can improve their skills associated with logic, coordination and control of even the smallest manual movements (fine motor skills)
And as always, Bibi.Pet will accompany you as you discover all the educational activities available.
Suitable for ages 2 to 5 and designed together with experts from the educational field.
The funny little animals that live there have particular shapes and speak their own special language: the Bibi’s language, which only children can understand.
Bibi.Pet are cute, friendly and scatterbrained, and can’t wait to play with all the family!
You can learn and have fun with them with colors, shapes, puzzles and logic games.
Features:
- 20 different settings
- 6 different types of games: Pixel, Tangram, Puzzles, Stickers, Free drawing and Coloring
- 7 tools for drawing, like a real artist
- Simplified coloring to stay within the lines automatically
- 72 games, puzzles and colors
- Educational games for children over 2 years of age
- Lots of different games for learning while having fun
--- DESIGNED FOR LITTLE ONES --- 
- Absolutely no adverts 
- Designed to entertain children aged from 2 to 6, from little to big!
- Games with SIMPLE rules for children to play alone or with their parents. 
- Perfect for children at play school. 
- A host of entertaining sounds and interactive animation. 
- No need for reading skills, perfect also for pre-school or nursery children. 
- Characters created for boys and girls. 
--- TRANSPARENCY & SAFETY ---
Bibi.Pet takes your family's digital safety seriously. We are fully dedicated to protecting your children's data online by rigorously following the compliance standards set by COPPA (Children’s Online Privacy Protection Rule) and KidSAFE.
• Privacy policy: https://www.bibi.pet/privacy
• Terms of use: https://www.bibi.pet/terms_of_use
--- Bibi.Pet Who are we? --- 
We produce games for our children, and it is our passion. We produce tailor-made games, without invasive advertising by third parties. 
Some of our games have free trial versions, which means you can try them out first before purchases, supporting our team and enabling us to develop new games and keep all our apps up-to-date. 
We create a variety of games based on: colors and shapes, dressing up, dinosaur games for boys, games for girls, mini-games for smaller children and many other fun and educational games; you can try them all! 
Our thanks to all the families who show their trust in Bibi.Pet!

▶ 트래블카드의 시작, 트래블월렛
· 45개 외화를 원하는 시점에, 실시간 환율로 충전
· 주요 통화(달러, 엔, 유로) 환전 수수료 0% (100% 우대 환율)
· 모든 외화 결제 시 해외 결제 수수료 0%
· 전 세계 1억 개 Visa 온/오프라인 가맹점에서 결제
· 전 세계 주요 도시 대중교통 컨택리스 결제(해외 교통카드) 지원
▶ 환전도, 결제도 내 마음대로
· 내 외화를 원화 환불, 외화간환전, 친구간송금, 투자로 자유롭게
· 번거로운 정산 없이, 결제 1번으로 다 함께 나눠내는 N빵결제
· 목표 환율에 도달하면 자동으로 충전하는 예약환전
· 분실에도 걱정없이 앱에서 자유롭게 카드를 관리하는 활성화 기능
▶ 일상에서도 트래블월렛!
· 결제하고 게임하며 매일매일 포인트 모으는 재미
· 내가 모은 포인트로 외화 환전, 스타벅스 별 전환, 항공 마일리지 전환까지!
· 수수료 없는 외화 해외송금, 개인부터 기업까지 국제송금/이체를 한 번에
▶ 국내/해외 여행 동행 찾기, 전 세계 여행자 커뮤니티 소셜
· 성별, 나이 등 신원이 인증된 안전한 동행 찾기
· 연락처 교환 없이 1:1 대화부터 단체 채팅까지
· N빵결제로 더 깔끔한 모임 정산
· 결제 내역으로 남기는 진짜 전 세계 맛집, 카페, 여행지 리뷰
▶ 트래블월렛(트래블페이)은 누가 운영하나요?
(주)트래블월렛은 정부로부터 전자금융업 선불전자지급수단 발행 및 관리업, 소액해외송금업 및 온라인 환전업, 은행권 공동 오픈플랫폼 인허가를 득하였으며, 국내 최고 수준의 IT보안환경을 구축하여 국가공인기관으로부터 인증 받고, 국제 보안 표준 규격 'PCI-DSS' 인증을 취득하였습니다.
트래블월렛의 모든 가입 절차 및 개인 정보는 금융결제원에서 관리하며, 안전하게 서비스를 제공하고 있습니다.
▶ 꼭 필요한 권한만 확인해요
서비스 제공을 위해 다음과 같은 선택적 접근권한을 필요로 합니다.
선택적 접근 권한의 경우 허용하지 않더라도 서비스의 기본 기능 이용 가능합니다.
선택 권한
- Face ID, Touch ID : 인증서비스
- 카메라 : 인증서비스, QR, 바코드 정보 인식
- 위치 : 위치기반 서비스 이용
- 연락처 : 친구 간 송금 서비스 이용
- 마이크 : 번역 서비스 이용
- 음성인식 : 번역 서비스 이용
- 알림 : 카드 사용알림, 이벤트 등 알림 메시지 수신
- 캘린더 : 소셜 서비스 일정 등록
각 권한 허용은 [설정 > 앱 > travel Wallet > travel Wallet 접근 허용] 메뉴에서 변경하실 수 있습니다.
(주)트래블월렛

02-522-0400

bluejetty:00078749:ios.description:
Includes random-item purchases
We are not only searching for the origin of humans, but also the starting point of mother earth.
Join the new casual SLG Primitive Era: 10000 BC to explore the magnificence of prehistoric civilizations such as Gendaya, Mesopotamia, Mulia, Atlantis and many others. Download the game for free and write your own history!
——Game Features——
►Unlock prehistoric civilization and explore the mysteries it holds
Travel back to the prehistoric era to explore the vibrant virgin jungle and conquer nature. You need to build a territory from scratch and solve countless mysteries. You can explore the new continent with other chiefs and communicate with millions of players all around the world in real-time!
►Improve productivity and develop civilization
In an era where resources are lacking, chiefs are required to develop their tribes with knowledge and build civilizations using languages and tools.
►Expand your tribe with romance
To adapt to the changing natural environment and keep expanding your tribe, you must reproduce as many offspring as possible to achieve higher productivity.
►Domesticate wild beasts and expand your tribe
Collaborate with different tribe members to domesticate prehistoric beasts such as mammoths and saber-toothed tigers. With personalized display and diversified decorations, Primitive Era is committed to providing all chiefs with the freest game experience of tribe construction!
►Fight other tribes and emerge as the ruler of all
Switching strategies of buildings and heroes will deliver a different gaming experience. You will conquer the world and decide the direction of civilization development as the leader of the strongest tribe!
——Contact——
If you need any help, please contact us via the "Service Center" in the game or e-mail us at CSC@37mobile.com
Facebook Fan Page: https://www.facebook.com/gaming/ThePrimitiveEra

bluejetty:00115281:ios.summary:
A new adventure from the creators of Hunt Royale and Tiny Gladiators!
STEP INTO A LIVING WORLD
From zero to hero – embark on an epic journey full of battles, loot, and legends!
Explore a vast, hand-crafted world where every path leads to a
bluejetty:00115281:ios.description:
A new adventure from the creators of Hunt Royale and Tiny Gladiators!
STEP INTO A LIVING WORLD
From zero to hero – embark on an epic journey full of battles, loot, and legends!
Explore a vast, hand-crafted world where every path leads to a story, a secret, or a monster to defeat. Shape your character through a class evolution system, a sprawling skill tree, and over 1,000 items to collect!
ALL ROADS LEAD TO ARCHER’S POND
Join other players in the grandest city of the Northern Lands.
Forge weapons, gossip in the tavern, ride flashy mounts and build bonds in a fully online town – because what use is a story if there's no one around to hear it? If you miss the old days of chatting with friends in town instead of endlessly grinding levels, Archer’s Pond may just feel like home. Maybe even a bit nostalgic?
MASTER COMBAT AND META-GAME
Choose your path and build a character like no other!
Six starting classes are just the beginning. Evolve, experiment, and unleash chaos with unique item sets and powerful skills. Combined with a classic elemental system, the world constantly challenges you: What stats suit your current class? Do your talents synergize with your gear? Do you have enough fire damage to exploit the boss’s elemental weakness?
EVERY RESOURCE COUNTS
Gather, craft, and upgrade – everything has a purpose!
Collect materials to forge gear, brew potions, and help the town grow. Archer’s Pond offers a separate layer of progression beyond traditional leveling. To become a true legend, you’ll need to understand the synergy between combat, crafting, trade, and resource harvesting!
A STORY WORTH DISCOVERING
Step into a world where the stakes go far beyond shiny loot.
A fearsome dragon, roaming bandits, and creatures from beyond the veil – and that’s just the beginning. Follow the main storyline and dive into hundreds of side quests in a narrative full of twists, heroism, and destiny.
Remember – you’re not just a bystander. Your actions shape the world. Unlock new paths, restore a farmstead to its former glory, or even help build a monument in the name of true art!
SHOW OFF YOUR GLORY
How do you spot a real hero? Their level, their gear... and their mount!
Collect legendary item sets with unique bonuses and unforgettable looks. Then ride into battle on a rare mount – from a saber-toothed cat to a war mammoth. Sometimes, a jealous glance from a friend is worth more than a pile of gold.
ACCESSIBLE YET CHALLENGING
Easy to pick up, hard to put down – a world that draws you in.
Welcoming to newcomers, rich in depth for veterans. Whether you enjoy combat, exploration, collecting, or crafting – there’s something here for everyone. Easy to learn, hard to master, as they say! The Northern Lands are too vast for just one playstyle – there’s room for us all!
Ready to begin? Download the game and start your legend in a world that remembers your footsteps. Adventure awaits!
Terms of Use: https://boombit.com/tos/

bluejetty:00071021:ios.name: Zombie Frontier 4: Sniper War
bluejetty:00071021:ios.summary: Zombie Frontier4 is latest established sequel of the zombie frontier series, it is a classical first-person zombie shooting game. Players can collect materials, blueprints to forge weapons, fight off mutated BOSSes, come and experience the
bluejetty:00071021:ios.description:
Zombie Frontier4 is latest established sequel of the zombie frontier series, it is a classical first-person zombie shooting game. Players can collect materials, blueprints to forge weapons, fight off mutated BOSSes, come and experience the feel of a real apocalypse and watch those zombie limbs explode. 
Game features
[Infinite Number of Apocalypse Challenges]
You will encounter zombies hiding in the dark corners of the game, pouncing zombies dogs, tentacled zombies, which can stand up even after their heads have been shot off, there are also Lickers, Roadblockers, Chargers and other mutated zombies, there is also the “Mother Worm”, the ultimate warped combination of all zombies and last, but not least there are General Simmons and other mutated zombies in your path.
[The One and Only Gun Strategy]
A unique skill is involved in the use of every gun. You can choose to master the pistol and shoot their vulnerable areas; you can decide to carry two automatic rifles; and suppress them by spraying them with bullets; you can also select the shotgun, where you’ll load around and fire around and blow anything up that comes near you. Besides that, there are also grenades, which can be used in certain areas, sniper rifles and other heavy artillery for certain tactics.
[Unrivaled Battlefield Experience]
You’ll need to kill your way out of ambushes in the snow, deserts and caves, you’ll find yourself on top of a skyscraper with nothing but a sniper rifle, you’ll have to take them out with a reaper rifle out in the middle of a bridge. You’ll be challenged to the max in event stages and compete sometimes with other survivors. There are also classical hospitals, cars, prisons, factories, islands and more, that are waiting for you to be explored.
[Self-Sufficiency Growth System] 
Anything from weapon upgrades to weapon modifications or new weapon installments to selecting armor suits all contribute to the diversity of the game, First Aid Kits, Adrenalines and other consumable items can also be purchased along the way. These are all your resources for survival.
[Connecting with Other Players]
Find more survivors, interact with others or compete with others. Just remember that you’re not alone in this game.

bluejetty:00115675:ios.description:
WiFi Password + WiFi Finder
Connect Smarter. Surf Faster. Stay Secure.
WiFi Password + WiFi Finder is a powerful and easy-to-use tool that helps you manage and enhance your WiFi experience. Whether you're at home, in the office, or on the go, this app gives you full control over your wireless connections.
Apps most useful features for daily use are Nearby WiFi List, WiFi Speed Test, WiFi Password Show, WiFi Signal Strength, WiFi Password Generator, WiFi Password on Map, Scan WiFi QR Code.
Key Features:
Nearby WiFi List
Scan and display all available WiFi networks in your area, including signal strength and security type.
WiFi Speed Test
Quickly measure your internet speed, including download, upload, and latency.
WiFi Password Show
View saved WiFi passwords on your device (device permissions or root access may be required).
WiFi Signal Strength
Monitor the signal quality of your connected network to find the best location for stability and performance.
WiFi Password Generator
Generate strong, secure passwords to protect your network from unauthorized access.
Scan WiFi QR Code
Easily connect to networks by scanning QR codes — no need to manually enter passwords.
WiFi Password on Map
Discover shared WiFi hotspots and their passwords on an interactive global map, ideal for travelers and remote workers.
Users must purchase a premium plan to use all Features Unlimited.
This app offers auto-renewable subscriptions.
For More Information :
Privacy Policy : https://bharatkakadiya.blogspot.com/2025/06/privacy-policy.html

bluejetty:00083758:ios.description:
Step into the immersive world of Civilization Wars: Strategy, a 2D RTS adventure where strategy and tactical decisions determine your success. Build your kingdom, lead your army, and set sail on a ship to conquer mysterious islands. Inspired by Ancient Maya, Ancient Egypt, and Ancient Greece, this game offers the ultimate challenge in creating and expanding a thriving civilization.
Take on the role of a leader in a fantasy realm where every action shapes the fate of your empire. Construct buildings, gather resources, and train your army to defend your land and explore new territories. Each level is a unique test of your strategic skills and creativity.
Build your kingdom 
Develop your civilization by constructing farms, fortifications, and outposts. Manage resources effectively and lay the foundation for a prosperous empire.
Explore new islands

bluejetty:00129336:ios.description:
Time for another adventure in Ni no Kuni: Cross Worlds!
Directed and produced by [LEVEL5 Inc.], and featuring animation from [Studio Ghibli] and music by composer [Joe Hisaishi],
a talented team unites to create the newest installment in the [Ni no Kuni] game series,
『Ni no Kuni: Cross Worlds』, the world inside your heart!
◀ Game Introduction ▶
■ A story where reality and fantasy collide.
A grand journey awaits you upon arriving in another world via the virtual reality game [Soul Divers].
Experience the epic that unfolds in 『Ni no Kuni: Cross Worlds』, where endless adventures await.
■ An open world indistinguishable from an animated film.
Beautiful graphics rendered in the Unreal 4 Engine.
Catch every carefully-crafted expression and action in this breathtaking world!
■ Customizable player characters show your individuality.
Choose from the mysterious fencer [Swordsman], the magic spear-wielding [Witch],
the genius gunner [Engineer], the mischievous archer [Rogue], and brawny hammer-swinging [Destroyer]
Who would you like to become in 『Ni no Kuni: Cross Worlds』?
■ Your helpful protectors, Familiars!
Meet the mysterious creatures unique to 『Ni no Kuni: Cross Worlds』.
Their cuteness hides incredible strength!
Collect [Familiars] and get stronger together.
■ Decorate your very own farm!
Get back to nature in the Familiars’ Forest and decorate it however you like!
You can place [decorations] like gardens, trees, and houses.
Enjoy your harvest and cook a delicious meal in the Familiars' Forest!
■ Join a kingdom and make friends!
Work together to rebuild the fallen [Nameless Kingdom] and develop your kingdom's resources.
Decorate the kingdom with interactive [Social Objects] and
triumph in various challenges to become the greatest on the server.
- Minimum Requirements: iphone 6s or Later, 2GB of RAM
- Recommended Requirements: iphone XS or Later, 4GB of RAM
- Homepage: https://ninokuni.netmarble.com/
*This app offers in-app purchases.
*By downloading this game, you are agreeing to our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
- Terms of Use: https://help.netmarble.com/terms/terms_of_service_en_p
- Privacy Policy: https://help.netmarble.com/terms/privacy_policy_p_en

Built-in Rules:
• Block ads and trackers
• Block social, chat, and AI widgets
• Block privacy, newsletter, and notification banners
Custom Rules:
• Block or allow web resources and websites 
• Hide webpage elements
• Strip cookies from web requests 
• Force the loading of websites and resources over a secure connection (https)
• Specify filters using a simple and an intuitive format or using regular expressions 
• Search, import, and share custom rules

• Block and hide content visually
• Blocker profiles
• iCloud Sync

bluejetty:00089170:ios.description:
Made for writers, by writers, Transom lets you capture and tag every little scrap of an idea so that you can easily find it whenever you're ready to write — without having to fumble through emails-to-self, messy notebooks, and clunky multi-purpose apps.
How it works: create a Thought to add it to your Transom notes. Easily add Tags and file it under a Project. When it's time to sit down and write, all those brilliant little gems will be right at your fingertips (and not buried in that old notebook — no, the other one. Or was it in an email?). Questions or feedback? We'd love to hear from you: help@wearetransom.com.

Lazy Workout – Your Gateway to Effortless Fitness, Anytime, Anywhere
Discover a new way to weave fitness into your daily routine with LazyFit, a pioneering mobile app designed with your comfort in mind. As your personal pocket-sized trainer, LazyFit offers an array of easy, effective, and engaging workouts that you can perform right at home. You don't need any complicated equipment or a pricey gym membership – all you need is a chair, a wall, or even your bed!
Workouts Tailored to Your Lifestyle
We know that everyday life can be busy, so we've created workouts that fit seamlessly into your schedule. LazyFit’s exclusive workout plans, incorporating stretching, yoga, pilates, strength training, and cardio workouts, are perfectly suitable for before or after sleep, during your lunch break, or whenever you have some downtime.
Gentle Yet Powerful
Don't let the name fool you. LazyFit provides exercise regimens that are simple and accessible, yet still pack a punch when it comes to getting you in shape. Each routine has been meticulously curated by expert trainers to ensure you're making the most of every movement, enhancing your overall fitness while improving strength and flexibility.
Features You'll Love
• Variety: Choose from a wide array of workouts, including stretching, yoga, pilates, strength, and cardio workouts. 
• Convenience: No need for any gym equipment or a large space – these workouts are designed for your living room, office, or bedroom. 
• Guided Workouts: Easy-to-follow, step-by-step instructions ensure you're performing each exercise safely and effectively. 
• Customizable: Adjust your workout to your fitness level and preferences with our customizable plans. 
• Progress Tracker: Stay motivated and track your progress with our built-in tracking system.
Join the LazyFit community today and start your journey to a healthier, happier you – no gym required. If you thought fitness was hard, LazyFit is here to show you how easy it can be.
Take the first step to effortless fitness – download LazyFit today!
7M - Let's get healthier together!
SUBSCRIPTION INFORMATION

bluejetty:00163191:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00163191:ios.description:
Adopted by more than 2 million users, TeamPulse centralizes everything a team needs to stay organized day to day
Designed with coaches, embraced by players and parents, it brings together all the features needed to manage a team or a club, whatever your level
No more scattered tools and lost threads: you now have a single application that replaces your entire toolset — TeamPulse — while remaining 100% free, with no ads, no hidden fees and no locked features
Key features of TeamPulse:
- PLANNING: View your calendar at a glance and never miss an event. Add recurring events (training) and one-offs (specific sessions, matches, meetings, team socials) in seconds
- AVAILABILITY: Know who’s in or out for each event. Automatic reminders encourage quick responses, giving immediate visibility on available players
- CALL-UPS: Select available players and call them up in one tap, with a notification sent to each player. You can also publish the call-up in the team’s locker room so no one misses it
- LINEUPS: For football — and soon many other sports — create visual lineups by placing your players on the pitch according to your chosen formation
- SOCIAL: Use a dedicated space for each team, the LOCKER ROOM, to share key information. Every member can speak up, react and add photos, videos or documents for the whole group
- MESSAGING: Communicate with your different teams using direct and group messages. Each player receives personal notifications and keeps a centralized message history
- POLLS: Ask your questions directly in chats (dates, logistics, sporting decisions, equipment, etc.) and see results in real time
- PARENT-CHILD: Follow your children more easily and add multiple guardians for the same child, with notifications sent to each guardian separately
- STATISTICS: View attendance across training types with clear, informative charts. Track progress and make better decisions to improve performance
- CALENDAR EXPORT: Automatically sync your events with your personal calendar. Edited, canceled or newly added events are updated automatically even after the export
- MULTI-TEAMS: Manage or join as many teams as you wish. Ideal if you play and/or coach in different squads
- NOTIFICATIONS & REMINDERS: Stay informed in real time about events and important messages thanks to instant notifications
BONUS: Because organization also lives in the details, TeamPulse offers additional features that make everyday life easier
* Easy sign-in via FACEBOOK or APPLE
* Detailed player profiles, profile photos and team logos
* Fine participant management: selection, limits and reserves to fit your roster
* Hide event attendance from non-admins
* Automatic attendance summary 1 h before each session
* Admin notifications when attendance changes
* Edit attendance after events
AVAILABLE FOR ALL SPORTS:
Football, Basketball, Handball, Rugby, Volleyball, Tennis, Combat sports, Dance, Gymnastics, Badminton, Swimming, Padel, Walking, Table Tennis, Cycling, Athletics, Running, Triathlon, Water Polo, Hockey… and many more

bluejetty:00166411:ios.name: Nota Ringtones
bluejetty:00166411:ios.summary: Nota Ringtones is a completely free app for creating ringtones directly on your iPhone, without the need to connect to a computer. Easily and quickly create ringtones from your favorite songs and set them for calls, notifications, or alarms
bluejetty:00166411:ios.description:
Nota Ringtones is a completely free app for creating ringtones directly on your iPhone, without the need to connect to a computer. Easily and quickly create ringtones from your favorite songs and set them for calls, notifications, or alarms.
Ease of Use
Every iPhone user can effortlessly create their own ringtone. If you have any questions or issues, feel free to contact our support team through the app. We provide personalized assistance completely free of charge.
App Benefits
Wide Selection of Ringtones: Regular updates with popular, fun, and fresh ringtones and notification sounds.
Tutorial Materials: We offer detailed instructions on creating ringtones using GarageBand and iTunes.
Visual Guides: Every step of the ringtone creation process is described with illustrations and videos to ensure a 100% success rate.
Key Features
Extract Audio from Videos: Select a video from your gallery and automatically extract audio to create a ringtone.
Precise Trimming: Adjust ringtones with accuracy up to 0.1 seconds.
Fade-In and Fade-Out Settings: Support for fade effects ranging from 1 to 5 seconds.
Format Conversion: Convert videos and audio files to MP3 and M4R.
Special Features
Assign unique ringtones to specific contacts.
Save and edit your favorite ringtones in the "My Collection" section.
Upgrade to Premium:
- No Ads and Limits
- Unlimited Use of Features
- Unlimited Ringtones
Subscription Details:
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription with a 3 days free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of the selected plan. Subscriptions and auto-renewal may be managed by going to Account Settings after purchase. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.
Subscription Options:
- Weekly: $3.99
- Lifetime: $24.99
For other currencies, the price corresponds to the same tier on the App Store Pricing Matrix.
With Nota Ringtones, creating a personalized ringtone has never been easier or more enjoyable! Join us and start customizing your sound today!

Terms & Conditions: https://nota-ringtones.notion.site/Terms-and-Conditions-109599bb4bd980fe9871d40fe8ac76a5?pvs=74
Support: https://nota-ringtones.notion.site/Support-109599bb4bd9801d86dfdd3fa2e03cb7

その他: 映画（ローマの休日など）、ビジネス英語、TOEFL®、IELTS™対策教材

アプリを利用するには、iOS14.1以降のiPhoneまたはiPod touchが必要です。

・解約手続きは「設定」アプリの「iTunes & App Store」から行えます（詳細は下記に記載）。
・自動継続課金は購読期間終了前24時間以内に自動で行われます。
・お支払はiTunesアカウントに請求されます。
・すでにプレミアムサービスに登録したことがあるAppleIDをご利用の場合、無料トライアルは適用されません。
【有料プランの解約方法】
1「設定」アプリを開く
2 「iTunes & App Store」を選択する
3 「Apple ID: メールアドレス」を選択する
4 表示されたポップアップ内の「Apple IDを表示」をタップする（必要に応じてサインインする）
5 「登録」ボタンを選択する
* iTunesからも同様の確認や自動更新の解除・設定を行うことができます。

bluejetty:00119100:ios.name: English Phrasal Verbs in Use
bluejetty:00119100:ios.summary:

When we face a phrasal
bluejetty:00119100:ios.description:
This application is dedicated to one of the most complicated topic in the English language — Phrasal Verbs. There are dozens of rules and nuances in this topic, but we have made maybe the easiest way to deal with it.
When we face a phrasal verb for the first time, they usually do not know HOW to translate it and then HOW to use it. The problem occurs rather often because there are more than 10000+ phrasal verbs in English. That means, that we meet them every day in the spoken and written language.
But at the same time, such a big number does not mean that all of these phrasal verbs are of common usage. The majority of them just rest inside the vocabulary. Native speakers know them but they hardly use them in every day speech. 
That is why we have collected phrasal verbs of wide usage. They will help you extend your vocabulary and understand native speakers.
Being the developer, we take much care about our users. We understand clearly that it is not appropriate to give just a list of verbs like all other vocabularies do. It is not comfortable for learning, understanding and practice.
We really believe that learning apps should develop students’ skills in a clear and simple way. That is why you will find a very friendly interface and useful functions inside the app.
We have included 200 phrasal verbs. You can read and learn them in two ways:
— use an alphabetical list and open a card with the verb you do not know;
— fun game and practice to remember phrasal verb
— quiz with more than 10 level to improve phrasal verbs.
Every card contains a simple explanation and an example of usage. Also every verb is marked separable/inseparable. Students can use bookmarks to form the list of necessary phrasal verbs. 
After you have studied the verbs you are able to check your knowledge. We have made up a collection of quiz where users are offered to choose the needed phrasal verb or to choose the needed meaning. When you complete a test the app shows you the result and mistakes.
Download and enjoy. It 's free.

bluejetty:00073176:ios.description:
Grow crops, grow your agricultural empire! Become a modern farmer to operate more than 100 authentic machines by Case IH, CLAAS, DEUTZ-FAHR, Fendt, John Deere, KRONE, Massey Ferguson, New Holland, Valtra & many other acclaimed manufacturers from around the world - offering a wide range of farming activities. 
Choose what kind of farmer you want to be in Farming Simulator 23 (FS23) as the acclaimed agricultural sim by GIANTS Software offers a brand-new experience with many new features for your mobile device!
Operate realistic tractors, harvesters, field sprayers, and more
Cultivate fields with a variety of crops, or harvest grapes and olives on the hillside
Start logging with heavy forestry equipment 
Establish production chains and use powerful trucks for transport
Tend to farm animals like cows, sheep, and now: chickens!
Enjoy tons of possibilities on two new maps, including collectibles
New gameplay features also introduce plowing and weeding
A tutorial mode, AI helper & a new autoload feature for logs/pallets assist you on your farm 
There’s a lot more to do after plowing, removing weeds, harvesting crops, or collecting eggs from chicken coops: Produce valuable goods made from your harvest to expand your flourishing business with new factories and production chains! 
Don’t worry - there is always time to relax and walk around your vast arable land while visuals change through the atmospheric seasons. If more than 100 machines are not enough, you can grow your fleet of agricultural vehicles through official extra content.
New and improved in-game tutorials show you the ways of the farm if you’re new to country life. Start farming wherever you go and let the good times grow!

bluejetty:00179274:ios.description:
Elevate your journey with the Qantas app, your trusted, simple, and personalised travel companion. Whether you're travelling, shopping, or tracking your Qantas Points, we've got you covered. Check-in for your flight, view your digital boarding pass, see your Points activity and more.
Use the Qantas app to:
• Search and book Qantas flights
• Explore all Qantas products including hotels, cars, tours and travel insurance
• Manage and view your trips, including flights, hotels and car bookings 
• Access your digital boarding pass and keep it in the app or add to Apple Wallet
• Select or change your seats any time before check-in when flying on Qantas-operated and marketed flights 
• Request an upgrade with a few taps
• Track your Points activity, Status Credits, tier progress and learn more about how to earn points
• Discover and redeem your Frequent Flyer member benefits
• Claim missing Qantas Points and status credits for eligible flights
• Use and earn Qantas Points on a range of products from Qantas Marketplace and Qantas Shopping
• Explore movie and TV show options that will be available on your flight 
• Stay updated with notifications for check-in and boarding 
• Manage, link and transfer your lounge invitations before you fly
• When eligible, see which lounges you can access
Download the app today on your iPhone or iPad.
Enjoying our app? Leave us a rating and review. Any questions or feedback? Reach out to mobileappsupport@qantas.com.au
Please note: Check-in, in-app boarding passes, requesting upgrades and some alerts are not available for all flights and all airports.

bluejetty:00165241:ios.name: TRY DRY: The Dry January app
bluejetty:00165241:ios.summary: Try Dry® is the powerful, easy-to-use, and totally free premium app helping tens of thousands of people to take control of their drinking. Try Dry® is the official app of the Dry January® challenge, which was created and is run by the chari
bluejetty:00165241:ios.description:
Try Dry® is the powerful, easy-to-use, and totally free premium app helping tens of thousands of people to take control of their drinking. Try Dry® is the official app of the Dry January® challenge, which was created and is run by the charity Alcohol Change UK.
Co-created with drinkers and based on behavioural science and a spirit of experimenting (hence the name), Try Dry® contains unique features such as 'planned drinking', custom goals, and special missions. Unlike 'sobriety-only apps', it works brilliantly whether you want to cut back or try being sober.
Whether you’re taking on the Dry January® challenge, doing Sober Spring, trying a sober October, making a longer-term change to your drinking, or just cutting back, the Try Dry® app is your trusted year-round support system.
Why should I download Try Dry®?
• Track your units, calories and money saved
• Set goals that work for you
• Loads of great badges to achieve with in-app celebrations
• Access our exclusive free coaching email programme
• See your progress using the charts
• Daily motivation - receive a reminder every day, at a time that suits you
• Use the drinking risk quiz to see how you are doing
• Led by science, developed for you. Try Dry® combines behavioural science with a highly responsive approach to feedback from users. 
• Totally free. No upfront costs. No hidden costs. No ads. Entirely funded by the charity Alcohol Change UK.
Why cut down your drinking?
• Better sleep. More energy. Glowing skin (yes, really).
• More money in your pocket (the average UK adult spends £50,000 on booze in their lifetime!)
• Get healthier - cutting back on the booze lowers your risks of over 60 serious medical conditions including heart disease, stroke, and 7 cancers
• Take control – if alcohol has become a habit, break free and take full control
• Be more present, enjoy life more, and really be there for your family and friends.

bluejetty:00062658:ios.name: Scanbooster Ultrasound Sim
bluejetty:00062658:ios.summary: Start learning sonography today! Many different cases and pathologies. An ever expanding library of new patients for you to practice with. Learn the correct ultrasound probe movements with our scan tutorial. Revise anatomy with our labeling
bluejetty:00062658:ios.description:
Start learning sonography today! Many different cases and pathologies. An ever expanding library of new patients for you to practice with. Learn the correct ultrasound probe movements with our scan tutorial. Revise anatomy with our labeling: It shows all important structures colored - for maximum clarity during scanning. We are the world's first realistic ultrasound simulator app. Scanbooster allows sonographers, medical doctors, students, and nurses to learn sonography with ease. Scanbooster puts a professor, a high-end ultrasound machine and many patients on your iPhone. It SIMULATES sonographic examinations with maximum realism.
Scanbooster comes with many different organs and even real pathologies that you can scan - just like with a real device. Just move your device to perform virtual scans. If you have both iPhone and iPad you can use your iPhone as a virtual ultrasound probe to control Scanbooster on your iPad. Just download the additional Scanbooster Control App!
Features:
-Easy navigation:
Labeling of many important structures is available in every contained organ volume!
If you ever get lost, just turn on labeling to see every structure colored. Pathological structures will be labeled separately.
-Learn the correct handling of an ultrasound transducer: With our scan-tutorial the correct handling and the different movements become easy to repeat for yourself.
-Learn the difference between different ultrasound probes: We have included linear probes, curved probes and even intravaginal/intracavital probes in Scanbooster.
-Included Pictogram:
With the pictogram, you'll always know where you are scanning currently. Just turn it on - with a single tap.
-Many different cases:
Scanbooster features an ever-growing array of both physiologic cases and pathologic cases as well. For the first time, all medical doctors can scan even the rarest pathologies themselves -instead of only looking them up 2d in the textbook.
-Innovative learning modes:
With our different learning modes, performing an ultrasound examination becomes a breeze. Scanbooster will show you various stats about your learning progress. That way you'll always keep track of your progress. If you should ever need help - Scanbooster has got you covered. Just like a professor that's always beside you. In our learning modes, Scanbooster will guide you to the right answer.
-Scanning like the real thing:
With the optional Scanbooster Control App on your iPhone, scanning will feel almost like the real thing. Install it to your iPhone to control Scanbooster on your iPad. With it, your iPhone becomes a virtual ultrasound probe. On newer devices, realScan functionality supports all movements: fanning, rotating, rocking, sweeping, sliding and compression - all in the air. All movements are then sent to your iPad with a very fast Bluetooth connection. Your iPhone will be transformed into your virtual ultrasound probe. With Scanbooster Control you'll feel as if your patient was right in front of you!
-Free lifetime updates for all volumes/organs:
If we add new features to any organ you can download it right away - for free!
-Many options and settings:
Scanbooster has many options and settings - just like a real ultrasound machine. You can change brightness, contrast, zoom, depth,...and many more. We placed high importance on making Scanbooster feel a little like a real device. That way the transition will become much easier for you when you finally perform your examinations - with real patients and devices.
Terms of use: https://scanbooster.com/index.php/impressum#qx-heading-1479

bluejetty:00115134:ios.description:
BeStar is the ultimate music career game where you create, release, and promote your own songs. Build your fanbase, climb the charts, and compete to become a star.
Start small with your first single, then push your way into playlists, send songs to radio, and release full albums. Every choice matters: promote at the right time, launch a lyric video or official video, or save coins and spins to outplay your rivals.
Challenge your friends, collaborate on tracks, and watch your music rise on daily and weekly charts. Drop remixes, go on tour, or unlock VIP perks to boost your career even faster.
BeStar isn’t just about making music—it’s about strategy, timing, and showing you’ve got what it takes to hit #1. Are you ready to outshine the competition?
Subscription Information
Title: VIP (1 Month)
Length: 1 Month (auto-renewable)
Price: $9.99 USD per month
Benefits: Unlock VIP perks, exclusive boosts, and premium features in BeStar.
Payment: Your iTunes account will be charged at confirmation of purchase.

A beauty salon gathering professional beauticians and high-quality products, offering customized programs from cleansing to maintenance. Through gentle techniques, it awakens ski
bluejetty:00115461:ios.description:
Beauty Salon: Professional Care, Rejuvenating Skin Experience
A beauty salon gathering professional beauticians and high-quality products, offering customized programs from cleansing to maintenance. Through gentle techniques, it awakens skin vitality, allowing every experiencer to enjoy the surprise of hydrated and refreshed skin.
Trendy Boutique: Curated Trends, Personalized Styling Inspiration
Shelves are filled with trendy items sourced globally, where niche designs collide with popular styles. No need to search hard here—you can easily find styling inspiration that fits your personality and create a unique look effortlessly.
Cinema: Visual Feast, Immersive Viewing Experience
Light and shadow flow in the dim theater, with stunning sound surrounding the audience. Whether it’s the delicate emotions of a drama or the grand scenes of a sci-fi film, it makes people temporarily forget the outside world and immerse themselves in the story.
Fashion Week: Cutting-Edge Fashion, Runway Trend Extravaganza
Models walk gracefully under the spotlight, showcasing designers’ latest collections one by one. Tailoring, colors, and creativity interweave into a visual feast, filling the air with the enthusiasm and anticipation of cutting-edge fashion.
Happy Home: Warm Little Home, Family Joy Moments
The living room sofa is soft and comfortable, the kitchen wafts with the aroma of meals, and the balcony is filled with green plants. Family members sit chatting or share dinners—every corner hides the warmth and laughter of daily life.
Supermarket: Convenient Living, Abundant Shopping Choice
Shelves are fully stocked from fresh produce and vegetables to daily necessities, with clearly priced goods neatly arranged. Pushing a shopping cart through, you can easily gather all daily needs, filled with the vibe of everyday life.
Commercial Street: Bustling Shopping District, Vibrant Shopping Experience
Shops line the street one after another—clothing stores, restaurants, milk tea shops. Pedestrians come and go, with shouts and music intermingling. It’s lively during the day and brightly lit at night.
Celebrity Building: Gathering of Stars, Luxury Private Space
The imposing building features exclusive elevators and security. The interior decoration is exquisite and sophisticated, with well-equipped lounges and studios, meeting both celebrities’ work needs and private life protection.
Fashion Design Studio: Creative Workshop, Birthplace of Fashion Design
Cutting tables, fabric racks, and design sketches are scattered around. Designers sometimes gesture to cut, sometimes match fabrics, with the sound of sewing machines and discussions interweaving—each idea takes shape as a fashion prototype here.
-----Subscription Service Description-----
1.Theme scene subscription:
Monthly Pass: $3.99 per month, with automatic monthly renewal
Annual Pass: $29.99 per year, automatically renewed annually
Ads Monthly Pass: $2.99 per month, with automatic monthly renewal
Neo Lux： $0.99 per week, Automatically renew weekly
2. The membership service will be paid directly through the iTunes account.
3. 24 hours before the subscription service expires, the system will automatically renew the subscription and deduct the corresponding fee according to the subscription type.
4. If you need to close the subscription service, please do so in "Account Settings" at least 24 hours in advance.
5.Service Agreement and Privacy Policy :
User Agreement (EULA): https://hdwl.site/ios_user_agreement_builder_en.html
Privacy Policy: https://hdwl.site/hnhd_privatet_en.html

bluejetty:00156892:ios.description:
We created Aurora to make it really simple to create stories with soul. Aurora is the simplest design tool that allows anyone to create aesthetic social media stories and posts - what used to take an hour on your laptop will now just take a few minutes anywhere you are. 
We believe the joy of design should never be only for those who can afford to pay.
That is why half of Aurora will always be free.
> Freely design layouts
Create any design or layout that you can imagine in Aurora, you can even save them for later. 
> Aurora Instant
Create stories in one-tap - Simply select your photos and Aurora will automatically insert them into all possible templates, all you have to do is choose your favorite and share!
> Aurora Studio
Edit Photo and Video with handcrafted film emulations, allowing you to age your content for a nostalgic vibe.
Just some of the design possibilities with Aurora:
- Moodboards
- Collages
- Social Media Stories
- Social Media Posts
- Wallpapers
- And so much more
Aurora is a celebration of your memories. Frame the memory, join the club.
We publish only the best designs that we come up with. And yes, half of the app will always be free as we know that not everyone can afford to pay for premium features. 
We want all of you to be able to express your most authentic selves through design, regardless of money or if you’re a paying or free user. Feel good about your stories!
A diverse design library filled with realistic textures
• Stickers: Pins and tape, text backgrounds, paper tears, abstract art, butterflies, silhouettes, flowers, basic shapes, darkroom doodles and much more.
• Backgrounds: Walls, Paper, Marble, Water, Retro Gradients, Abstract Art and more.
• Text: A collection of handpicked fonts because typography matters. From Serif, Sans Serif, Handwritten, Typewriters, Monospaced and more.
• Overlays: Elevate your designs with realistic overlays that include Shadows, Light, Dust & Grain.
Templates: Easily create beautiful content for social with over 300+ handcrafted templates. Start with an editable template in Canvas when you’re feeling creative or get a beautiful looking design quickly with our Gallery templates.

bluejetty:00029831:ios.description:
Use your existing MyMercy account to manage your health information and communicate with your doctor on your mobile devices.
With MyMercy you can:
• Review test results, medications, immunization history, and more 
• Stay in touch with your physician
• Manage your appointments
• View and pay your bill
• Access your family's health information
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the "Apple Health app", when enrolled in self-tracking programs
• Through a user's Healthkit account they have the ability to track their personal health information such as weight.
• Stay up to date with your MyMercy health feed right from your Apple Watch.
• Learn about new features from our tutorial videos.
• Quickly find what you need with our improved Message Center that groups messages by conversation threads and folders.
• Try our new upcoming tests and procedures activity that replaces the old report-based style 
• Create your own health reminders to help keep your goals on track
You must first create an account through www.mymercy.net. If you require support accessing your existing account, contact us at 1-888-98-MERCY (1-888-986-3729) or visit www.mymercy.net for more help options.
Have feedback about the app? Email us at mymercymobile@mercy.net.

bluejetty:00075490:ios.description:
The Total Connect Comfort app allows users to remotely monitor and manage their heating and cooling system – at anytime, from anywhere. Total Connect Comfort works with Honeywell Home Wi-Fi Thermostats and with Honeywell Home Redlink Comfort Systems when used in conjunction with a Redlink Internet Gateway.
With the Total Connect Comfort app users can:
- View and change the schedule (for thermostats that support this feature)
- View and change heating and cooling system settings
- View and set the indoor temperature
- View and change system fan (for thermostats that support this feature)
- View and change humidifier and dehumidifier settings (for thermostats that support this feature)
- View 5-Day weather forecast
- View outdoor temperature and humidity (when used with an outdoor sensor)
- Access multiple smart thermostats
- Access multiple locations if more than one system is registered
- View thermostat alerts such as high or low temperature
- Use the Demo Mode before purchasing a thermostat
- Automatically upgrade to new features once they become available
Whether a homeowner, business owner or both – users will find comfort in Total Connect Comfort.
