bluejetty:00061826:ios.description:
Live sound with its true feelings. Enjoy recording, playback and audio editing with Voice Recorder. We have fine tuned it for your day-to-day activities. Attending something important and want to record it
for later playback, Voice Recorder will allow you to record your meetings, lectures, and other events with codec noise reduction technology. You can record anything within 10-100 meters around you.
Edit the recording as per your need and save it for later playback. Voice Recorder has multiple playback options helping you decide how you want to hear your recording. Developed specially for Apple, it plays just as excellent with Apple EarPods as it plays with our old earphones.
You can auto upload and even share the recording on cloud (Dropbox) in seconds. 
Voice Recorder is an easy to use and handy app to record the meeting, lecture, music and many more. The interface is designed to make it quick. With single tap you can record and share the recordings.
Enjoy sound, record, edit, play and listen!
List of Features
# Audio Recorder
- Quality options: (Low:8KHz, Medium:22.05KHz, High:44.1KHz)
- Format options: (WAV, CAF, M4A)
- External input device support : Bluetooth Mic, Other External Mic (Tested with Tascam mic)
- Background recording support
(New)
- Continue recording into existing recordings.
- Call Interruption handling - Recording will continue after a call or other interruption.
# Audio Player
- Quick audio player
- Playback controls (Fast backward, Fast backward)
- External output device support (Bluetooth and External speaker devices)
- Background audio playing
# Audio Trimming
- Select a part of recording and trim it.
# Sharing
- Email recordings
- Dropbox sharing (Auto upload recording support)
- Upload to iCloud Drive
- Import recordings to computer with iTunes file sharing
- Airdrop sharing with iOS and Mac devices.
# Universal App
- Support for both iPhone and iPad devices.
# AVAILABLE IN 11 DIFFERENT LANGUAGE
English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português (Br.),Português, Italiano, 中文 (Simplified), Русский, 日本語, 한국어

bluejetty:00014788:ios.summary: Task Office is the best of ever existing GTD, to do lists, projects and contacts management apps. Designed to make business planning, scheduling and getting things done more efficient, Task Office makes your plans clear and achievable. Mana
bluejetty:00014788:ios.description:
Task Office is the best of ever existing GTD, to do lists, projects and contacts management apps. Designed to make business planning, scheduling and getting things done more efficient, Task Office makes your plans clear and achievable. Manage both simple and complex projects, to do lists without any difficulties and focus on the final result. Manage your contacts and relationships, schedule your time and succeed. 
Planning & Performing
• Start scheduling each new day on Home screen. Here you will find your current projects and to dos: a timeline with tasks you have planned for today and outline of upcoming tasks. Home screen allows you to focus only on current tasks, planned for today, and not to get lost in plenty of other planned tasks. You can plan your day directly from Home screen creating new tasks, projects, contacts and companies
Quick & Easy navigation
• Reach any project, task, to do list or contact in seconds. Task Office is designed in a way that will allow you to navigate within app screens just in one tap
• Organize your tasks by categories, projects or priorities and make a logic order of all your plans
Detailed GTD
• Add all important details to get things done: choose tasks category, status, priority and set dates
• Assign tasks to people by choosing a person from all existing contacts 
• Add locations to each task and project
• Make all your information categorized – assign special categories for easy filtering and browsing through tasks and projects
Comprehensive GTD Tab
• All tasks are organized according to GTD methodology (by D. Allen)
• Add tasks of different types: 
- ToDo – tasks with duration of several days
- Appointment – assign task duration accurate to minutes
- Email/Call – short task for making calls or sending emails to any user
Alerts
• Use double alert and let the program remind you what is next to be done
Tracking project progress
• Track the progress of your projects and to do lists by viewing the pipeline: view the percentage of work performed and how many tasks still need to be done
• Check out everyone who is involved in project: view the list of contacts involved in the project
Managing your team
• Create new contacts and companies; add all the important information about your contact or company. Either you can import existing contact from your device Address Book
• Send e-mails directly from Contacts Screen
• Group your contacts creating your Private Lists, so that you can easily monitor their productivity and track task implementation. Save each Private list and refer back to easily
Visualized Calendar
• Task Office calendar allows you to focus on what is important in your timeline. See your planed To Dos, Appointments, Emails/Calls to get things done in time
• View calendar by day, week or month
• Add tasks directly to the Calendar by Tap&Hold
• Change tasks duration or Start and Due Dates simply Drag&Drop
Calendar Syncing
• Task Office syncs with Calendars (iCloud, Google Calendar, Exchange, Yahoo, Outlook) and you will not miss anything checking out due dates
iCloud Sync
• Sync your information – tasks, projects, contacts, etc. – between your devices
Repeating tasks
• Add repeated tasks, choosing recurrences frequency
Set goals and achieve them. Become a part of Task Office team today!

bluejetty:00023298:ios.description:
Quran with English Translation and Interpretation (Tafsir)
Our Quran reader app gives you a pleasant experience with its intuitive interface, and offers you a stylish way to read Quran and its interpretation (tafsir) on your smartphones and tablets.
The app features: 
• Complete Quran like the actual Mus'haf
• Translation of each verse in English by Abbas Sadr-Ameli
• English Interpretation of verses of Quran as per Ahlul-Bayt school of thought: An Enlightening Commentary into the Light of the Holy Qur'an by Sayyid Kamal Faqhih Imani linked to each verse
• Displaying word-by-word English translation for each ayah and ability to play the Arabic pronunciation of a word in an ayah
• Transliteration of Quran (Roman characters) to read Quran in Arabic
• Verse-by-verse audio recitation by multiple reciters (Abdulbasit, Al-Minshawi, Maytham Al-Tammar,...)
• Exclusive English audio translation (Sadr-Ameli), verse by verse
• Quran Khatmah based on the amount of daily recitation or start and end dates

bluejetty:00042156:ios.name: Andronico's Deals & Shopping
bluejetty:00042156:ios.summary:
Andronico's Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Andronico's all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your
bluejetty:00042156:ios.description:
Andronico's Grocery Deals & Delivery 
Shop, save & simplify your meal planning with Andronico's all-in-one grocery app. Find everything you need, from fresh produce to pet food and pharmacy prescriptions.  Choose convenience that fits your schedule: grocery delivery or DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup service. 
CONVENIENT GROCERY DELIVERY OR PICKUP 
Get grocery delivery or choose DriveUp & Go™ for easy curbside grocery pickup. Use Schedule & Save to automate your household essentials and save more on every order. Flash™ 30-minute delivery available in select markets for additional convenience. 
SEND GROCERIES AS A GIFT 
Shop, add a personalized message & send fresh groceries, flowers, chocolates or everyday essentials to anyone — delivered to their door or ready for store pickup. Select "Make this order a gift" at checkout, with no extra gifting fees. It is the perfect way to care for loved ones, celebrate special occasions, send a thoughtful thank-you gift or help out a friend with a fully stocked fridge. 
MEET YOUR AI SHOPPING ASSISTANT 
Take the guesswork out of meals with Ask AI. Use everyday language to ask for recipe ideas, find items based on dietary needs or compare products. Whether you're asking "What can I make with chicken and rice?" or looking for "gluten-free snacks," our assistant helps you build your grocery list fast. 
MEAL PLANNING & RECIPES 
Get inspired with thousands of shoppable recipes designed to fit every budget and preference. Import your favorite recipes into the app to convert ingredients into a digital shopping list. Plan your weekly menu & add all necessary items to your grocery shopping list with a single tap. 
SHOP EASIER & FASTER 
Quickly add items to your cart based on frequent purchases, recommendations & past orders. View and reorder from your order history at any time. Save your favorite household items, scan barcodes at home to add products to your digital cart instantly and build repeatable shopping lists. 
LOYALTY, DEALS & COUPONS 
Maximize your budget by clipping digital coupons, tracking your reward points and watching your savings stack up automatically at checkout. Find hundreds of weekly grocery coupons, digital offers and exclusive sales. Earn, track and redeem Andronico's for U™ rewards automatically as you shop. Try FreshPass® for unlimited free grocery delivery on eligible orders, exclusive perks and subscriber-only savings. 
SECURE SNAP/EBT & WIC PAYMENT OPTIONS 
Use your SNAP/EBT benefits to easily pay for online grocery delivery and DriveUp & Go™ grocery pickup orders on eligible items, subject to state availability. WIC benefits are also accepted in store at participating Andronico's locations only. 
YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD PHARMACY & HEALTH APP 
Order eligible prescriptions in the app and pick them up curbside through DriveUp & Go™ at 1,700+ participating pharmacy locations nationwide. Transfer your prescriptions to save more on your next grocery order, refill scripts for your family or pets, schedule vaccine appointments, access health tests and manage your wellness goals with Sincerely Health. Choose to bundle your Rx with your grocery pickup in one easy trip or go pharmacy-only. 
BUILD HEALTHY HABITS 
Monitor your nutrition, steps, sleep and activity. Earn rewards as you eat better, move more and stay active through the Sincerely Health wellness hub. Take advantage of custom health insights, track your daily wellness metrics, unlock premium rewards for making positive health choices and set achievable goals that support your complete physical well-being. 
Download the Andronico's app and sign in or create your account to start shopping, saving and simplifying your week.

bluejetty:00039175:ios.description:
• Проверка штрафов ГИБДД по автомобилю и водителю онлайн;
• Подробная информация о штрафах, включая карту с местом нарушения;
• Уведомления о новых штрафах ГИБДД по электронной почте и в приложении;
• Оплата штрафов ГИБДД с 25% скидкой;
• Напоминания об истечении срока оплаты;
• Оплачивайте штрафы банковскими картами Visa и Mastercard;
• Погашение штрафов ГИБДД всего за 2 рабочих дня;
• Часто задаваемые вопросы и поддержка пользователей в разделе Помощь.
Подробнее о приложении:
Проверка штрафов ГИБДД происходит в режиме онлайн, данные из баз госорганов отображаются в реальном времени. Это обеспечивает максимальную точность информации о штрафах.
Информация о штрафах включает в себя статью КОАП, место нарушения с отметкой на карте, наименование подразделения ГИБДД, выписавшего штраф, сроки оплаты штрафа.
Подпишитесь на бесплатные уведомления о новых штрафах по электронной почте или в приложении. Вы всегда будете узнавать о новых штрафах вовремя.
В соответствии с Федеральным законом от 22 декабря 2014 г. № 437-ФЗ, вы сможете оплачивать штрафы ГИБДД со скидкой 25%. Мы также напомним об истечении льготного срока оплаты штрафа, чтобы вы успели ей воспользоваться. 
Оплачивайте штрафы ГИБДД банковскими картами Visa и Mastercard. Чек об оплате отправляется вам по электронной почте, копия чека сохраняется в разделе Архив. 
Средний срок погашения штрафа ГИБДД - 2 рабочих дня, это намного быстрее, чем при оплате другими способами.
Проверка штрафов ГИБДД займет меньше минуты. Введите номер авто и свидетельство о регистрации, чтобы проверить штрафы ГИБДД по автомобилю или номер водительского удостоверения, чтобы проверить штрафы ГИБДД по водителю. 
Штрафы ГИБДД проверяются по всей России, вы узнаете о своем штрафе, даже если вы “поймали” его в другом регионе.
Мы гарантируем погашение штрафов, оплаченных через наше приложение. Мы дополнительно уведомляем соответствующие органы (ГАИ, ГИБДД и казначейство) о факте оплаты. Это гарантирует, что ваша оплата не потеряется.
В разделе Помощь собраны ответы на часто задаваемые вопросы автомобилистов и есть возможность задать свой вопрос через форму обратной связи.
В случае возникновения вопросов, пожалуйста, свяжитесь с нами по адресу support@shtrafy-gibdd.ru.
Оплата штрафов ГИБДД осуществляется НКО “МОНЕТА.РУ” (ООО). Лицензия ЦБ РФ №3508-К от 2 июля 2012 года

Оферта: https://r.shtrafy-gibdd.ru/docs/oferta_shtrafy.html

bluejetty:00120500:ios.name: Preschool & Kindergarten Games
bluejetty:00120500:ios.summary:

The app is perfect for kids from 3 to 6 years old. Whether your child is a curious toddler, starting preschool, or in kindergar
bluejetty:00120500:ios.description:
Millions of parents and teachers use our Preschool & Kindergarten Games to educate and entertain young children.
The app is perfect for kids from 3 to 6 years old. Whether your child is a curious toddler, starting preschool, or in kindergarten, they will find RosiMosi games fun and amusing. At the same time, our games are not only about playing. They are designed using real-world preschool and kindergarten curricula and Common Core State Standards. 
Preschool & Kindergarten Games cover the following learning topics: 
ABCs & READING 
- Letters: Learn letters with helpful pictures and voices
- Letter Tracing: Use your finger to draw upper and lower case letters
- Alphabet: Pop bubbles while learning the alphabet
- Upper and Lower Case: Match upper and lower case letters by dragging them together
- Phonics: Match a picture to the phonic sound
- Vowels and Consonants: Identify vowels and consonants in words and the alphabet
- Sight Words: Play bingo and identify over 100 words
- Spelling: Spell hundreds of words with helpful voice narration
- Rhyming: Listen and match rhyming words together
- Nouns and Verbs: Identify the difference between nouns and verbs, a building block for reading
MATH 
- Counting: Count with helpful voice narration to learn numbers
- Addition: Add fruit together to learn addition
- Number Tracing: Draw and trace numbers
- Counting Down: Count down from 10 and launch a rocket
- Missing Numbers: Find the missing number in the sequence
- Quantity: Learn what a number actually means
- Missing Numbers: Find the missing number in the sequence
- Measure: Compare short and tall objects and heavy vs light objects
- Ordinal Numbers: Learn the ordinal names for numbers, such as first, second, and third
- More, Less, Equal: Play with marbles and learn the concept of more, less, and equal
LEARNING ESSENTIALS:
- Shapes and Colors: Identify shape and color differences
- Sorting: Learn to sort in multiple ways, including size, color, and more
- Memory: Flip and match cards to help improve memory and attention
- Positions: Learn left, right, and center. Important for preschool and kindergarten
- Months: Sort the months and put them in the correct order
- Color Mix-Up: Fill in the picture by combining the correct colors to make new combinations
- Patterns: Identify repeating patterns using fun animals
- Puzzles: Fun and colorful puzzles, with cute animals
- Emotions: Identify different emotions on real faces
- Months: Sort the months and put them in the correct order
- Differences: Use a critical eye to find differences in a variety of fun scenes
Advanced Features in the Full Version Include:
- Detailed progress reports to help track your child's development
- Lesson builder to create specific plans for your child to follow and play
- Multiple user support so up to 6 kids can play on the same app
- Avatars, stickers, and backgrounds for kids to unlock as they learn
- ClassKit support for teachers and educators
Helpful voice narrating, colorful graphics, and fun sound effects will help your pre-k child learn letters, spelling, math, and more! Kindergarten and preschool kids love these games!
===
Terms of Use and Privacy Policy: https://www.rosimosi.com/privacy
===
PROBLEMS WITH THE GAME?
If you are having any issues with the game, please email us at help@rosimosi.com, and we will get it fixed for you ASAP.

PERFECT FOR

bluejetty:00151778:ios.description:
Never lose an important detail from a phone call again. Call Recorder records your incoming and outgoing calls on iPhone, keeps every recording in one place and turns conversations into text in over 30 languages.
PERFECT FOR
- Business calls: capture prices, deadlines and agreements exactly as they were said
- Interviews: focus on the conversation and get a transcript afterwards
- Doctors, banks and support lines: replay instructions, reference numbers and what was agreed whenever you need them
- Lessons and coaching: listen again at your own pace
- Family calls: keep the voices and moments that matter to you
EVERYTHING YOU NEED IN ONE APP
- Record incoming and outgoing calls in a few taps: just merge the call with our recording line
- Read your calls as text: transcription in over 30 languages
- Find the right moment fast: tap anywhere on the waveform to jump there
- Keep listening in the background and control playback from the Lock Screen
- Rename and trim recordings to keep only what matters
- Send recordings with AirDrop, Mail, Messages and other apps, and share transcripts as text
- Protect your recordings with a passcode, Face ID or Touch ID
- Sign in with your phone number and your recordings come back with you
WHAT YOU NEED
- iPhone with iOS 15 or later
- Call merging (three-way calling) on your carrier plan
- A phone number from one of the 18 countries with a recording line; choose your country in the app
- Works with regular phone calls, not WhatsApp or FaceTime. You start recording for each call you choose.
- All step-by-step instructions are shown right in the app.
SUBSCRIPTION
Premium unlocks all features: call recording, access to your recordings and speech recognition. One monthly plan, no introductory offer. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically every month at the same price unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. To cancel, go to Settings > [your name] > Subscriptions on your iPhone. Deleting the app does not cancel the subscription.
Privacy Policy: https://smart-mobile-apps.com/callrec/privacy.html

bluejetty:00129689:ios.name: Archer Review NCLEX
bluejetty:00129689:ios.summary:
Archer Next-Generation NCLEX – with a single motto to Make Quality Test Prep Affordable & Effective!
Over several years, Archer Review has provided affordable and successful courses to nursing students, medical students, and physicians. Ar
bluejetty:00129689:ios.description:
Archer Next-Generation NCLEX – with a single motto to Make Quality Test Prep Affordable & Effective!
Over several years, Archer Review has provided affordable and successful courses to nursing students, medical students, and physicians. Archer applies a high-yield focused test preparation strategy to help you prepare SMART. Good test-prep courses need not be pricey, and Archer is moving forward with this single motto. Since 2020, about 200,000 nursing students and nurses have trusted Archer Review and have reported high pass rates.
Archer NCLEX products include:
1. Question banks 
2. On-demand videos 
3. Combos (question banks and on-demand videos)
- A large number of questions (next-generation NCLEX items and legacy items spread out according to the new NGN-NCLEX pattern): 
A. 2950+ NCLEX-RN questions on an interface that mimics the real NCLEX exam 
B. 1100+ NCLEX-PN questions. High-yield new questions are added almost every week so that you will see a continuously increasing number of critically important questions.
- Multiple prediction assessments: Multiple readiness assessments can be launched. Assessing yourself frequently helps you know your readiness throughout your prep compared to assessing just at the end of the prep. 
- Computer Adaptive Testing (CAT) mode: Like NCLEX, CAT adapts to your performance and sequentially delivers questions to simulate NCLEX. 
- 98% pass rate confidence: Among the Archer Q-bank users who took the exam after completing all the sure-pass criteria and achieving consecutive highs on four assessments, the pass rate has been 98%.
- The Power of Rationales: In-depth and detailed explanations (rationales). Additional information sections provide in-depth details, while the body of the rationale provides focused information. Multiple concepts are explained in a single question, so you understand why a specific option is incorrect. 
- Challenging Questions: The questions will challenge you. While the questions can be challenging, the goal is to challenge you and explain the subject within the explanation. Learning is enhanced under stress – we use this scientific concept to challenge you hard, so you study and retain the explanation better. Review your performance, weak and strong, under previous tests.
- Tutor/ Test and Timed modes: Tutor mode allows you to see the rationale immediately, whereas Timed mode simulates the actual testing atmosphere. Create comprehensive tests on the go or practice questions in your weak areas via—system-based question review. 
- Ability to launch tests based on NCSBN client need areas. This is particularly useful for those with prior NCLEX attempts to launch and practice tests in their weak client-need areas. 
- "Peer Stats" provides you with information to compare yourself with your peers regarding every question and the overall test. Your score compared to the average peer score lets you assess your readiness for the exam.
- Videos: Our unique "video rationales" accompany some essential topics repeatedly tested on NCLEX. Once again, Archer's strategy is to help you retain concepts through "audio-visual reinforcement" while quizzing you.
- Multiple test item types: All next-generation NCLEX item types (unfolding case studies, other standalone new NGN items), single choice, SATA (select all that apply), fill in the blanks, ordered sequence, audios/ images questions with a large proportion of questions being SATA to reflect the actual exam distribution.
- Performance dashboards to analyze your weak and strong areas. System-wise breakdown and client-needs data are presented.
Combo products include 
- All features of the Q-bank 
- On-Demand videos covering every client need area tested on the NCLEX. Videos are updated after every live review. Both the videos of live review crash courses and topic-wise videos are included in the On-Demand bundles. 
- Money-back guarantee (SurePass combo users only)
https://archerreview.com/terms-and-conditions

bluejetty:00128074:ios.description:
Imagine 64 animals of all types, from the relaxed capybara to the majestic Phoenix, living freely and happily with their young inside a huge alien spacecraft created to protect our fauna.
That's the goal of Idle Star Zoo. But first you have to save them all! 
SAVE THE ANIMALS!
Travel across Earth's continents and rescue all the helpless little animals: from the most common to mythical ones like the Dragon and the Unicorn! 
KEEP THEM HAPPY!
Lots of animals make a lot of mess! Upgrade your habitats and keep them clean at all times. Oh, and don't forget to take good care of your animals because they need a lot of love!
EXPAND YOUR HABITATS!
The more animals you save, the more coins you earn and the more habitats you can unlock, so everyone can be together, safe and happy in your zoo!
COMBINE THE ANIMALS!
Habitat full? No problem! You can merge five of the same animal to generate an even cuter version of it! 
HAVE FUN WITH MINIGAMES!
In addition to the satisfaction of saving those in need, you can enjoy lots of fun minigames!
Ready to save all the animals? Play Idle Star Zoo and make that dream come true!

bluejetty:00025924:ios.name: Battlesmiths: Medieval Battle
bluejetty:00025924:ios.summary: Battlesmiths – The Forge of Legends in an Epic Medieval Strategy! Step into the shoes of a master blacksmith in the perilous age of the Middle Ages. Craft powerful swords and unique armor, manage your village, and lead your heroes into tact
bluejetty:00025924:ios.description:
Battlesmiths – The Forge of Legends in an Epic Medieval Strategy! Step into the shoes of a master blacksmith in the perilous age of the Middle Ages. Craft powerful swords and unique armor, manage your village, and lead your heroes into tactical battles. This isn’t just an RPG — it’s a strategy game where every decision shapes the outcome of war.
The Art of Blacksmithing and Trade
Take charge of your forge and master the ancient craft. Hone your skills to create one-of-a-kind equipment — from razor-sharp blades to unbreakable armor. Gather resources to keep your construction running and ensure your forge never cools down. Your craftsmanship is the key to victory in the battles to come.
Build trade connections in the bustling city. Sell your goods to help your village thrive and improve your warriors’ gear. Every strategic choice in the marketplace directly influences your military strength.
Combat and War Strategy
Assemble a squad of mighty warriors and mages. Engage in tactical battles where your strategy and foresight mean everything. Compete in epic PvP duels against real opponents or conquer the levels of the Tower of Trials!
An Epic Adventure Awaits
Dive into a rich storyline filled with intrigue, quests, and villains. Your legacy is forged not only in steel but also in triumphs on the battlefield. Develop your heroes, fine-tune their equipment and abilities, and lead your team to victory. Every decision in this tactical RPG brings you closer to mastery.
Game Features
- Unique Blacksmithing System: Forge legendary blades, armor, and magical artifacts.
- Turn-Based Battles: Tactical strategy and autobattler mechanics combined.
- Immersive Medieval World: Explore vast lands, fight in arenas and dungeons.
- Trade and Economy: Make deals, manage resources, and grow your wealth.
- Clan System: Join forces with other players for greater strength.
- PvP Arenas and Tower of Trials: For true masters of strategy and skill.
Battlesmiths is an RPG strategy where craftsmanship and intellect decide everything. From the anvil to the battlefield — your courage and skill will determine the fate of your realm.

bluejetty:00024405:ios.name: Moonshot - A Journey Home
bluejetty:00024405:ios.summary:
Moonshot is a physics-based puzzle game where you play as Moon Pi, a young moon separated from Mother Earth. Using slingshot mechanics and navigational puzzles, help Moon Pi trek across the mysterious universe to finally get back home.
Gam
bluejetty:00024405:ios.description:
Moonshot is a physics-based puzzle game where you play as Moon Pi, a young moon separated from Mother Earth. Using slingshot mechanics and navigational puzzles, help Moon Pi trek across the mysterious universe to finally get back home.
Gameplay:
In Moonshot, use a simple drag and release mechanic to launch yourself past other planet's gravity fields, all while avoiding dangerous traps like black holes, aliens and other strange space phenomena in your quest back to Mother Earth.
Moonshot is for anyone who loves playing slingshot and physics-based casual puzzle games that also can test their precision and speed. Navigate through levels full of fun obstacles and boosters, uncovering optimal paths that take the least amount of moves to finish.
Each week players will also be challenged to compete in special events, and be rewarded with prizes and rare skins for Moon Pi.
Features:
• 126 levels spread across 7 unique worlds
• Innovative physics-based space puzzle game with a gravity twist
• Weekly challenges to unlock rare skins
• A visual delight to look at, listen to and play
• Stunning level designs, full of obstacles, super powers, and boosters that require speed and precision
• 35 different skins and fun themed outfits
• 50 achievements
• A heartwarming adventure story
• Easy to learn and play, hard to master
• iCloud support — Play on your iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV and your progress will always be in sync

bluejetty:00013840:ios.name: Sella
bluejetty:00013840:ios.summary:
Scarica l’app Sella, l’applicazione di mobile banking con un design rinnovato e nuove soluzioni per gestire le tue finanze in modo ancora più semplice.
• Accedi all’app in modo rapido e sicuro con le modalità disponibili nel tuo dispositi
bluejetty:00013840:ios.description:
Scarica l’app Sella, l’applicazione di mobile banking con un design rinnovato e nuove soluzioni per gestire le tue finanze in modo ancora più semplice.
• Accedi all’app in modo rapido e sicuro con le modalità disponibili nel tuo dispositivo: la tua impronta digitale o il riconoscimento del viso.
• Gestisci i tuoi conti e le carte, anche di altre banche, in un’unica app. 
• Personalizza la tua homepage selezionando i widget che ti interessano di più, per un accesso rapido alle tue funzionalità preferite: puoi visualizzare i movimenti recenti, il PIN della tua carta, creare e gestirei budget, monitorare le statistiche di spesa e molto altro ancora.
• Raggiungi i tuoi obiettivi di risparmio grazie alla funzionalità “salvadanaio”.
• Con “Invia denaro” puoi scambiare denaro in modo semplice e immediato con altri contatti che utilizzano l’app Sella.
• Nella sezione “Operazioni” trovi tutte le possibilità di pagamento, tra cui bollettini, PagoPA, CBill e F24, resi più immediati grazie all’uso della camera del tuo device.
Banca Sella si impegna a rendere sempre più accessibili il proprio sito web e le proprie app, aggiornando i servizi offerti e adottando le migliori soluzioni tecnologiche per garantire l'utilizzo dei servizi online nel rispetto delle linee guida AgID. Per ulteriori informazioni sull'accessibilità delle nostre app consulta le dichiarazioni di accessibilità nell'apposita sezione del sito Sella.it : https://www.sella.it/banca-on-line/accessibilita
Per maggiori informazioni, suggerimenti e per assistenza scarica l'app e contattaci direttamente in chat.  Se ti piace l'app, condividi la tua opinione sullo store!

bluejetty:00072288:ios.description:
Introducing our American Sign Language learning app - the perfect tool for anyone who wants to learn the language of the Deaf community! Our app is designed to help you learn ASL in a fun, engaging and interactive way. Whether you're a complete beginner or looking to improve your existing skills, our app has everything you need to get started.
With a wide range of lessons and tutorials, you'll be able to learn ASL at your own pace, whenever and wherever you want. Our app features high-quality videos, images and graphics to help you understand the signs and gestures used in ASL. You'll also have access to quizzes and exercises to test your knowledge and track your progress.
Our app is perfect for anyone who wants to communicate with the Deaf community, or for anyone who simply wants to learn a new and exciting sign language. Whether you're learning for personal or professional reasons, our ASL learning app is the ideal choice for you.

bluejetty:00033411:ios.description:
America is in great need of spiritual and cultural renewal. This app provides a digital platform that cultivates community among Bible-believing Christians who want to strengthen their faith, understand how to better live out their faith in the public square, and be salt and light in government and culture. It will equip you with news and resources to cultivate a biblical worldview and be spiritually, governmentally, and culturally active.
It will include:
1. News and Commentary Through the Lens of a Biblical Worldview:
Articles, interviews, podcasts, and other resources covering current events from The Washington Stand, Washington Watch, Outstanding podcast, and other sources will be compiled and easily accessible in the app. They can be shared with others and each story will include a way to specifically pray for it.
2. United Prayer:
There will be specific ways to pray for news stories and current events so that you can take the next step. There will also be prayer community so you can join with others around the nation praying for important matters. 
3. Bible Reading Plan and Biblical Worldview Resources:
Participate with others in an engaging two-year Bible plan and access publications that help you apply a biblical lens to today’s pressing cultural issues. 
4. Community Groups:
Connect with like-minded individuals across the nation in community groups to pray together, share thoughts, discuss, and encourage each other. 
5. Government and Culture Engagement:
Receive updates on current ways to take meaningful action and get involved through petitions, contacting your elected officials, voter information and resources, and other action steps.

Whether you are diving into italian language learning, mastering german language learning, exploring a french learning app experience or ready to learn portuguese, Sounter makes every lesson feel like your favorite playlist. It's like language reactor but with music.
WHY SOUNTER
Experience a new way to learn languages that adapts to your taste and your pace. Sounter leverages your favorite songs to teach vocabulary, pronunciation and cultural context—all without traditional drills or textbooks. You won’t just memorize words; you’ll sing them, repeat them and internalize them naturally.
KEY FEATURES
• Personalized music-based course: turn any song into an interactive lesson
• Extensive multilingual catalog: Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese and more
• Real-time lyric exercises: complete lyrics while listening and get instant feedback
• Offline learning mode: download videos and lyrics to practice anywhere
• Adaptive difficulty: lessons adjust to your level, from beginner to advanced
• Vocabulary builder: tap on any word to see definitions, examples and pronunciation
• Progress tracking: monitor your streaks, mastered words and completed songs
UNIQUE BENEFITS
• Engage with authentic content: learn from real music instead of artificial examples
• Boost retention: scientific evidence shows music enhances memory and recall
• Learn faster: songs stick in your mind, so you acquire new vocabulary in minutes
• Stay motivated: combining entertainment and education keeps you coming back
• Cultural immersion: discover the nuances and slang of native speakers
• Holistic skills: practice listening, reading, speaking and writing in one session
HOW IT SOLVES YOUR PROBLEM
Traditional apps can feel repetitive, disconnected or boring. Sounter solves this by embedding learning directly into songs you love. Say goodbye to rote flashcards and hello to immersive sessions that feel more like entertainment than study. You’ll notice progress in comprehension, pronunciation and confidence as you engage with meaningful, enjoyable content.
SUPPORTED LANGUAGES
• Spanish learning app: comprehensive courses for Latin America and European Spanish
• French learning app: rich catalogue of chansons and pop hits for every learner
• Italian language learning: immerse yourself in Italian hits, from classics to modern tracks
• German language learning: extensive library of German-language songs to build fluency
• Learn Portuguese: Brazilian and European playlists curated for learners
WHY LEARN WITH MUSIC
Music is proven to activate memory centers more effectively than traditional methods. When lyrics loop in your mind, you absorb grammar structures and vocabulary subconsciously. Sounter combines cognitive science and user-friendly technology to help you speak and understand new languages faster and more naturally than ever before.
WHAT USERS LOVE
• Effortless onboarding: start learning in seconds with no configuration
• Seamless integration: link your favorite playlists or explore curated collections
• Community-driven recommendations: discover trending songs that other learners enjoy
• No hidden fees: access core content for free and upgrade anytime for premium features
GET STARTED TODAY
Ready to transform your language journey? Download Sounter now and join millions of learners who have unlocked new skills by singing along to their favorite tracks. Whether you’re seeking a top-tier spanish learning app, pursuing italian language learning goals, or exploring multiple languages at once, Sounter delivers an engaging, effective and fun experience. Embrace a smarter way to learn languages—your next favorite song is waiting.

Looking to stay on top of your track progress? Look no further than Stopwatch app for Sport & Work! This versatile tool is ideal for a wide range of activities, including sports, work, hobbies, and daily tasks. Whether you're focusing on a particular project, tracking your progress in running or swimming, or simply looking for a way to manage your time more effectively, Stopwatch has got you covered.

And with the ability to group your time measurements by boards, you can stay organized and on top of your goals at all times. Plus, you can now run several stopwatches at once, making it easier than ever to manage multiple activities at once.
But that's not all. Stopwatch is also packed with great features designed to help you stay focused and on track. With a simple and intuitive interface, you can easily start and stop timers with just a few taps. And with the ability to run Stopwatch in the background, you can keep track of your progress without interrupting your work or play.

It's simple, it's powerful, and it's the ultimate way to take control of your activities and your life. So get started today and see just how much of a difference Stopwatch can make!

bluejetty:00126634:ios.description:
Location: Your Comprehensive Location and Orientation Companion
Discover the power of myLocation, a user-friendly tool designed to simplify location search and sharing. With just a few screen clicks, effortlessly navigate between your current and specified locations. Need to uncover the coordinates or address of your current spot? Look no further than iLocation (ife).
Whether you have an important appointment to explain or find yourself in need of your current whereabouts, my Location has you covered. Simply pin your desired location on the map and effortlessly select your preferred transportation method to share it with others.
Key Features at a Glance:
While traveling with a vehicle (car, bicycle, etc.), while hiking or climbing, you can instantly discover your location and altitude, direction, geographic coordinate, address and atmospheric pressure on the map. While following your direction on a detailed compass screen, you can also monitor the change in altitude. You can share the photos you take with your loved ones, including your altitude, geographic coordinates and address information. Depending on the shooting angle, the compass direction is also included in the photos.
DISCOVER YOUR HEIGHT FROM SEA ON THE MAP (Normal Mode)
You can instantly discover the information of your location on the map
- Altitude (elevation) above sea level
- Open air (atmosphere) pressure
- Latitude and longitude coordinates and address
- Speed in motion
- Direction with a detailed compass
- KML sharing
- PDF sharing
FOLLOW YOUR HEIGHT FROM SEA ON THE MAP ON THE MOVE (Track Mode on the Map)
On the map when traveling in a vehicle (car, bike, etc.), hiking or climbing, you can instantly track your location and the base in information
- Altitude (elevation) above sea level
- Open air (atmosphere) pressure
- Latitude and longitude coordinates and address
- Speed in motion
- Direction with a detailed compass
FOLLOW YOUR HEIGHT FROM SEA ON THE COMPASS (Compass Mode)
While traveling with a vehicle (car, bicycle, etc.), while taking a walk or climbing, you can instantly track your direction and the altitude of your current location
SHARE YOUR PHOTO WITH YOUR LOVED ONES WITH HEIGHT AND DIRECTION INFORMATION (Sharing Mode)
While traveling with a vehicle (car, bike, etc.), hiking or climbing, you can share the photos you have taken with this information
- Height, pressure, coordinate and address information will be on the photo
- Depending on the shooting angle, the compass direction will be added to the photo
IMPORTANT REMINDER ABOUT CALCULATION METHOD AND ACCURACY
- The coordinates of the altitude and location are calculated using the GPS signals of the device used
- There may be differences in the measurement values depending on the GPS signal quality of the device's location
- Just below the height value, the accuracy value of the measurement is given instantly in meters
- Compass accuracy may be affected by magnetic or environmental interference
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERM
• Auto-renewable subscription
• Pro Version is only $6,49/month. 
Pricing in other countries may vary and charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country you live in.
The Pro Version subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go into your iTunes user account settings to manage your auto-renew and subscription settings.
Visit the site for Terms and Conditions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy : https://ikbalyasar.github.io/smsgonderapp/iLocation.html
Contact
ikbalyasar@gmail.com

bluejetty:00017469:ios.description:
Download the Official West Virginia Lottery App (iPlay) and Experience the Fun Anywhere!
With the West Virginia Lottery App, you can take the excitement with you wherever you go. Play your favorite iLottery instant games and draw games, see the latest jackpot amounts, and check winning numbers—all right from your mobile device anywhere in West Virginia.
Easily scan any draw-game ticket or Scratch-off to find out instantly if you’re a winner and be the first to discover the newest games as soon as they’re released. You can also locate retail partners near you, save your favorite numbers and save a digital play slip for your favorite in-store games.
The app gives you exclusive access to the PlayOn® Loyalty Program, where every play earns you points. Redeem points for more chances to win, enter Second Chance promotions, and unlock exciting rewards that keep the fun going whether purchased online or in-store.
Creating or logging into your secure iPlay account ensures your gameplay, purchases, and personal information are always protected with trusted, secure technology. For 40 years, the West Virginia Lottery has proudly served the state with fairness, integrity, and entertainment you can trust.

• Safe and encrypted transactions to protect purchases and deposits

• Fraud prevention and identity verification to protect your account

bluejetty:00180392:ios.summary:
Build custom HIIT, Tabata, boxing, and circuit timers with multiple intervals, rounds, warm-up, and rest periods — then let audio beeps, visual cues, and haptic feedback keep you on track so you never have to watch the clock.
APPLE HEALTH
bluejetty:00180392:ios.description:
Build custom HIIT, Tabata, boxing, and circuit timers with multiple intervals, rounds, warm-up, and rest periods — then let audio beeps, visual cues, and haptic feedback keep you on track so you never have to watch the clock.
APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Completed timers can save as workouts in Apple Health and contribute to your Activity Rings. Opt in once, tag the timers you want to track (HIIT, Boxing, Yoga, and more), and BeepWatch credits the rings — even when you start the timer on iPhone. Heart rate and active energy from your Apple Watch attach automatically.
GET STARTED IN SECONDS
Choose from 15 ready-made presets including HIIT, Tabata, Boxing Rounds, Pomodoro Focus, Meditation, and more. Or build your own timer in under a minute.
CUSTOM INTERVAL TIMERS
* Add as many intervals as you need, each with its own duration, name, sound, and warning
* Set total rounds or run infinitely
* Add warm-up time before your first interval
* Add rest time between rounds
* Count up or count down — six display modes to choose from
AUDIO, VISUAL & HAPTIC ALERTS
* Choose from beeps, buzzes, clicks, gongs, whistles, and more
* Set warning alerts before an interval ends
* Flash the screen on interval changes
* Haptic vibration feedback
* Independent volume control for interval and control sounds
* Background tick audio to confirm your timer is running
TRACK YOUR PERFORMANCE
* Automatic and manual lap recording
* View split times and deltas
* Share lap data with your coach or training partner
BEAUTIFUL THEMES & PROGRESS BARS
* 20+ color themes including Neon, Aurora, and Sunset
* Circle, rows, chronograph, and box progress indicators
* Precision timing up to 3 decimal places
APPLE WATCH
* Full timer sync between iPhone and Apple Watch
* Run timers independently on your wrist, or remote-control the timers on your iPhone
* Workouts save to Apple Health from either device, with cross-device dedup so you never get double entries
* Optimized Watch interface
NOT JUST FOR WORKOUTS
BeepWatch works for anything you time: Pomodoro focus blocks, study sprints, meditation, sport drills, public-speaking practice, recipe steps, and getting kids through morning routines.
SHARE TIMERS
* Share any timer via link or file
* Recipients preview and import with one tap
* Perfect for coaches, trainers, and workout groups
NOW IN 12 LANGUAGES
BeepWatch speaks Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Italian, Hindi, Indonesian, English, and Simplified Chinese.
BeepWatch is the timer app you've been looking for!

bluejetty:00085212:ios.description:
The new and improved Yodel by InPost app now includes more features Delivery to InPost Lockers, Returns & Click & Collect.
Keep track of your parcel deliveries, book returns, UK mail and manage Click & Collect orders with ease. Download the Yodel by InPost app now and enjoy a seamless parcel management, delivery experience and delivery service with your local parcel delivery app.
Easily track your parcel deliveries, food deliveries, and UK mail to your doorstep in real-time with our parcel tracker app. Our parcel manager and delivery tracking feature allows you to see how many parcel deliveries are coming your way and you can even call or text your courier for more information. Our app also includes a photo of your delivery, so you can be sure that you're receiving the right package in the right place. With our delivery tracking notifications, you can track and trace deliveries and always know the status of your local parcel delivery, and you can even nickname your parcels to keep track of them with our app.
Get a safe delivery service, every time
If you're not home to receive your deliveries, our parcel tracker app has got you covered – including the option to deliver your parcel to an InPost Locker. Our parcel tracking feature provides 2-hour delivery windows on every parcel to your door, and you can choose where you want your local parcel delivery courier to leave your package. Whether you want it left in a safe place, with a neighbour, or at one of our suggested safe locations, we've got you covered. Plus, you can save your preferred delivery tracking settings, so your parcels are always delivered to a safe place.
Keep track of every parcel on the go
Managing delivery tracking and multiple parcel deliveries from our brands is a breeze with our parcel tracker app. You can track and trace deliveries and multiple orders at once with our shipping tracker. You can also add multiple addresses to your account, making it even easier to track and trace deliveries from your local parcel delivery app.
Get notified on updates, no spam!
Stay informed on your delivery tracking, food deliveries, and UK mail with our parcel tracking message centre. Our parcel tracker app sends notifications about anything that could impact your parcel's journey, such as extreme weather or road closures. We even send push notifications, so you don't have to remember to track your parcel, we do it for you.
Our friendly customer service is on your side
If you ever have any questions or need help, our customer service team is just a chat away. Our app is easy to use, but if you ever need help, you can reach our parcel tracker team easily through our app. Plus, we have a tooltips feature that will guide you through the in-app delivery experience, making sure you get the most out of your local parcel delivery app and delivery tracking service.
We're constantly updating our app to make parcel tracking even easier. Recently, we've added 2-hour parcel tracker delivery windows, a photo of the delivered parcel, and a manual address fill-in feature. You can also book Returns and choose from thousands of locations to Click & Collect your parcels in person, from our Yodel Store services. Use our shipping tracker on parcels, whether they're sent to a local collection point or to your door. Get notified when your Click & Collect orders arrive, and never miss a local parcel delivery with the Yodel delivery service again!
Start using the Yodel by InPost app today, and get a delivery experience that is seamless with Yodel by InPost parcel tracking!

bluejetty:00015133:ios.description:
Corneille takes your child into a fantastic adventure of reading in French! As a fun and educational game for children ages 3 to 8, Corneille makes learning French easy. Children will discover letters, learn new words, identify sounds in words, discover numbers and play memory games. 
Corneille creates smart screen time while teaching kids French. Based on the latest cognitive studies, the app was developed by reading experts—teachers and language professionals—who realize that parents are sensitive to the content that their children are exposed to on screens. 
Early Literacy
From sounds to phonics to reading
Discovering new words and identifying the sounds in a word are the first steps in learning how to read. By playing with French phonics, children will learn animal names, numbers, colors and words for everyday objects.
Reading alone in French
Children record their own voices while reading their first sentences. They will better understand and read twice while listening to his own voice. Auto correction is the best way to learn.
Drawing and writing letters
The drawing and writing modules engage children while they learn and develop their motor skills and creativity.
Digital French library
Discover our first children's book. More selections are in the works and will be available to read within the app as the library expands.
With Corneille, your child will benefit from meaningful and engaging screen time while reading and learning French.
www.corneille.io
Contact us at contact@corneille.io
The subscription is auto-renewable; you can cancel anytime through the Apple store.
Our terms and conditions: http://corneille.io/index.php/mentions_legales/
Privacy Policy: http://corneille.io/index.php/politiqueconfidentialite/

bluejetty:00030430:ios.description:
Vaccy is your digital vaccination record for the 21st century, developed by medical students of Charité - University Medicine Berlin! Download the most popular vaccination record now and keep track.
Never miss a vaccination again with Vaccy, your reliable digital helper! The app is not only easy to use, but also effective at managing your vaccination appointments and reminding you of upcoming boosters. Whether you're at the GP or traveling internationally, Vaccy keeps your vaccination data safe and organized in one place. So you can easily keep an eye on your health and are always well prepared. See the benefits for yourself and download Vaccy now!
MOST IMPORTANT FEATURES
- Overview: Experience a clearly structured view that allows you to see all the essential information at a glance.
- Vaccinations: Enter your vaccinations directly into the app to have them to hand at all times and always keep track of them.
- Multiple profiles: Easily manage your whole family's immunization data by creating multiple profiles, so you always have not only your own but also your children's vaccinations to hand.
- PDF export: Easily export your immunization data as a PDF and take it with you to your next doctor's appointment.
- Doctors: Add your doctors and keep important contact details such as phone numbers and opening hours at your fingertips.
- iCloud Sync: Use iCloud synchronization to seamlessly sync your data between your Apple devices and store it securely in the cloud.
- App lock: Protect your sensitive information securely with FaceID, TouchID or a passcode thanks to the integrated app lock.
- Reminders: Set up reminders that reliably remind you of upcoming vaccinations so you never forget an important appointment.
USER FEEDBACK
I think this app has great potential to maintain family vaccinations. The developer is a medical student which is an ideal background to offer researched and relevant data to enhance the app. I contacted him asking for an enhancement and got a rapid and detailed response. I recommend you give this app a try. ~ Mjjeaj
WHAT'S COMING NEXT
The app is still new and many improvements and new functions are planned. So stay tuned, the next update is coming soon. If you like the app, a rating on the AppStore would help me and the further development incredibly. If you have any problems using the app or ideas for new features, please contact me at support@vaccy.christophriepe.com.
LICENSE AGREEMENT

bluejetty:00175424:ios.summary: PulsePoint Respond is a 911-connected mobile app that can immediately inform you of emergencies occurring in your community and can request your help when cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) is needed nearby. If you’re trained in CPR and ar
bluejetty:00175424:ios.description:
PulsePoint Respond is a 911-connected mobile app that can immediately inform you of emergencies occurring in your community and can request your help when cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) is needed nearby. If you’re trained in CPR and are willing to assist in an emergency, the app will alert you if someone near you is having a cardiac emergency and may need CPR.
In addition to nearby “CPR Needed” notifications, you can choose to be notified of other events that may impact you and your family, such as wildland fires, flooding and utility emergencies. You can also monitor live dispatch radio traffic for most PulsePoint-connected communities with a simple tap on the speaker icon.
PulsePoint currently provides coverage for thousands of communities in North America, with many more on the way. For more information, visit pulsepoint.org, contact us at info@pulsepoint.org.
PulsePoint Respond is an end-to-end FirstNet Certified™ application. FirstNet Certified solutions must demonstrate 99.99% availability and pass independent third-party security, data privacy and performance audits.
PulsePoint is a 501(c)(3) public non-profit foundation building applications that help public safety agencies inform and engage their citizens.
NOTE: Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life. Your actual experience is always visible in Settings | Battery | PulsePoint.

bluejetty:00069935:ios.description:
깔끔하게 정리된 화면과 독서를 도와주는 기능이 더해진
새로운 알라딘 eBook 뷰어를 공개합니다!
▷ 책장 
- 구매 목록에서 다운로드한 도서는 기본 책장에 추가됩니다. 기본 책장에서 '편집' 기능으로 다른 책장으로 이동할 수 있습니다. 
- 책장에서는 분야별 또는 독서 상태, 소장 또는 대여, 파일 형식 등으로 도서를 필터링할 수 있습니다. 
- '선택한 분야 자동 추가' 기능을 이용하여 책장과 분야를 미리 매칭해두면 분야별 책장을 쉽게 만들 수 있습니다. 
- 책장 위쪽의 이미지를 변경하거나 사용 여부를 변경할 수 있습니다. 
- 구매 목록에서 숨기고 싶은 책은 '잠금' 기능을 이용해 보세요. 
- 세트 도서는 묶어서 보거나 낱권으로 볼 수 있도록 옵션이 제공됩니다. 
▷ 독서 캘린더 & 리포트 
- 읽은 책이 캘린더에 자동으로 추가되어, 한 달 동안의 독서 기록을 한눈에 볼 수 있습니다. 
- 읽은 책, 독서 시간, 스크랩 정보 등이 자동으로 기록되어 주간, 월간 단위로 리포트가 발행됩니다. 
▷ 뷰어 최적화 
- 글꼴, 글자 크기, 줄간격 등을 도서별로 설정할 수 있습니다. 
- 기기에 내장된 TTS 엔진으로 도서를 읽어 드립니다. 
- ePub, 만화, PDF 등 모든 파일 포맷의 발기 조절 옵션을 통일하였습니다. 
- 만화 역순 보기 기능을 제공합니다. 
- 블루투스 리모컨으로 책장을 넘길 수 있습니다. 
▷ 동기화 
- 모든 단말기에서 동일한 책장과 독서 상태를 유지합니다. 
- 다양한 옵션을 이용하여 원하는 환경으로 세팅할 수 있습니다.
▷ 선택 접근 권한 안내
- 카메라 : 앱내 사진 첨부와 전송 시 사용
- 사진 : 책장 배경이미지 및 이미지로 공유하기의 배경화면 기능에 사용
- FaceId/TouchId : 앱 잠금 해제제 사용
- 알림 : 앱 푸시 전송 시 사용
* 선택 접근 권한은 동의하지 않아도 앱을 사용할 수 있습니다. *
▷ 연락처
- 전화번호 : 1544-2514 (평일 9:00 ~ 18:00)
- email : cs-center@aladin.co.kr

bluejetty:00127733:ios.description:
A beautiful redesign for iPad and a new iPhone edition, which includes all the same content as our print and iPad editions, presented in an easy, mobile-friendly reading experience. 
iPad users can preview articles from the latest issue. Enjoy a look around before you decide what’s right for you: single-issue purchase, or a month-to-month or yearly subscription.
· NEW SUBSCRIBERS: Enjoy a 30-day free trial on iPhone and iPad when you subscribe.
About the Magazine
The interactive edition of Reader’s Digest lets you browse smart, useful tips on health, work, food, relationships, home, and money, all expertly selected from hundreds of online and print sources. You’ll discover original profiles of inspiring people, real-life dramas, insightful essays, and news roundups that get you up-to-date fast on the issues you care about. All the features and departments from the print edition are here, including the jokes and funny true stories, along with our famous Word Power column—now with automatic scoring and audio pronunciations. Each issue is enhanced with exclusive cartoons, videos, slide shows, animations, and useful Web links—all in a well-designed, easy-to-navigate interface. 
Choose your Subscription Option
Get a 30-day FREE trial when you subscribe.
• 1-month subscription for $1.99 automatically renewed until canceled
• 1-year subscription for $14.99 automatically renewed until canceled
• Your subscription starts with the latest issue; back issues are not included, but you may purchase them as single issues ($3.99)
SUBSCRIBERS’ AUTOMATIC-RENEWAL FEATURE: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews for another subscription period (another year for annual subscribers, another month for monthly subscribers) unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Your credit card will be charged the full amount for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.

bluejetty:00144586:ios.description:
Vivo – Uma marca Telefónica
Conheça o app Vivo  
Você pode gerenciar seus serviços contratados, consultar faturas, acompanhar o consumo de internet, fazer pagamentos e aproveitar diversos benefícios. Agora, o app também está disponível pra clientes Vivo Empresas, que podem gerenciar seus serviços corporativos com a mesma praticidade. 
O que você pode fazer no app:
▸ Consultas e pagamentos
Na área Assinaturas, é possível consultar faturas, acessar a segunda via e fazer pagamentos quando precisar.
▸ Consumo de internet
Você pode acompanhar sua franquia e o consumo de internet pra ter mais controle sobre o uso dos serviços.
▸ Compartilhar e enviar internet
Só pelo app, quem tem Vivo Pré pode compartilhar ou enviar internet pra outros números Vivo. É rápido e simples.
▸ Loja
Encontre ofertas selecionadas pra você. Também é possível assinar serviços Vivo ou de parceiros e comprar produtos com ofertas exclusivas.
▸ Benefícios
Aproveite descontos e gratuidades em cultura, gastronomia, viagens e muito mais 
▸ Bônus
Você pode recarregar e aproveitar os bônus de internet disponíveis pra sua linha.
▸ Vivo Pay
Sua vida financeira pode ser feita com a Vivo. Na área Vivo Pay, você pode gerenciar sua conta, fazer e receber Pix, solicitar empréstimos e outros serviços financeiros.
▸ Pra Você
É a área central do app, com um resumo das informações mais importantes, como atalhos, mensagens e recursos.
▸ Pra Empresas
Clientes Vivo Empresas encontram no app funcionalidades pra facilitar a gestão do negócio. Agora, é possível consultar a segunda via e fazer pagamentos de faturas, gerenciar perfis de gestores, solicitar suporte técnico e aproveitar novas ofertas e benefícios exclusivos no app.
▸ Vivo Lite (Easy)
O Easy agora se chama Vivo Lite, e seus serviços também estão disponíveis no app Vivo. Você pode gerenciar o plano, comprar pacotes adicionais, acessar benefícios e ganhar bônus ao convidar outras pessoas.
Baixe agora o app Vivo e aproveite tudo o que ele pode oferecer!
Sobre a permissão de acessibilidade
O app Vivo usa o Serviço de Acessibilidade para as funcionalidades: 
* Bloquear o aparelho quando você solicitar, em caso de perda ou roubo.  
* Apagar os dados do aparelho quando você solicitar, em caso de perda ou roubo  
Pra executar essas funções, o app Vivo coleta e compartilha os seguintes dados:  
* Identificadores do aparelho, como o número de telefone, usados pra ativar essas funções

bluejetty:00163928:ios.name: Stratego® Online
bluejetty:00163928:ios.summary: The beloved strategy game Stratego, known for its tactical depth and captivating gameplay, is now available to a global audience through a modern and engaging online platform! Stratego Online brings the timeless strategy and excitement of t
bluejetty:00163928:ios.description:
The beloved strategy game Stratego, known for its tactical depth and captivating gameplay, is now available to a global audience through a modern and engaging online platform! Stratego Online brings the timeless strategy and excitement of the original board game to your phone.
Stratego is a two-player strategy game where each player controls an army of 40 pieces with the goal of capturing the enemy flag. The pieces of the opponent are hidden until engaged in battle, so you’ll have to be tactical to reveal the location of important enemy pieces. Use special pieces, like bombs, miners and spies to gain an advantage over your opponent and win.
ONLINE RANKED MATCHMAKING
Play competitive Stratego battles against players from all over the world! Climb the ranked ladder from recruit up to grandmaster and fight for a spot on the leaderboard.
TRAINING
Try your skills against one of the three bot opponents in a thrilling single-player match. Each bot brings a new difficulty level for you to overcome!
SINGLE PLAYER CAMPAIGN
Experience a new way to play the board game in a story mode about a traitor that has infiltrated the bluecoat army. Play through 15 different gameplay scenarios with story, unique objectives, and new gameplay mechanics that can be recognized from other versions of Stratego throughout the years.
PREPARE YOUR STRATEGY
Stratego Online allows you to prepare your piece arrangement before you jump in a game, greatly reducing the setup time that is normally needed before starting to play. You can also rewatch your games to study your mistakes, adapt your strategies, and beat your rivals.
CROSS-PLATFORM & SOCIAL
You can connect and play with players playing on all our supported platforms. Add players as friends to chat with them, spectate their games and challenge them for friendly battles.
FREE TO PLAY
This game is not pay-to-win. All purchases are either cosmetic or unlock benefits that do not influence your win chance.
CONTINUOUS DEVELOPMENT
We’re constantly updating the game to release new exciting features. Join our Discord server so even your suggestions might be included in the next update!
Support:
Contact us by sending an email to support@wanted5games.com
Privacy policy:
https://www.wanted5games.com/privacy-policy
General Terms and Conditions:
https://www.wanted5games.com/tos

bluejetty:00131717:ios.name: Tattoo Studio Pro
bluejetty:00131717:ios.summary: Say goodbye to shop chaos and hello to the only all-in-one management app built just for tattoo studios, no salons, no gyms, just your world. Tattoo Studio Pro streamlines your workflow, cuts no-shows, and helps you grow, so you can focus o
bluejetty:00131717:ios.description:
Say goodbye to shop chaos and hello to the only all-in-one management app built just for tattoo studios, no salons, no gyms, just your world. Tattoo Studio Pro streamlines your workflow, cuts no-shows, and helps you grow, so you can focus on your art. Ready to level up?
Everything you need to transform your business:
- Log every ink and needle (NEW!): Set up the inks and needles you use, then tick them off on each client's form. Lot numbers fill in automatically and land on the signed consent PDF, ready for your health inspector.
- Be up and running in minutes: Signing up asks for your studio name and a PIN, not ten fields. A setup checklist walks you through the rest.
- Get answers without leaving the app: Tap Ask Dot on any screen, or reach a human by email or a booked call.
- Run your day from the Calendar: Day, week, month, and list views, staff color-coding, and view settings that stick between sessions.
- Track every appointment's status: Mark appointments Upcoming, Confirmed, Cancelled, Completed, or No-Show.
- Keep your team's hours straight: Studio and artist hours, time off so nobody gets booked while away, and a Schedule view of the whole team's week.
- Automatic booking confirmations: Every appointment fires an instant confirmation text from your own template, honoring each client's SMS consent. Switch texts off per appointment.
- Collect deposits at booking: Your confirmation goes out with a secure payment link, or copy a link from any appointment and send it yourself. Take the deposit at the counter and the link switches off, so nobody pays twice.
- Smarter reminder sequences: Build up to 5 timed SMS reminders per appointment, with live preview.
- Take card payments in person: Pair a Stripe M2 card reader and take chip, swipe, and contactless payments with tipping, right from checkout. Sales land in your reports.
- Know every client: Client profiles show visits, spend, and deposits at a glance, with purchase history in its own tab.
- Online and walk-in check-in: Clients fill out your form before they arrive and land in a Walk-ins tab. Match them and drop them into the Queue, your one dashboard for appointments, forms, and check-ins.
- Sync bookings to your phone: One-way calendar sync puts your appointments on your lock screen, your Apple Watch, or wherever your calendar lives.
- Capture every lead with Inbox: Share your request link or embed it anywhere. Requests with notes and photo references land in one inbox you can confirm, decline, or convert.
- Share your portfolio anywhere: Copy a public portfolio link or embed code for your socials, your site, or a client.
- Ditch the paperwork: Go paperless with digital consent forms and health questionnaires, customize them to fit your vibe.
- Sync your crew: Invite your team with role-based access to keep everyone on the same page.
- Boost revenue with Stripe: Use Stripe as your full POS for service and retail sales, with required consent forms connected to each service.
- Track your finances: Monitor sales, deposits, and reports with ease. Your numbers, your control.
- Manage your plan in the app: Upgrade, switch plans, or manage your subscription without leaving Tattoo Studio Pro.
- Keep it secure: Cloud-based storage and privacy-first design keep your data safe, with auto-lock controls to fit your device.
- Run your shop anywhere: Our companion web app lets you manage your studio on any device.
Why Tattoo Studio Pro?
We're the tattoo-specific solution that gets you. Join studios around the world saving time, boosting revenue, and growing their client list.
Try it free for 30 days!
Download now and see the difference. Questions? Hit us up at support@tattoostudiopro.com. Let's keep your chairs filled and your shop buzzing!
EULA - https://tattoostudiopro.com/eula/
Privacy Policy - https://tattoostudiopro.com/privacy-policy/
Terms & Conditions - https://tattoostudiopro.com/terms-and-conditions/

bluejetty:00027621:ios.description:
The New Mayo Clinic Diet is the only weight loss program that features a comprehensive, whole-health program developed and approved by the Mayo Clinic. Our flexible meal plans fit into any lifestyle, and our easy-to-prepare recipes show you how good food can be great—and great for you, too.
This app is your companion to the New Mayo Clinic Diet digital platform, and it includes all the essentials you need on the go, such as:
>> New Diet Score to make it easier to follow the program.
>> Delicious Meal Plans including the Original Mayo Clinic Diet, Simple, Healthy Keto, Higher Protein, Vegetarian, Mediterranean, and Protein Balance menus.
>> Habit Optimizer to swap unhealthy habits for healthy ones.
>> Food Tracker with over 1 million foods to help you keep track of your Mayo Clinic food group servings. The Tracker includes a barcode scanner and the ability to add foods that aren't already in the database instantly.
>> Recipe Search to look up hundreds of delicious healthy meals.
>> Weight Tracker to record your weight, body measurements, and weigh-in selfies.
>> At-home Exercise Plans with no equipment required.
>> App subscription
• The Mayo Clinic Diet is available on a 3-month auto-renewing subscription of USD$119.99
• Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews every 3 months unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by the user going to their iTunes Account Settings after purchase
• Once purchased, refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term
• This subscription cannot be used in conjunction with any other promotion
Terms of Use: https://diet.mayoclinic.org/us/terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://diet.mayoclinic.org/us/privacy-policy/
++++Important++++
Before starting any weight loss program, it is highly recommended that you consult your physician or health care provider.
++++References++++
The meal plans in this app are based on the dietary guidelines specified in The Mayo Clinic Diet Second Edition by Donald D. Hensrud, M.D., Director of the Mayo Clinic Healthy Living Program.
The food group calculations are based on the Mayo Clinic Diet Healthy Weight Pyramid, available in the above mentioned book.

bluejetty:00155625:ios.description:
Unlock the Power of Beverage Knowledge with CellarCo.AI
Welcome to CellarCo.AI, the ultimate educational marketing app designed specifically for distributor reps in the alcohol industry. With CellarCo.AI, you can transform your role, enhance your product knowledge, and earn rewards, all while engaging with top beverage brands in fun and innovative ways.
What is CellarCo.AI?
CellarCo.AI is a dynamic platform where beverage brands launch micro-incentivized educational campaigns tailored just for distributor reps. These campaigns might include watching a brief video, reading an informative fact sheet, or participating in a quick survey. For every campaign you complete, you earn rewards ranging from $1 to $5. It's a win-win: you gain valuable knowledge and insights to better assist your accounts, and brands benefit from your enhanced expertise and influence.
Why Choose CellarCo.AI?
1. Boost Your Product Knowledge:
Stay ahead in your distribution career by learning directly from the top beverage brands. Each campaign is designed to provide you with the latest product information and sales techniques, helping you become a more effective and knowledgeable rep.
2. Influence Your Favorite Brands:
Your feedback matters. By participating in CellarCo.AI campaigns, you have the power to influence the brands you interact with every day. Share your insights and experiences, and see how your input can shape the future of these brands.
3. Earn Rewards:
Who doesn’t love getting paid for learning? With CellarCo.AI, you can earn $1 to $5 for each campaign you complete. It’s a simple and enjoyable way to supplement your income while enhancing your professional skills.
4. Real-Time AI Insights:
Brands receive valuable, real-time insights from your participation, which helps them understand their products' impact and effectiveness. This data-driven approach ensures that the content you engage with is always relevant and beneficial.
How It Works:
1. Download the CellarCo App:
Available on iOS app store, the CellarCo app is easy to download and set up. Simply create your profile and start exploring available campaigns from top beverage brands.
2. Join Campaigns:
Browse through a variety of campaigns that interest you. Whether it's a new product launch, a promotional video, or a quick survey, there's always something exciting to engage with.
3. Complete and Earn:
Participate in campaigns at your convenience. Each completed campaign earns you instant rewards that can be redeemed through the app.
4. Provide Feedback:
Your opinions and insights are invaluable. Share your thoughts on the campaigns and help brands improve their products and services.
What Sets CellarCo.AI Apart?
•User-Friendly Interface:
CellarCo.AI is designed with you in mind. Its intuitive interface makes it easy to navigate, ensuring a seamless experience from start to finish.
•Diverse Campaigns:
No two days are the same with Cellar.AI. With a wide range of campaigns to choose from, you can always find something that piques your interest and fits your schedule.
•Community of Influencers:
Join a growing community of distributor reps who are making a difference. Connect, share experiences, and learn from your peers.
Get Started Today!
Ready to transform your distribution career and start earning rewards? Download Cellar.AI now and unlock a new world of opportunities. Engage with top beverage brands, enhance your product knowledge, and become an influential voice in the alcohol industry. Your journey to becoming a top-performing distributor rep starts with CellarCo.AI.

bluejetty:00062554:ios.description:
Piano by Yousician is your personal piano tutor for the digital age! Learn and play thousands of songs on your real instrument with clear, instant feedback as the app listens along.
Start your free trial today and experience all we have to offer!
Learn at your own pace, whenever and wherever you want. The app listens to you play and gives instant feedback on your accuracy and timing. Our curriculum, designed by expert piano teachers, will help pianists of all levels improve, from complete beginners to professionals.
Step-by-step video tutorials guide you through each lesson. Fun and addictive gameplay tracks your progress and keeps you motivated to practice and learn. You’ll be amazed by how fast your skills advance. So go sit at your piano or keyboard, and start playing now!
Who is this for?
• Piano & keyboard players
• Complete beginners
• Advanced & professional musicians
• Piano teachers
What is included?
• Over 1,500 missions & exercises, with hundreds of videos, covering all the skills you need: sight reading sheet music, classical and pop songs for Piano.
• Yousician also teaches you music theory and Includes special trainers for each skill.
• A Weekly Challenge, where you can compete with friends and millions of Yousicians worldwide.
How does it work?
• It listens to your piano or keyboard
• It gives you instant feedback on your performance
• It takes you through awesome songs and step-by-step tutorials that suit your playing level
• It makes learning fun with rewarding gameplay and challenges
__
SELF-LEARNERS
Yousician has been developed with the world’s most innovative and experienced music teachers. It is perfectly suited for self-learning or as a supplement to learning with a teacher. With step-by-step tutorials and constant feedback you can always be sure you’re playing right.
PLAY WITH PIANO

Download Homebot today and experience the power of a partnership between your trusted home advisor and a cutting-edge mobile app. Empower yourself with valuable insights, financial recommendations, and personalized guidance. bluejetty:00163988:ios.name: SVPlayer - watch in 60+ fps
bluejetty:00163988:ios.summary: SVP (aka SmoothVideo Project) converts any video to 60 fps (and even higher) and does it in real time. From the extensive community feedback, we learned that anyone who has watched at least three movies at high frame rates would never ever
bluejetty:00163988:ios.description:
SVP (aka SmoothVideo Project) converts any video to 60 fps (and even higher) and does it in real time. From the extensive community feedback, we learned that anyone who has watched at least three movies at high frame rates would never ever want to watch anything in the outdated 24 fps standard ;)
In-App subscriptions: Frame Rate Conversion (aka FRC aka HFR aka MEMC) is a PAID option after short trial period.
ALL OTHER FEATURES ARE FREE (yes, including MKV files playback).
Uses SmoothVideo Project (SVP) real-time motion interpolation (MEMC) engine, including:
* Target frame rate selection (48 fps, 60 fps, 120(*) fps, x2, x3 rate...)
* Flexible configuration
* Black bars detection and lighting
plus
* Can do high quality frame rate conversion (for example, using RIFE neural network) via a desktop PC/Mac running SVP 4 application.
* Built-in file browser supporting streaming from WebDAV, FTP, SMB, DLNA, Emby Server and Plex Server.
Please note that the SVP engine requires a recent and powerful CPU. At least Apple A13 performance level is highly recommended for 1080p playback with frame rate conversion enabled. SVPlayer WILL drain the battery like top games do and it MAY NOT WORK at all on old/slow devices. Please don't write bad reviews just because your device can't handle it.
Based on mpv video player which supports:
* All video and audio formats out there;
* Hardware video decoding;
* Network stream playback;
* High quality scaling and rendering;
* AFR (adaptive frame rate)
* HDR tone mapping;
* Audio normalization and equalization;
* Direct mpv.conf access;
* and much more...
See more info and desktop applications on our website!
(*) 120 fps support depends on hardware and iOS version.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
