bluejetty:00132191:ios.description:
Ultimate pack perks:
- Unlock Ace and Claire right away
- 800 diamonds
- 8 random tickets
Hardcore Hack’n Slash Action-RPG.
The must try game for any real hack and slash fan who already got bored with just mindlessly smashing buttons on the screen.
Shadow hunter is an action-packed dark fantasy hack and slash game with an incredible combat system and awesome boss fights, assisted by a one of a kind character control mechanism and a perfect mix of RPG elements to make your adventure super immersive.
A DARKENED, RUINED AND FULL OF SUFFERING SHADOW WORLD
As the mortal world got invaded and destroyed by the horde of dark demons and shadow monsters, everything was covered in the darkness of hell and the constant insufferable noises that were the combination of the endless scream from those evils and the crying and mourning of the lucky few that manage to survive through this nightmare.
The player will be a Shadow Hunter in this world, which is someone who got blessed by the Ancient One with a special power to fight off those dark demons. 
Through countless battles and obstacles, shadow hunters are destined to bring the light back to this mortal world.
EPIC BOSS FIGHT
Shadow Hunter's most exciting moments must be it's epic boss battle, in which the Hunters must defeat dark giant demons to collect their souls and advance to the darkest dungeon and the highest floor of the evil tower. 
Without a decent set of equipment and highly trained techniques, any player could easily get wrecked by those big bosses. 
However, the incredible feelings that players get from successfully overcoming those challenges will make it all worth it. 
Furthermore, those dark demon souls are the key to upgrade hundreds of shadow equipment and weapons, turning them from just a common warrior sword to a legendary hero's blade that would be worshiped by the generations to come.
ENDLESS CHALLENGES
Shadow Hunter will have 4+ different PVE sections with multiple difficulty modes and a PVP arena for players to explore and conquer.
“Adventure” is where players start the game with. It may not be the most challenging part, but it is the most essential section in the game since you need to keep advancing through it to unlock further sections of the game.
Once you have passed a certain dungeon level, you can unlock “Altar of the Darkness” , “Boss Mode” and “Clock Tower of Challenges”. Those are where the true test of skill and power happens. For our shadow hunters to overcome those challenges, mastering the fighting technique is a must, understanding the characteristics of each demon and preparing a suitable strategy is needed and strengthening the shadow equipment is a huge plus. 
At the end of the day, shadow hunters can not only liberate the mortal world from those dark demons but also can test their skills and mastery against other fellows of the shadow. 
MULTIPLE CHARACTERS TO PLAY AND ROLL
Players will get to play as multiple different characters, each has its own unique skills, gameplay and assets. Each character is going to be a distinct way to play the game, a distinct approach to the strategy and the combat.
KEY FEATURES
Intense hack and slash combat.
Epic Boss Fights.
Multiple characters to play.
Hundreds of equipment and weapons to loot and upgrade.
4+ PVE modes and PVP.
Play anytime, anywhere even when offline.
Visit Here to Learn More About Shadow Hunter:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SHLostWorld
Twitter: https://twitter.com/shlostworld

bluejetty:00148785:ios.description:
Whether ye be just getting yer sea legs or ye be an old salt, this interactive world map will help ye navigate the Sea of Thieves. 
—X Marks the Spot!—
…if by “x” you mean bright round map markers…
This companion gives you a comprehensive—and frequently updated—map with markers for that which you seek.
With so much to explore in the Sea of Thieves, it’s no wonder the map is awash in markers! So—just like pirate flags—each marker category boasts its own colors and symbol. That way you can quickly and easily find what your voyage needs.
Marker Categories
 • Heart of Fire Tall Tale
 • Legends of the Sea
 • The Seabound Soul Tall Tale
 • Shores of Gold Tall Tales
 • Festival of the Damned
 • Skeleton Thrones
 • Trading Companies
 ◊ Gold Hoarders
 ◊ Merchant Alliance
 ◊ Order of Souls
 ◊ Hunter's Call
 • Outposts
 ◊ Outposts
 ◊ Shipwrights
 ◊ Taverns
 • Riddle Clues
 ◊ Island landmarks
 ◊ Rock paintings
 • Points of Interest
 ◊ Skeleton Camps
 ◊ Ziplines
 ◊ Cooking Spots
 ◊ Cargo Runs
 ◊ Sea Posts
 ◊ Volcanos
 ◊ Docks
 ◊ Easter Eggs
 ◊ Skeleton forts
 ◊ Ammo chests
 ◊ Cannons
 ◊ Uncharted Islands
 ◊ Shipwrecks
 ◊ Gunpowder Barrels
 • Animals
 ◊ Chickens
 ◊ Pigs
 ◊ Snakes
 • Campaigns
 ◊ The Hungering Deep
 ◊ The Cursed Sails
 ◊ Forsaken Shores
—Filter by Categories—
Need to find the nearest Gold Hoarders to sell your treasure chest? Then you might not need to see where all the animals are right now. Filter by Gold Hoarders to shoo the little scallywags off the map.
Want to sell some chickens, pigs or snakes to the Merchant Alliance? Bring back those animals! Filter by animals and the merchant alliance.
—Search for Specifics—
Stuck in a riddle? Try searching for key terms. It might just unlock your path forward.
—Tap to Pop—
Tap a marker to pop-up a window with an image of your destination.
How does this help?
Well, just off-hand, we can think of a couple scenarios.
•Scenario 1•
Before you wander too far, you might want to be sure you are headed in the right direction. Tap the marker to confirm it’s what you seek.
•Scenario 2•
You’ve arrived at the marker, but you’re still not seeing it? Tap the marker to get a closer look.
…occasionally, these pop-ups will also include fun facts or helpful tips…
—Plan Your Voyage—
Use the "Plan Voyage" feature found under Settings to set route markers, in order of visit, on the map.
—Island Finder—
Use our Island Finder feature by clicking the Question Mark button to quickly find islands from your X Marks The Spot map. 
—Peruse the Shops—
Use the "Shop Preview" to scroll and search through the cosmetics offered by the Weapon shop, Equipment shop, Clothing shop and Shipwright for each outpost.
—In-Game Time—
Use the "Time" feature to see the current day in-game.
Disclaimer:
Sea of Thieves Companion is a third-party application. This application is in no way sponsored, endorsed or administered by, or associated with Rare Ltd. or Microsoft Game Studios.
…we’re just really big fans…
Terms of Use
https://maps.seaofthieves.rarethief.com/terms_of_use.html

bluejetty:00164007:ios.description:
Available exclusively for Netflix members.
“It’s one of the best games to hit Netflix’s fledgling gaming service to date.” — The Verge 
“An engaging, cozy and responsive experience” — Engadget 
“It’s as close to perfect as a mobile game gets” — Esquire 
“A truly magical experience” — TouchArcade 
Master the art of flying. Dive off mountains, weave across forests and glide over rivers to unlock new abilities as you explore a vast, peaceful world.
Use the ancient power of the Windfolk's enchanted capes to hone your skills, take on challenges and fly through obstacle courses that will make your heart soar. Explore an expansive island in this open-world adventure inspired by wingsuit flying.
Features:
• Flying at your fingertips: Inspired by the real-world sport of wingsuit flying, the position of Laya's arms change the shape of her cape just like a bird's wings. Move your thumbs independently or together to steer, boost, rise and dive using intuitive controls.
• Endless exploration: Cut through the air in high-speed races and try not to crash as you carefully maneuver through challenging obstacle courses. If you're in the mood for a relaxing adventure, simply enjoy the beauty of the island and fly without a goal.
• Complete challenges, upgrade your skills: This game is filled with more than 50 exciting missions from many characters, over 40 challenge levels and more than 100 collectables to keep you flying. Unlock capes and charms to help boost your abilities.
• High risk, high reward: Power your flight by flying boldly. Fly close to everything — from hot air balloons to snowy slopes. This will allow you to absorb the island's energy and keep flying fast. If you feel a drop in energy, simply dip low and close to your environment to collect sparks and boost.
• Find your own way to fly: Discover a unique set of flying abilities as you unlock enchanted capes and charms on your journey. Try out different equipment combinations to increase boost speeds, conserve energy and improve maneuverability. 
• Get lost in beautiful horizons: From the winding rivers of the Highlands to the towering rock formations of Stone Forest, each patch of terrain offers a distinct flying experience. Weave through narrow caves filled with ancient ruins, skim over massive waves, dodge raging geysers and so much more.
• Meet interactive characters: An eclectic group of people, the Windfolk are as diverse as the land they live on, which makes meeting them as interesting as discovering the island itself.
• Exclusive music and calming design: Original music and handcrafted audio welcome you into the world of the Windfolk. Adaptive audio matches the movement and intensity of your flying for a totally immersive experience. Enjoy an orchestral score that provides the perfect ambience to your flight and environment.
• An improved gamepad experience: We’ve added gamepad support to most menus. Settings and full map control coming soon.
- Created by Snowman.

bluejetty:00130895:ios.description:
【Video Mode】
Customizable player supporting floating video, playback speed control, picture-in-picture, DLNA and AirPlay casting, and one-click screen lock.
【Userscripts】
Supports both JavaScript and Tampermonkey 5.3.0 syntax. After years of user feedback, Focus has greatly improved compatibility with various scripts, ensuring more scripts run smoothly on Focus.
【Reading Mode】
The best reading mode on iOS, supporting automatic preloading of the next page, font size, line height, margin adjustments, and webpage theme selection.

bluejetty:00129558:ios.description:
This tool is absolutely free.
Decibel Meter turns your iPhone, iPad and iPod touch into a professional accurate sound meter, precisely measures the sound pressure level all around you. This extremely useful tool. Have you wondered how quiet is your room or how loud is a rock concert or sport event? Decibel Meter will help you answer all those right now. 
A decibel meter is a device which measures sound pressure to determine how intense sounds are, measuring in decibels. Decibels are a logarithmic scale based on the sensitivity of the human ear. Prolonged exposure to sounds over 85 decibels can lead to hearing loss, making measurement of decibel levels important for people who work in noisy environments so that they know when they need to protect their ears.
For a frame of reference, normal conversation occurs between around 40 and 60 decibels, depending on who is talking. A firecracker is about 140 decibels, and a jackhammer runs at around 100 decibels. Musicians, mechanics, construction workers, and other people who work in loud environments can endanger their hearing, especially if they work in environments with explosives, which can generate sound waves intense enough to cause pain and immediate hearing damage. A decibel meter can indicate when sound has reached the danger zone.
The decibel meter measures the sound pressure and provides a reading in decibels for the convenience of the user. Some may also provide readings in other units of measurement, depending on the uses they are intended for. Decibel meters are often designed to be portable so that people can move them around as needed, and are often hand held, although sometimes they can be part of a permanent instrument array which is designed to take continuous measurements in a given area. 
One application in which a decibel meter can be used is in the reinforcement of municipal codes. Many municipalities bar sounds above a certain decibel level for safety and comfort, and may have restrictions on noise during certain hours. Police officers can carry decibel meters to determine whether or not a sound is violating the noise ordinance. These devices are also used in noise pollution studies which are used to determine the impact of passing vehicles, aircraft, and other sound-generating objects on a community.
The decibel meter is also used in the music industry, during recording and setting up for concerns as well as monitoring of conditions in a concert. Similarly, meters may be installed in noisy workplaces to monitor conditions, and may be designed to send out alerts when people need to wear ear protection or take other precautions to protect their hearing. These devices are also utilized in testing of hearing protection such as ear plugs and headphones, with such products coming with a decibel ratings to provide an indicator as to which settings they can and should be used in.

bluejetty:00023724:ios.description:
Dead Empire: Zombie War is a real-time war strategy game set in the late modern period. The story is about a group of unique and fascinating women with different life experiences, who help the Allies fight against the invaders and the evil zombie forces created by the invaders in the war. You will play as a Commander in the game. Train powerful troops and recruit beautiful female Officers to lead. Unite other Commanders to eliminate the Invaders and evil zombie forces and finally achieve world peace by establishing a stronger Guild!
1. Brand New Troop Control System
The game uses a new free control system that allows players to command multiple troops to march, garrison, and change targets and marching routes on the battlefield. Strong troops cannot prevail without excellent leadership and strategies!
2. Vivid War Scenes
We have created vivid cities and battlefields based on actual geography from late modern Europe, including landmarks that people will recognize. Plus, we have also simulated the famous war machines used during the late modern period, which aim to bring you back to the era when legends emerged.
3. Real-time Multiplayer Combat
Fighting against real players is always more complicated and appealing than battling the A.I. You still need help from other players, even when you're strong because you won't be fighting against one opponent. It could be an entire Guild, or even more.
4. Multiple Countries to Select
You can choose different countries to play in the game. Each country has its own Country Trait, and the combat units unique to each country are all famous war machines that served the countries throughout history. You can lead the army that you want in the game, and launch attacks on your enemies!

listings.description:
Dead Empire: Zombie War is a real-time war strategy game set in the late modern period. The story is about a group of unique and fascinating women with different life experiences, who help the Allies fight against the invaders and the evil zombie forces created by the invaders in the war. You will play as a Commander in the game. Train powerful troops and recruit beautiful female Officers to lead. Unite other Commanders to eliminate the Invaders and evil zombie forces and finally achieve world peace by establishing a stronger Guild!

1. Brand New Troop Control System
The game uses a new free control system that allows players to command multiple troops to march, garrison, and change targets and marching routes on the battlefield. Strong troops cannot prevail without excellent leadership and strategies!

2. Vivid War Scenes
We have created vivid cities and battlefields based on actual geography from late modern Europe, including landmarks that people will recognize. Plus, we have also simulated the famous war machines used during the late modern period, which aim to bring you back to the era when legends emerged.

3. Real-time Multiplayer Combat
Fighting against real players is always more complicated and appealing than battling the A.I. You still need help from other players, even when you're strong because you won't be fighting against one opponent. It could be an entire Guild, or even more.

4. Multiple Countries to Select
You can choose different countries to play in the game. Each country has its own Country Trait, and the combat units unique to each country are all famous war machines that served the countries throughout history. You can lead the army that you want in the game, and launch attacks on your enemies!
Millions of players have joined this legendary battlefield. Expand your Guild, show your power, and conquer this land!

bluejetty:00142645:ios.summary:

發票存摺是統一發票對獎與電子發票管理 App：對獎、掃描、中獎號碼查詢、手機條碼載具歸戶、發票記帳與消費分析、定期花費與價格增加提醒、會員卡收納都在這裡；存發票還能參加發票回饋活動、做任
bluejetty:00142645:ios.description:
統一發票開獎後，在發票存摺按一下就能對獎，整期發票一次對完，一般獎和雲端發票專屬獎一起對；設定領獎帳戶後，雲端發票中獎獎金自動匯入您的銀行帳戶。手機條碼與信用卡、悠遊卡等載具歸戶後，載具發票自動匯入，並依消費類別累計成每月花費，存發票就是記帳；開啟價格增加提醒，訂閱、月費金額變高也會通知您。
發票存摺是統一發票對獎與電子發票管理 App：對獎、掃描、中獎號碼查詢、手機條碼載具歸戶、發票記帳與消費分析、定期花費與價格增加提醒、會員卡收納都在這裡；存發票還能參加發票回饋活動、做任務賺金幣。
◤ 統一發票對獎：開獎一鍵對，中獎馬上知道 ◢
● 雲端發票對獎：開獎後到「我的發票」按「立即對獎」，當期所有發票，包括載具匯入、掃描和手動輸入的發票，一次對完；一般獎與雲端發票專屬獎分開顯示已對、未對，中了雲端發票專屬獎（百萬元、2 千元、8 百元、5 百元）也會在發票上標示獎額。雲端發票專屬獎還沒開出時，App 會提示您晚點再回來對；對獎卡片也標示領獎期間，過了期限會提醒。
● 對獎結果：以動畫揭曉本期「中 X 張／共 Y 張」與中獎金額，中獎或沒中都能把這期對發票的結果做成分享圖，和朋友分享。
● 掃描對獎：鏡頭對準電子發票的 QR Code，相機持續辨識，一張接一張連續掃描發票；已開獎的期別掃到就自動對獎、馬上顯示結果，新發票同時存進發票存摺並取得消費明細，同一張重複掃不會重複存。可開關手電筒與掃描音效。
● 傳統發票：切到「傳統發票」分頁，用文字辨識讀取發票號碼對獎；此模式同時讀取 QR Code 與文字；判斷不出期別時讓您自己選期，對完可按「儲存發票」存進發票存摺。
● 末三碼對獎：用數字鍵盤輸入發票末三碼，可選最新一期、上一期或兩期一起對；末三碼對中時，App 會提醒您核對完整號碼。
● 統一發票中獎號碼：奇數月 25 日開獎，「中獎號碼」頁列出特別獎、特獎、頭獎號碼，附各獎金額、「末 N 碼相同」的對獎規則與領獎期間；可切換期別，也能手動更新中獎號碼。
● 開獎倒數與提醒：「我的發票」顯示開獎倒數；開獎當天下午進到「我的發票」，會跳出「發票開獎囉！立即對獎」，按一下就對完整期。
● 資料來源：中獎號碼與雲端發票資料來自財政部電子發票整合服務平台，以財政部公告為準；發票存摺由民間公司開發，不代表財政部或任何政府機關。
◤ 兌獎領獎：獎金自動入帳，不用跑超商 ◢
● 設定領獎帳戶後，手機條碼與歸戶載具裡的中獎雲端發票，獎金自動匯入您的銀行帳戶，不必再到超商機台列印、排隊兌獎。
● 領獎帳戶：在 App 內完成財政部的匯款帳戶設定，之後開獎的雲端發票中獎獎金就會匯入這個帳戶。
● 中獎發票的明細頁會標示獎金金額與「領獎辦法」，對獎結果頁也能查看領獎辦法。
◤ 手機條碼載具：一個條碼管好所有發票 ◢
● 手機條碼：用手機號碼和載具驗證碼（財政部密碼）登入；還沒有手機條碼，可在 App 內開啟財政部頁面申請，忘記驗證碼或要更新驗證碼也在 App 內處理。
● 出示條碼：手機條碼頁可開啟自動調整螢幕亮度，條碼能一鍵複製，也顯示領獎帳戶是否已設定，並可直接進入小工具設定；首頁底部的條碼面板往上拉就能出示手機條碼或愛心碼，可開啟恆亮，不用切換頁面。
● 載具歸戶：信用卡／簽帳卡、悠遊卡、一卡通、iCash 2.0、網購會員、跨境電商電子信箱與其他卡類，都能在 App 內開啟財政部頁面歸戶綁定；歸戶後載具裡的發票自動匯進來，不用再收紙本發票。
● 水電帳單歸戶：掃描或輸入帳單上的兩段或三段條碼即可歸戶，帳單繳費入帳、開立發票後就會歸戶成功。
● 已歸戶載具清單：查看每個已歸戶的卡片與帳號，以及各自的本期發票張數，點進去就能看它的發票。
● 發票同步：登入時同步近 7 期發票，在「我的發票」下拉可重新整理當期；同步到新發票時，會跳出「X-Y 月有新發票進來囉」。
● 驗證碼失效提醒：在財政部改過驗證碼導致同步中斷時，App 會提醒並引導您更新驗證碼，更新後重新同步發票，完成時通知您。
● 發票推播通知：登入後，「設定 > 隱私與通知」的「發票推播通知」開關會在發票存入時提醒您，可自由開啟或關閉。
● 愛心碼與捐發票：手機條碼頁可切換成愛心碼，結帳時直接出示；可捐贈的發票也能在明細頁捐出，用單位名稱或愛心碼搜尋，並顯示前次捐贈單位。
◤ 存發票，還能領回饋 ◢
● 發票回饋：「我的發票」會出現當期的回饋活動卡片，標示活動獎勵，達成條件後直接按「領取」；活動與獎項依每檔而定，部分活動還有抽獎機會。
● 任務與金幣：在「集點兌禮」的任務頁查看每個任務的進度、期限與獎勵，完成後領取金幣或票券。
● 商城：依分類瀏覽，用金幣兌換超商票券、日本票券、各大平台體驗／優惠券或 App 主題；每項商品都標示剩餘數量與兌換期限，已兌換或額滿也會標示。
● 金幣紀錄：查看金幣的獲得與使用紀錄，以及即將到期的金幣。
● 我的物品：兌換到的票券集中保存，兌換條碼可恆亮出示、優惠碼一鍵複製，實體獎品可填寫收件資料。
● 兌換碼：在「我的物品」輸入兌換碼，領取票券或金幣。
● 好友邀請碼：每個人都有專屬邀請碼，新朋友加入後輸入一次，驗證成功雙方都能獲得金幣。
◤ 發票明細與記帳 ◢
● 發票清單：依期別查看發票，每張都標示來源是載具、掃描或手動輸入；單張發票可刪除。
● 發票明細：電子發票可查看購買品項明細，沒有隨機碼、開立買方統編等查不到明細的情況也會標示說明。每張發票都能加備註（最多 50 字），沒有店名的手動發票會以備註當標題。
● 消費歸類：發票依餐飲、居家、交通、購物、娛樂、其他 6 類歸類，累計成每月花費，存發票就是記帳。
● 搜尋與篩選：用品項或店家名稱搜尋發票，結果可依日期或價格排序，並保留搜尋紀錄，可隨時清除；發票清單可依來源（載具、掃描、手動輸入）或 6 種消費類別篩選。
● 手動新增：條碼污損的電子發票或傳統發票，可輸入消費日期、發票號碼、金額與隨機碼（選填，有填才能查明細），再加上備註；按「儲存並輸入下一張」可連續輸入，重複的發票和未來日期會被擋下。
● 雲端保存：掃描和手動輸入的發票會上傳保存；換手機重新登入後，會同步近 7 期的發票，包括載具、掃描和手動輸入的發票。
● 發票匯出：免費匯出 CSV 檔，可用 Excel 直接開啟。可選當月及前 12 個月中的任一個月，一次匯出一個月；格式二選一：「全部發票」含消費時間、發票號碼、店家、賣方統編、品項、單價、個數、小計、總計、備註，或「僅消費明細」。匯出後透過分享面板存檔或傳送。
● 一鍵刪除本期所有掃描與手動輸入的發票，載具發票會保留。
◤ 消費分析與預算 ◢
● 首頁消費摘要：顯示本月累積消費、與上月相比多或少多少，以及各類別金額，點類別就能看該類發票。
● 預算管理：設定每月預算時，App 會依您近期的消費建議金額，可一鍵套用或清除；首頁顯示剩餘額度與進度，並依掌控得宜、即將達標、已超支等狀態給提示。
● 我的數據公佈欄：6 種消費分析，可依週、月、年切換。
● 分類分析：圓餅圖呈現各類別的筆數與金額。
● 中獎分析：當期預估中獎機率，載具、手動、掃描發票的張數占比，以及「發票魔人指數」贏過多少比例的使用者。
● 載具分析：已歸戶數量、各自的發票張數，以及「省紙愛地球指數」。
● 消費店家分析：消費次數多的店家、平均一天去幾次、總消費次數與金額，以及消費次數贏過多少比例的使用者。
● 時間分析：長條圖呈現凌晨、早上、下午、晚上各時段的消費次數與金額，並標出熱門時段。
● 發票制縣：在台灣地圖上看您在哪些縣市消費過，點進各縣市的「制霸」頁。
● 每種分析都能做成圖片分享。
◤ 定期花費：訂閱、月費漲價提醒 ◢
● 定期花費：從載具發票整理出雲端空間、AI 工具、影音、健身房、停車月租與水電等固定扣款，列出每一項的每月金額與當月合計。
● 價格增加提醒：開啟後，某項定期花費的金額比前幾期明顯變高時通知您，及早決定要不要續用；水電等公共事業改與去年同期比較。
● 出帳前提醒：開啟後在下次出帳前提醒您，確認是否已經退訂或完成繳費。
◤ 會員卡收納 ◢
● 新增會員卡：從熱門店家清單挑選，或新增自訂卡；卡號可用相機掃描或手動輸入，自訂卡還能拍照或從相簿選卡面並裁切。
● 出示會員卡：以條碼或 QR Code 顯示，點一下放大；搭配「會員卡 & 載具」桌面小工具，結帳時和手機條碼一起出示。
● 管理會員卡：可記錄會員姓名、電話與備註，可拖拉排序卡片順序，不用的卡可刪除；也能把卡片做成圖片分享給家人。
◤ 小工具與個人化設定 ◢
● Apple Watch：在手錶上出示手機條碼；會員卡列表點進任一張，就能出示該卡的條碼或 QR Code。
● 長按 App 圖示，選「載具條碼」直接打開手機條碼頁。
● 5 款桌面小工具（Widget）：基本款條碼、自訂款條碼、橫式會員卡、直式會員卡、會員卡 & 載具；小工具顏色會隨深淺色模式切換；格狀會員卡小工具點一下卡片，就切換到該卡條碼。
● 自訂款小工具：用自己的照片當背景（支援透明圖片，10MB 以內），雙指縮放、拖曳裁切，條碼文字可選黑色或白色。
● Face ID／Touch ID 上鎖：開啟後，啟動 App 時須先通過驗證，也可改用裝置密碼解鎖。
● App 主題：多款主題可用金幣在商城兌換，到「我的物品」套用；深色模式可選跟隨系統、開啟或關閉。
● 預設起始頁：設定打開 App 時先進哪一頁，我的發票、集點兌禮、掃描對獎、載具管理、首頁 5 選 1。

● 雲端發票對獎：開獎後到「我的發票」按「立即對獎」，當期所有發票，包括載具匯入、掃描和手動輸入的發票，一次對完；一般獎與雲端發票專屬獎分開顯示已對、未對，中了雲端發票專屬獎（百萬元、2 千元、8 百元、5 百元）也會在發票上標示獎額。雲端發票專屬獎還沒開出時，App 會提示您晚點再回來對；對獎卡片也標示領獎期間，過了期限會提醒。
● 對獎結果：以動畫揭曉本期「中 X 張／共 Y 張」與中獎金額，中獎或沒中都能把這期對發票的結果做成分享圖，和朋友分享。
● 掃描對獎：鏡頭對準電子發票的 QR Code，相機持續辨識，一張接一張連續掃描發票；已開獎的期別掃到就自動對獎、馬上顯示結果，新發票同時存進發票存摺並取得消費明細，同一張重複掃不會重複存。可開關手電筒與掃描音效。
● 傳統發票：切到「傳統發票」分頁，用文字辨識讀取發票號碼對獎；此模式同時讀取 QR Code 與文字；判斷不出期別時讓您自己選期，對完可按「儲存發票」存進發票存摺。
● 末三碼對獎：用數字鍵盤輸入發票末三碼，可選最新一期、上一期或兩期一起對；末三碼對中時，App 會提醒您核對完整號碼。
● 統一發票中獎號碼：奇數月 25 日開獎，「中獎號碼」頁列出特別獎、特獎、頭獎號碼，附各獎金額、「末 N 碼相同」的對獎規則與領獎期間；可切換期別，也能手動更新中獎號碼。
● 開獎倒數與提醒：「我的發票」顯示開獎倒數；開獎當天下午進到「我的發票」，會跳出「發票開獎囉！立即對獎」，按一下就對完整期。
● 資料來源：中獎號碼與雲端發票資料來自財政部電子發票整合服務平台，以財政部公告為準；發票存摺由民間公司開發，不代表財政部或任何政府機關。

◤ 兌獎領獎：獎金自動入帳，不用跑超商 ◢
● 設定領獎帳戶後，手機條碼與歸戶載具裡的中獎雲端發票，獎金自動匯入您的銀行帳戶，不必再到超商機台列印、排隊兌獎。
● 領獎帳戶：在 App 內完成財政部的匯款帳戶設定，之後開獎的雲端發票中獎獎金就會匯入這個帳戶。
● 中獎發票的明細頁會標示獎金金額與「領獎辦法」，對獎結果頁也能查看領獎辦法。

◤ 手機條碼載具：一個條碼管好所有發票 ◢
● 手機條碼：用手機號碼和載具驗證碼（財政部密碼）登入；還沒有手機條碼，可在 App 內開啟財政部頁面申請，忘記驗證碼或要更新驗證碼也在 App 內處理。
● 出示條碼：手機條碼頁可開啟自動調整螢幕亮度，條碼能一鍵複製，也顯示領獎帳戶是否已設定，並可直接進入小工具設定；首頁底部的條碼面板往上拉就能出示手機條碼或愛心碼，可開啟恆亮，不用切換頁面。
● 載具歸戶：信用卡／簽帳卡、悠遊卡、一卡通、iCash 2.0、網購會員、跨境電商電子信箱與其他卡類，都能在 App 內開啟財政部頁面歸戶綁定；歸戶後載具裡的發票自動匯進來，不用再收紙本發票。
● 水電帳單歸戶：掃描或輸入帳單上的兩段或三段條碼即可歸戶，帳單繳費入帳、開立發票後就會歸戶成功。
● 已歸戶載具清單：查看每個已歸戶的卡片與帳號，以及各自的本期發票張數，點進去就能看它的發票。
● 發票同步：登入時同步近 7 期發票，在「我的發票」下拉可重新整理當期；同步到新發票時，會跳出「X-Y 月有新發票進來囉」。
● 驗證碼失效提醒：在財政部改過驗證碼導致同步中斷時，App 會提醒並引導您更新驗證碼，更新後重新同步發票，完成時通知您。
● 發票推播通知：登入後，「設定 > 隱私與通知」的「發票推播通知」開關會在發票存入時提醒您，可自由開啟或關閉。
● 愛心碼與捐發票：手機條碼頁可切換成愛心碼，結帳時直接出示；可捐贈的發票也能在明細頁捐出，用單位名稱或愛心碼搜尋，並顯示前次捐贈單位。

◤ 存發票，還能領回饋 ◢
● 發票回饋：「我的發票」會出現當期的回饋活動卡片，標示活動獎勵，達成條件後直接按「領取」；活動與獎項依每檔而定，部分活動還有抽獎機會。
● 任務與金幣：在「集點兌禮」的任務頁查看每個任務的進度、期限與獎勵，完成後領取金幣或票券。
● 商城：依分類瀏覽，用金幣兌換超商票券、日本票券、各大平台體驗／優惠券或 App 主題；每項商品都標示剩餘數量與兌換期限，已兌換或額滿也會標示。
● 金幣紀錄：查看金幣的獲得與使用紀錄，以及即將到期的金幣。
● 我的物品：兌換到的票券集中保存，兌換條碼可恆亮出示、優惠碼一鍵複製，實體獎品可填寫收件資料。
● 兌換碼：在「我的物品」輸入兌換碼，領取票券或金幣。
● 好友邀請碼：每個人都有專屬邀請碼，新朋友加入後輸入一次，驗證成功雙方都能獲得金幣。

◤ 發票明細與記帳 ◢
● 發票清單：依期別查看發票，每張都標示來源是載具、掃描或手動輸入；單張發票可刪除。
● 發票明細：電子發票可查看購買品項明細，沒有隨機碼、開立買方統編等查不到明細的情況也會標示說明。每張發票都能加備註（最多 50 字），沒有店名的手動發票會以備註當標題。
● 消費歸類：發票依餐飲、居家、交通、購物、娛樂、其他 6 類歸類，累計成每月花費，存發票就是記帳。
● 搜尋與篩選：用品項或店家名稱搜尋發票，結果可依日期或價格排序，並保留搜尋紀錄，可隨時清除；發票清單可依來源（載具、掃描、手動輸入）或 6 種消費類別篩選。
● 手動新增：條碼污損的電子發票或傳統發票，可輸入消費日期、發票號碼、金額與隨機碼（選填，有填才能查明細），再加上備註；按「儲存並輸入下一張」可連續輸入，重複的發票和未來日期會被擋下。
● 雲端保存：掃描和手動輸入的發票會上傳保存；換手機重新登入後，會同步近 7 期的發票，包括載具、掃描和手動輸入的發票。
● 發票匯出：免費匯出 CSV 檔，可用 Excel 直接開啟。可選當月及前 12 個月中的任一個月，一次匯出一個月；格式二選一：「全部發票」含消費時間、發票號碼、店家、賣方統編、品項、單價、個數、小計、總計、備註，或「僅消費明細」。匯出後透過分享面板存檔或傳送。
● 一鍵刪除本期所有掃描與手動輸入的發票，載具發票會保留。

◤ 消費分析與預算 ◢
● 首頁消費摘要：顯示本月累積消費、與上月相比多或少多少，以及各類別金額，點類別就能看該類發票。
● 預算管理：設定每月預算時，App 會依您近期的消費建議金額，可一鍵套用或清除；首頁顯示剩餘額度與進度，並依掌控得宜、即將達標、已超支等狀態給提示。
● 我的數據公佈欄：6 種消費分析，可依週、月、年切換。
● 分類分析：圓餅圖呈現各類別的筆數與金額。
● 中獎分析：當期預估中獎機率，載具、手動、掃描發票的張數占比，以及「發票魔人指數」贏過多少比例的使用者。
● 載具分析：已歸戶數量、各自的發票張數，以及「省紙愛地球指數」。
● 消費店家分析：消費次數多的店家、平均一天去幾次、總消費次數與金額，以及消費次數贏過多少比例的使用者。
● 時間分析：長條圖呈現凌晨、早上、下午、晚上各時段的消費次數與金額，並標出熱門時段。
● 發票制縣：在台灣地圖上看您在哪些縣市消費過，點進各縣市的「制霸」頁。
● 每種分析都能做成圖片分享。

◤ 定期花費：訂閱、月費漲價提醒 ◢
● 定期花費：從載具發票整理出雲端空間、AI 工具、影音、健身房、停車月租與水電等固定扣款，列出每一項的每月金額與當月合計。
● 價格增加提醒：開啟後，某項定期花費的金額比前幾期明顯變高時通知您，及早決定要不要續用；水電等公共事業改與去年同期比較。
● 出帳前提醒：開啟後在下次出帳前提醒您，確認是否已經退訂或完成繳費。

◤ 會員卡收納 ◢
● 新增會員卡：從熱門店家清單挑選，或新增自訂卡；卡號可用相機掃描或手動輸入，自訂卡還能拍照或從相簿選卡面並裁切。
● 出示會員卡：以條碼或 QR Code 顯示，點一下放大；搭配「會員卡 & 載具」桌面小工具，結帳時和手機條碼一起出示。
● 管理會員卡：可記錄會員姓名、電話與備註，可拖拉排序卡片順序，不用的卡可刪除；也能把卡片做成圖片分享給家人。

◤ 小工具與個人化設定 ◢
● Apple Watch：在手錶上出示手機條碼；會員卡列表點進任一張，就能出示該卡的條碼或 QR Code。
● 長按 App 圖示，選「載具條碼」直接打開手機條碼頁。
● 5 款桌面小工具（Widget）：基本款條碼、自訂款條碼、橫式會員卡、直式會員卡、會員卡 & 載具；小工具顏色會隨深淺色模式切換；格狀會員卡小工具點一下卡片，就切換到該卡條碼。
● 自訂款小工具：用自己的照片當背景（支援透明圖片，10MB 以內），雙指縮放、拖曳裁切，條碼文字可選黑色或白色。
● Face ID／Touch ID 上鎖：開啟後，啟動 App 時須先通過驗證，也可改用裝置密碼解鎖。
● App 主題：多款主題可用金幣在商城兌換，到「我的物品」套用；深色模式可選跟隨系統、開啟或關閉。
● 預設起始頁：設定打開 App 時先進哪一頁，我的發票、集點兌禮、掃描對獎、載具管理、首頁 5 選 1。

bluejetty:00078389:ios.description:
Take the WYFF News 4 app with you everywhere you go and be the first to know of breaking news happening in Greenville and the surrounding area. Always stay up to date with the latest local news, national, sports, traffic, political, entertainment stories and much more. Download the WYFF News 4 app for free today.
Our Local News, Weather and Sports App Features Include:
- Greenville breaking news alerts with push notifications
- Live streaming breaking news updates from our WYFF News 4 reporters when it happens, where it happens
- Local news submission area for breaking news, news tips and the ability to email your news photos and videos right to our newsroom to be featured on air
- Up to date, current local weather conditions, hourly Greenville weather updates, and 7 day forecasts
- An interactive radar that lets you zoom in and out to street level and watch storms as they approach. Move the map around to see major weather activity
- Share stories via email or your social media pages
- Greenville weather alerts and updates, WYFF News 4 weather team videocasts and more
Although Hearst Television believes the majority of its news content is appropriate for a variety of ages, it is intended for individuals 18 and older.

bluejetty:00141028:ios.description:
Elevate Your Family's Style with The Superior Shop
Welcome to The Superior Shop – your go-to destination for exceptional men's and kids' fashion. Step into a world where timeless elegance meets contemporary flair, catering to every member of your family and ensuring that each outfit tells a story of refined taste and individuality.
At The Superior Shop, we understand that style is more than just clothing; it's a way of life. Our meticulously curated collection offers a harmonious blend of classic sophistication and modern trends, allowing you to express your unique personality on every occasion.
For the modern gentleman, we offer a handpicked selection of menswear that embodies the essence of quality and craftsmanship. From impeccably tailored suits that command attention to casually refined ensembles that capture your lifestyle, our range ensures that you're always dressed to impress.
But we don't stop at menswear – we cater to your little ones too. Our kids' collection is designed to let their personalities shine. From adorable outfits for special occasions to comfortable playtime attire, we bring the same level of quality and style to your children's wardrobe.
Craftsmanship is at the core of everything we offer. We collaborate with renowned designers who share our passion for excellence, resulting in garments that marry luxury and comfort in every stitch.
However, The Superior Shop experience is about more than just shopping. Our dedicated and knowledgeable staff are here to guide you and your family, making sure you find pieces that resonate with your unique style journey.
Join us in celebrating the art of dressing well for every generation. Discover The Superior Shop and unlock a world of sophistication, elegance, and distinction that sets you and your family apart as true connoisseurs of fashion.

Lots of zombies are attacking and their target is you! Your city is in danger!
In the role of a brave hero with many special skills, your mission is to destroy all your enemies to take back the city and its inhabitants!
As a warrior with limitless potential, you and the other survivors will have to take up arms or use skills and fight a whole bunch of zombies!
HERO SYSTEM
There are many characters to choose from with different skills and powers. Choose your favorite character to accompany you in many upcoming survival battles.
HOT BATTLE
The number of enemies is enormous. Fight while collecting mana to unlock and upgrade your skills. Destroy them by fighting thousands of monsters at once! With just one hand, clear the map!
ZOMBIE AND BOSS MONSTER
You have to go through 5 battles in each level, the boss will appear in the final battle. Many types of zombies and bosses are waiting for you.
DIVERSE SKILL SYSTEM
There are 50+ skills that vary in number and strength. Make the right choice of survival skills to kill as many zombies as possible.
SPECIAL PVP MODE

bluejetty:00148592:ios.description:
I made this game for all sailors.
Easy way to control. Tap to tack, long-press to change the direction to where you want to go. That's it.
You can change the setting of environment and boats as you need.
This game can be helpful for beginners who will start yacht racing.
【About Sailing】
-Sailing is a sport advances by wind power.
-When a yacht is travelling upwind by 45 degrees, it is sailing ”close-hauled”.
-When a yacht is travelling diagonally to the left towards upwind, it is sailing ”starboard”.
-When a yacht is travelling diagonally to the right towards upwind, it is sailing ”port”.
-The maneuver of turning between ”starboard” and ”port” is called ”tack”.
-Make a series of tacking moves in a zig-zag fashion, and lead your yacht to the finish line!!
-New courses have been added.
【About "Right of Way"】
-Starboard yacht has the right of way.Boats on a port tack shall keep clear of boats on starboard tack.
-If you meet with starboard boat when you are on a port tack, you have to tack or bear not to hit.
-When a boat is tacking it shall keep clear of boat that is not tacking. You need to check whether there is no ship around you, before start tacking.
-If you hit another ship without your right of way, you will be "DSQ"(disqualified), which means "game over".
(*These are simple rules for game.)

bluejetty:00135667:ios.description:
AR鲁班尺，手机秒变鲁班尺。买房租房与装修房屋时，方便快捷地测试户型。
本尺具有设置三种常用尺长---46.08厘米、42.9厘米和50.4厘米，还支持创造自己专属的尺长（上面三种之外的尺长），方便快速查询定吉凶，多种尺长对比更精准。不再需要多把尺子测量对比了。支持多种测量单位。

快速创建平面图，快速查看图纸信息对应的字义。
测亩仪 --- 支持地图上画地块、步行和车载测量面积。
APP主要功能：
1. AR测量功能，直接测量显示对应的字义，实时保存多个测量数据与对应的鲁班尺字义。
2. 鲁班尺长度常用三种---46.08厘米、42.9厘米和50.4厘米，可以在这三种中任意切换，总有一种是你需要的。
3. 创造专属自己的尺长----用于常用3种尺长之外的长度。
4. 测量单位灵活设置---毫米，厘米，市寸与英寸，更贴近实际场景。
5. 可便捷查看各『 字 』代表的意思与寓意。
鲁班尺，亦作“鲁般尺”，进行建筑设计和室内装饰时时所用的测量工具，类今工匠所用的曲尺。它从左至右共分四排，其分别是传统的寸、鲁班尺、丁兰尺、厘米四种标尺。鲁班尺相传为春秋鲁国公输班所作，后经风水界加入八个字，以丈量房宅吉凶，并呼之为“门公尺”。其八个字分别是：“财”、“病”、“离”、“义”、“官”、“劫”、“害”、“本”，在每一个字底下，又区分为四小字，来区分吉凶意义。

bluejetty:00179458:ios.name: 揭棋Online - 暗象棋
bluejetty:00179458:ios.summary:
《揭棋Online - 暗象棋》是一隻十分刺激的象棋遊戲, 保証你一玩便上癒，運氣技巧缺一不可, 是最好玩的其中一種象棋！
揭棋(暗象棋)是什麼？
揭棋亦稱潮州象棋，越南文稱為Cờ tướng úp、Cờ úp，使用整個中國象棋棋盤，開始時除了『帥』可保留原位，其他棋子要洗亂，然後放在正式象棋玩法的棋子位置。
棋子的走法？

bluejetty:00079435:ios.description:
Our game "Intermix" lets you unleash your creativity by mixing elements to discover new ones. This is the concept of Infinity Craft.
Each combination is a quick brain teaser: drag and drop elements to see what they create! Our AI instantly generates a logical result, whether it's an emotion, material, place, or pop culture reference. These new creations can then be used for further combinations! Level up by crafting new items, unlocking the ability to combine longer words for even more possibilities. 
At the beginning, you will have 4 fundamental elements available to you: Fire, Water, Earth & Wind
Here are few examples on the working:
1) Fire + Water = Steam
2) Water + Water = River
3) Earth + Steam = Volcano
etc.
There's no official finish line - the challenge grows with you, and custom sound effects keep things engaging.
• Privacy policy and terms of use: https://agreement.combine-craft.limitnil.com

About this app
The simple way to verify your identity. ID verification and anti-money laundering checks are made easy with our user-friendly app.
Who are Credas? 
At Credas, we provide industry-leading compliance software that has been trusted by over three million individuals, globally, to confirm both their identity and source of funds. 
Why you can trust Credas with your data
We understand that just as you wouldn’t purchase a property without a solid foundation, you wouldn’t share your sensitive data without being confident in the security measures protecting it. 
Credas is certified under the UK Government’s Digital Identity and Attributes Trust Framework, a trusted mark of excellence in identity verification. Our systems are fully compliant with ISO 27001, the globally recognised standard for information security management. 
All information is securely encrypted and sent directly to our protected servers where it is made available to the company that issued the invite. 
Need help using our app?
You can find extensive user guides and resources within our knowledge hub: https://www.credas.com/usersupport/ as well as the option to contact our support team for further assistance.

bluejetty:00024378:ios.summary:
As Featured by iMore, track and analyze every aspect of your hockey!
HockeyTracker turns every Apple Watch into a sophisticated hockey tracking computer. Start HockeyTracker before a game and track your favorite performance stats, and afte
bluejetty:00024378:ios.description:
As Featured by iMore, track and analyze every aspect of your hockey!
HockeyTracker turns every Apple Watch into a sophisticated hockey tracking computer. Start HockeyTracker before a game and track your favorite performance stats, and afterwards, dive deep into your data. 
HockeyTracker tracks just about any performance metric you can imagine, plus a few exclusive to HockeyTracker. 
Key Features:
• Dedicated Game, Pick-up, Practice, Goalie, Dryland Training, Coach, Stick Time, Open Skate, Pond and Ref modes
• Automatic Shift Detection* (including shift length, calories burned, top speed, and heart rates from each shift)
* Recovered (fresh) Heart Rate Alert
* High Heart Rate Alert 
* Live In-Game Stat Tracking 
* Live In-Game summary of your last shift (duration, cals, distance, and avg speed) 
• Game Scores
• Goals, Assists, and Plus-Minus Rating
• Calories Burned
• Distance Skated
• Heart Rates (including Max and Average Ice Time Heart Rates)
• Max and Average Skating Speed
• Ice time
• VO2 max**
• Heart Rate Recovery
• Maximum Capable Speed
• Hockey Fitness Level
• Skate Efficiency
* Effort Level 
* Heart Rate Zone Analysis 
• Longest, shortest and average shift times
• Historical graphs of all your metrics over time to see whether you're improving
• Shift Timer: set your desired shift time and get a haptic ping to tell you to get to the bench!
• Share your stats via text, email, Twitter, Facebook, Slack! 
• Freshness Meter Complication so you know how prepared you are for your next session
• The notes section lets you keep track of how you played or describe goals, hits and penalties etc.
• Custom heart rate filtering algorithm that will filter out falsely high heart rate values. 
HockeyTracker lets you record a full workout, from start to finish, without a phone.
*HockeyTracker uses a proprietary shift tracking algorithm that is able to detect whether a place is on the ice or on the bench. 
**Note that in order to calculate VO2Max, HockeyTracker uses your resting heart rate (as is set by Apple during period of inactivity). Series 0 Apple Watches are not capable of resting heart rates therefore VO2Max cannot be calculated at this time on Series 0 Watches.
Notes:
• HockeyTracker requires an Apple Watch to collect the data it displays
• HockeyTrack integrates with the Health App on your iPhone to retrieve the data it displays. It will request permission to access the relevant data types associated with a workout.
Information about HockeyTracker subscriptions:
- Subscribers will receive 1 week free of HockeyTracker
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription
- Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period.
- Depending on what subscription length you choose (Monthly or Annually), so long as your subscription is active, you will have access to the entire iPhone app for these periods, respectfully. 
- Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. Automatic renewals will cost the same price you were originally charged for the subscription.
- You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings on the App Store after purchase.
- Read our terms of service (https://www.hockeytrackerapp.com/terms-of-service/) and privacy policy (https://www.hockeytrackerapp.com/privacy-policy/) for more information.

bluejetty:00062752:ios.description:
* This App is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by TED in any way
To become good at English, you need to listen to it often, but simply listening to English is not enough. Just like other languages in the world, English has many similar words that are difficult to distinguish by listening. That’s why you need to be able to confirm whether you heard them right. 
The key to gaining expertise is in mastering dictation! 
When you listen to the speaker and type in the words, the program will check them, letter by letter. 
Because it only takes a short period of time, you can use it on the bus or subway. You can also use it as a TED viewer through the video function with the subtitles activated. 
The notable feature is that a huge number of TED lectures are constantly added, which means an unlimited amount of available learning materials for you. 
TEDICT allows you to download as many TED lectures as you want, so you’ll always get new learning materials. 
The World’s Best Intellectual Archive, TED 
High-level TED speeches 
This program even features various kinds of English pronunciations from all over the world. 
Use TEDICT to listen to cool ideas from TED and improve your English skills!
* More Information ->
https://cocoswing.com/tedict/
* All TED Talks subject to the creative commons license found at ted.com

Sengled Home is a residential smart-products management platform, which provides you with an integrated mobile app to control, manage and
bluejetty:00021776:ios.description:
Sengled Home is the latest smart home control app that replaces the earlier version -- Element Home.
Sengled Home is a residential smart-products management platform, which provides you with an integrated mobile app to control, manage and monitor your Sengled smart products. With easy set-up, Sengled Home is able to quickly connect your smart products to the Internet, implement real-time communication between your cell phone and household devices through the cloud platform, and achieve remote controlling and monitoring. Moreover, it is able to customize a fully automatic control system based on your personal habits.
CONTROL YOUR LIGHTS FROM ANYWHERE ON THIS PLANET
Either 1 foot away from your Sengled smart device, or 10,000 miles away from your home, as long as you have internet, you can control or check the status of your devices.
COLOR, COLOR TEMPERATURE AND BEYOND
Transform your mobile device into a color palette, and your bulbs, your canvas. Choose from 16 million colors—or choose from Warm White to Day Light—and change the colors of your bulbs to match any mood you have.
ROOM ARRANGEMENT AND GROUPING
Sengled Home App enables you to easily bundle your smart LED lightbulbs into pre-set rooms, or create your own user defined rooms for grouping purposes.
FRONT PAGE OR WIDGET CONTROLS MOST OF YOUR DEVICES
With a simplified and optimized UI design, you can access and control most of the functions from the front page of the Sengled Home App. Scene control and Mobile home page Widget control even makes this process easier.
SMART LED GETS SMARTER WITH SENSORS
Sengled smart LED lights with built-in motion sensor can not only push notifications for any motion event, but also setup actions after detecting motion events. For example, turn on the lights in your bedroom when motion is detected in your backyard in the middle of the night. Sengled smart door sensor can also be used to link with your smart LED lights for event triggered actions.
SCHEDULES, SCENES AND ROUTINES
Either setup daily routines, such as waking or sleeping routines, for the convenience, or setup automation routines, such as turning lights on/off when sensor events were detected. Scenes can be created for multi bulb or multi room control.
WAKE UP & SLEEP
Sengled smart LED bulbs can be programmed for gradual brightening and wake you up with lights naturally. Sleep schedule will control the Sengled smart LED bulbs in night light for delayed dimming.
LIGHT EFFECTS
Six light effects would help users to have more fun with their Sengled products during parties or holidays like Halloween and Christmas. 
3rd PARTY PROGRAM:
After configuring the Sengled Home App, all the settings can be easily ported over to 3rd party programs, like IFTTT. You can expand your home automation with many more capabilities.
HELP WITH ALEXA, GOOGLE ASSISTANT, APPLE HOMEKIT AND MORE:
In-app help page can walk you through the process of setting up Amazon Alexa, Google Assistant, Apple HomeKit, and more.
SAVE ENERGY
Every time you turn your Sengled smart device on or off, an event will be logged. You can check the performance page to see your cumulative power consumption for different devices.
Contact us:
Our development needs your support. Your opinions and suggestions will be appreciated.
Want to know more about Sengled smart products? Follow us on:
Official Site: sengled.com
Facebook: @Sengled
Twitter: @SengledUSA
Instagram: sengled
YouTube: Sengled

bluejetty:00097040:android.description:
EdgeAura transforms your device's visual experience with stunning edge glow effects and dynamic live wallpapers. Make your phone stand out with a beautiful, customizable aura of light that elegantly outlines your screen's edges. This immersive glow effect floats over your other apps and reacts to your activities, including incoming calls, creating a uniquely vibrant and personalized look for your device.
Key Features:
· Dynamic Edge Glow: Enjoy a smooth, colorful glow that frames your screen. Customize the color, width, and intensity of the light to perfectly match your style and wallpaper.
· Floating Overlay Effect: The elegant glow effect works on top of your other applications, providing a continuous and immersive visual experience without interfering with normal phone use.
· Incoming Call Alert: The edges of your screen light up with your chosen color when you receive a call, offering a visually striking and modern notification alert.
· Extensive Live Wallpaper Collection: Discover and apply a wide variety of high-quality, animated live wallpapers from our regularly updated library to refresh your home screen and lock screen instantly.
Important Note on Accessibility Service Permission:
To provide the floating edge glow and incoming call detection features, EdgeAura requires the use of the Android Accessibility Service (AccessibilityService API).
We solemnly declare that this permission is used SOLELY for the core visual functionality of our app. It is strictly used to:
· Detect screen content and application windows to correctly draw the glow effect around the edges.
· Identify incoming call events to trigger the screen edge lighting.
Our app does NOT and will NEVER:
· Collect, transmit, or store any of your personal data, text, or passwords.
· Perform any remote audio recording.
· Change any system settings without your explicit consent.
· Prevent you from disabling or uninstalling the app.
· Interact with or manipulate other apps in any deceptive or unauthorized way.
Your privacy and device security are our top priorities. The Accessibility Service is a powerful tool, and we are committed to using it responsibly and transparently only for its intended purpose: to deliver a beautiful and innovative visual experience for you.
Download EdgeAura now and give your phone a brilliant, glowing personality!

ÚJDONSÁGOK:
• Új számlacsomagok: Hello, Plusz, Prémium, Prestige – válaszd
bluejetty:00017980:ios.description:
Digitálisnak születtünk. Válaszd a Gránitot, és intézd napi pénzügyeidet gyorsan, egyszerűen és kényelmesen, teljesen online, a díjnyertes Gránit app segítségével!
ÚJDONSÁGOK:
• Új számlacsomagok: Hello, Plusz, Prémium, Prestige – válaszd ki a hozzád illőt!
• Hello: feltétel nélküli ingyenes számlavezetés és kártya egyszerűen, digitálisan.
• Plusz: okos választás a mindennapi pénzügyekhez akár ingyenes számlavezetéssel és kártyával. 
• Prémium számla: extra szolgáltatások, kiemelkedő, lekötés nélküli kamattal.
• Prestige: exkluzív előnyök, beépített prémium szolgáltatások, kompromisszumok nélkül.
Számlanyitás pár perc alatt:
-Nyiss számlát szelfivel, új típusú személyivel, akár pár perc alatt. Gyors, kényelmes, teljesen digitális megoldás, teljes értékű bankszámlával. 
-Többdevizás megoldások: EUR, USD, CHF, GBP vagy RON számla néhány kattintással
-Akár azonnal használható digitális devizakártya (EUR és USD számlákhoz)
Gyors és kényelmes utalás:
- Utalj forintban és devizában, és tedd még egyszerűbbé az átutalásokat sablonokkal.
- Válts piaci középárfolyamonEUR, USD, CHF, GBP vagy RON devizában, banki munkanapokon 9 és 17 óra között, a havi limitig.
- Használd a díjmentes qvik fizetési funkciót pénzkéréshez! Megbízásaidat vissza is tudod keresni az érvényességi időn belül. 
- Rögzíts másodlagos azonosítót az utalásokhoz, így e-mail címmel vagy telefonszámmal is tudsz pénzt fogadni. 
- Hozz létre rendszeres átutalási megbízásokat egyszerűen az appban.
- Rögzíts csoportos beszedéseket közvetlenül az appban.
Kártya funkciók:
- Használd digitális bankkártyádat online vásárlásra és mobilfizetésre akár már a számlanyitás másnapján.
- Igényelj új forint-, prémium- vagy devizakártyát az appban, és használd akár azonnal, digitálisan. 
- Ellenőrizd kátyád PIN-kódját bármikor az appban. 
- Nézd meg a kártyaadataidat az appban, ha nincs nálad a fizikai kártyád!
- Igényelj néhány kattintással Egyszer használatos kártyát az appban, a még biztonságosabb online vásárlásokhoz.
Megtakarítások, befektetések:
- Indíts betétlekötést, nyiss megtakarítási számlát, vagy állíts be rendszeres megtakarítást néhány kattintással. 
- Nyiss értékpapírszámlát NYESZ-t vagy TBSZ-t, és fektess állampapírokba,, befektetési alapokba vagy vásárolj részvényeket!
- Indíts Perselyt az appban és gyűjts egyszerűen a céljaidra.
További funkciók:
- Qvik fizetési megoldás: lehetővé teszi a QR-kód, deeplink (ún. applikáción belüli link) és NFC alapú azonnali fizetést, valamint a már ismert qvik-kérelmet a kereskedelmi vásárlások és számlabefizetések során.
- Pénzügyek áttekintése: Kövesd valós időben bevételeidet és kiadásaidat, tranzakcióidról pedig ingyenes appértesítést kaphatsz.
- Mobilfizetés: Fizess egyszerűen és kényelmesen, egyetlen érintéssel a Wallet alkalmazás segítségével!
- Biztonság: Állítsd be, zárold vagy oldd fel bankkártyádat bármikor, biztonságos belépéssel PIN-kóddal, ujjlenyomattal vagy Face ID-val.
- Kövesd a bankkártyás költéseiddel járó CO2 kibocsátást az Öko Kalkulátorban, és támogass faültetést közvetlenül az appból.
- Csekkjeidet digitálisan is befizetheted: csak olvasd be a csekket, az app pedig elkészíti az átutalási megbízást. 
A tájékoztatás nem teljes körű, további részletek a www.granitbank.hu/ebank oldalon találhatóak.

bluejetty:00091263:ios.description:
Master Any Subject with Smart Study Tools
Whether you're preparing for an exam, completing homework, or simply trying to expand your knowledge, QuizMate makes learning easier with interactive study tools.
Snap a Pic, Answer Any Question
Struggling with a tough homework problem? With the QuizMate mobile app, just snap a picture of any question, and get the answer instantly—complete with a step-by-step explanation. Whether it’s math, science, history, or literature, QuizMate breaks down the solution in detail so you can truly understand the material, not just memorize answers.
Enhance Your Memory with Flashcards
- Create your own flashcards by uploading your study materials.
- Save decks for offline use and study anywhere, anytime.
Record Your Lectures, Auto-Generate Notes
No more frantic note-taking! With QuizMate, you can record your lectures in real-time, and AI will automatically generate clear, structured notes for you. Focus on listening and understanding while QuizMate does the work, summarizing key points so you can review them later with ease.
Essay Writer – Generate Essays in Seconds
Need to write an essay but don’t know where to start? QuizMate's AI-powered Essay Writer creates high-quality essays in any format with ease. Simply enter your topic, specify the word count, and let QuizMate do the rest. Whether it's a persuasive, argumentative, or research-based essay, you'll receive a well-structured, plagiarism-free paper in seconds. Perfect for saving time and improving your writing skills!
Complete Homework More Efficiently
- Get step-by-step solutions from subject experts to help with challenging questions.
With QuizMate, learning becomes more efficient, interactive, and tailored to your needs!
Any questions or need help? Email us at support@quizmate.io

TikTok: @quizmate.io

bluejetty:00074430:ios.description:
Get ready for Rhythm Ball Game with Color Coordination! Hold and glide your finger to burst the circles while grooving to the beat and keeping up with the catchy rhythm. Sounds like a breeze? Not so fast! And enjoy various genres of music, from beautiful Piano, Guitar songs to Rock and EDM masterpieces.
How to play
- Hold and Drag the ball to burst the circles. 
- Steer clear of different Colors! 
- Don’t let any circles slip by! 
- Keep up with the beat of addictive challenges. 
- Amaze your friends with your impeccable combos.
Game features 
- USER-FRIENDLY Game Control Experiences

Your ball smashes through colorful circles blocking, but if you hit one of a different color, it’s game over! Your ball shatters into pieces and you have to start your descent all over again.
Give it a whirl! Music aficionados will surely be delighted!
Listen to the beat and smash as many circles as you can in this mind-blowing music game now for Free.
If you are a music lover, what are you waiting for? Immerse yourself in the attractive melodies and colors. Surely you will like it!

bluejetty:00092728:ios.name: LCSB Mobile
bluejetty:00092728:ios.summary: LCSB Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by em
bluejetty:00092728:ios.description:
LCSB Mobile is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with LCSB Mobile:
Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
Transfer money between your accounts
Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
View and save your monthly statements
Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the LCSB Mobile app, you must be enrolled as a Lea County State Bank Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00025250:ios.description:
Scopri il più popolare gioco di carte gratis online: Scopa Classica, e si gioca anche offline!!
Scarica gratis il più completo gioco di carte online di Scopa e scegli tra tutte le carte italiane: napoletane, siciliane e piacentine.
Gioca partite rapide oppure a 11 punti. La grafica tradizionale e originale vi lascerà di marmo! Troverete anche diverse modalità di partita: da soli, contro altre persone e con amici.
Gioca e competi nella nostra classifica online!
Cosa troverai nel nostro gioco di carte online:
-Personalizzazione del gioco: scegli tra napoletane, siciliane e piacentine
-Partite in single player, decidi tu a che tipo di partita giocare
-Modalità multiplayer dove potrai sfidare i tuoi amici di Facebook o avversari casuali
-Tre diversi livelli di difficoltà (facile, medio e difficile)
-Statistiche dei tuoi progressi personali nel gioco
-Classifiche giornaliere, settimanali e mensili multiplayer
-Leghe settimanali, competi multiplayer per arrivare alla lega più alta per diventare un campione di Scopa
-Accedi tramite Facebook per utilizzare la tua foto profilo e il tuo nome
-Accedi tramite Facebook per trovare i tuoi amici
Ogni giorno potrai girare la ruota della fortuna e ottenere gratis monete!
Giocando aumenta il tuo progresso e avanza nei tavoli più prestigiosi e guadagna più monete fino ad arrivare al tavolo Leggenda e sbloccare le Leghe, solo per i giocatori più esperti.
Per le tue partite di scopa, potrai scegliere tra tanti mazzi di carte disponibili, dalle Napoletane alle Piacentine e le Siciliane, e tanti altre presto in arrivo!
Scopa ha molte varianti come asso pigliatutto (o asso piglia tutto), napola, re bello, scopone e scopetta.
La modalità multiplayer ti permetterà di giocare contro tantissimi avversari e collegandoti a Facebook potrai far visualizzare il tuo nome e la tua immagine di profilo.
Diventa un asso e scegli il tuo mazzo preferito tra napoletane, siciliane, piacentine.
La variante scopone, che prevede un multiplayer di 4 giocatori, sarà disponibile a breve su nuovi tavoli.
La nostra app è completamente gratis e permette a tutti di giocare gratuitamente in multiplayer, a 11 punti e partecipare alle leghe!
Scopa è il gioco perfetto per gli amanti di giochi di carte tradizionali italiani come Briscola, Scala40, Traversone, Tressette o Burraco
Scarica ora l’applicazione, ti aspettiamo già! BUON DIVERTIMENTO!
Prova gli altri nostri giochi: Briscola e asso pigliatutto.
La nostra privacy policy: https://www.aceofclubs.it/terms_ita/
La nostra email: aceofclubdeluxe@gmail.com

bluejetty:00107888:android.description:
Experience a world of cute animals and exciting puzzles in Tile Match: Animal Adventure! Spend just 10 minutes a day to match adorable animal tiles, clear the board, and boost your memory and focus. Perfect for players who love match 3 games, mahjong, or brain-training puzzles, this game offers endless challenges and relaxation.
Match 3 cute animal tiles to solve puzzles and unlock fun surprises. Each level brings unique challenges with different mechanics to keep your brain sharp and entertained. With new puzzles and rewards every day, you'll always have something fresh to enjoy!
Key Features:

bluejetty:00152930:ios.description:
Screw & Fashion: Makeover Story – Where Fashion, Love, and Screws Collide
Step into Ivy’s world—a young woman caught in the whirlwind of love and growth, standing at the turning point of her life.
One unexpected confession draws her into a story woven with romance and intrigue. To keep moving forward, Ivy must not only create stunning makeovers but also use her wits to solve 3D screw puzzles and unlock every transformation!
Unlike traditional screw-removal games, we’ve replaced screws with stylish, eye-catching earrings, letting you rotate exquisite 3D models, remove earrings, and collect fashion items as well as story clues along the way.
How to Play
 1:Rotate & Explore — Freely spin the 3D model to find earrings that can be removed.
 2:Strategic Unlocking — Use empty slots wisely to release trapped earrings.
 3:Color Matching — Sort earrings by color into boxes to unlock more outfits and cosmetics.
 4:Power Boosts — Use items to solve tricky situations or expand your storage space.
 5:Style Unlocks — Each completed level brings Ivy new clothes, makeup, and accessories.
Game Features
 -Dress-Up Showcase — Use rewards from levels to create Ivy’s signature look, and flaunt it in story scenes and events.
 -Romance & Intrigue — Follow Ivy through a plot filled with love, betrayal, and workplace rivalries.
 -Visual Feast — Detailed 3D earring models combined with high-fashion outfits and polished UI design.
 -Boosts & Rewards — Break through tough levels with powerful tools and collect rare fashion pieces plus story rewards.
 -Scene Styling — Dress Ivy for parties, work, dates, and more to unlock new story branches.
Why You’ll Love It
Whether you’re into romantic storytelling, stylish design, or relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzles, Screw & Fashion has it all. Every level you beat will push Ivy one step further on her journey through the worlds of fashion and life.

bluejetty:00080338:ios.description:
Need to send a fax without visiting a fax store or using a fax machine? 
Smart Fax turns your iPhone into a simple, secure, and reliable mobile fax app for documents, contracts, receipts, forms, IDs, and business paperwork.
Smart Fax is built for contractors, small business owners, freelancers, remote workers, legal professionals, healthcare-related workflows, and anyone who needs to send or receive faxes on the go. Scan documents, upload files, add a cover page, sign paperwork, and send fax documents directly from your phone.
KEY FEATURES
----------------------------
• Send fax from iPhone
 Send fax documents anytime, anywhere without a physical fax machine, landline, or office equipment.
• Receive fax on your phone
 Rent fax numbers in the United States and Canada and receive incoming faxes directly in the app.
• Scan documents into fax-ready files
 Use your camera to scan contracts, receipts, forms, letters, IDs, passports, certificates, licenses, invoices, notes, whiteboards, cards, menus, and more.
• Upload PDF, JPG, and PNG files
 Create faxes from your device, Camera Roll, Google Drive, Dropbox, or other cloud storage locations.
• Add a professional fax cover page
 Create and attach a cover page before sending business, legal, medical, or personal documents.
• Sign documents before faxing
 Add your signature to documents or fax files without printing, scanning again, or using extra software.
• Send fax to many countries
 Fax documents internationally to supported destinations around the world.
• Real-time fax notifications
 Get notified when a fax is sent, received, or updated.
• Email-to-fax support
 Send fax documents from email when you need a flexible workflow across devices.
• Use contacts from your phonebook
 Send faxes directly to recipients saved in your mobile address book.
• Organize your fax history
 Keep sent and received faxes organized, add notes, and manage your fax archive easily.
• Image enhancement tools
 Improve document quality with correction tools before sending your fax.
• HIPAA-compliant faxing
 Designed to support secure faxing workflows for sensitive documents.
Why Use Smart Fax?
----------------------------
Smart Fax helps you replace traditional fax machines, fax stores, landlines, and printing workflows with a fast mobile fax solution. 
Whether you need to fax a signed contract, send business paperwork, submit forms, share medical documents, or receive fax documents while traveling, Smart Fax gives you a complete fax service in your pocket.
No fax machine. 
No office printer. 
No landline. 
Just scan, upload, sign, send, and receive fax documents from your phone.
Subscription
The app contains the following subscription options:
Send Fax Service
 • 1 week — $6.99 USD
 • 1 month — $23.99 USD
 • 12 months — $69.99 USD
Receive Fax Service
 • 1 month — $19.99 USD
 • 12 months — $169.99 USD
Please note that subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal cost will be identified. Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off in Account Settings after purchase.
By using Smart Fax, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use.

bluejetty:00041230:ios.description:
Meet Cardi Health, the cardiovascular health app that helps you manage and better understand your heart health. Cardi Health is developed by Kilo Health, a member of the Innovators' Network of the American Heart Association's Center for Health Technology and Innovation. 
Here are the features that you'll enjoy with Cardi Health:
Heart Health Monitoring & Tracking: Seamlessly track your heart rate and blood pressure using our advanced tracker, providing real-time insights and personalized recommendations for optimal cardio management.
Personalized Meal Plans & Activity Tracking: Access customizable meal plans designed by nutrition experts to complement your heart health goals. Utilize the activity tracker to monitor your fitness routines and ensure you're on the right path to achieving your desired cardio results.
Comprehensive Cardio Insights: Gain valuable insights into your cardio health trends and patterns through comprehensive data analysis and easy-to-understand visualizations. Monitor your progress over time to make informed decisions and maintain a healthy heart.
Freeform Exercise Tracking: Use the app's freeform exercise tracking feature to log your workouts and physical activities, ensuring you're staying on top of your cardio goals and maintaining an active lifestyle.
Integrated Blood Pressure Monitor: Utilize the integrated blood pressure monitor to keep an accurate record of your hypertension management, ensuring that you're always aware of your current cardiovascular status.
Expert Guidance & Cardio Support: Connect with certified nutritionists and cardio specialists for personalized guidance and support. Access articles and resources that provide insights into managing cardiovascular health and achieving optimal blood pressure levels.
Community & Cardio Challenges: Join our active community to share your cardio journey, participate in challenges, and stay motivated. Engage in discussions centered around heart health and share tips and strategies to achieve collective cardio success. 
Cardi Health is not a substitute for the medical management of cardiovascular disease, nor is this app intended to cure, treat, or diagnose any medical condition. Developed by cardiologists and designed to help anyone manage and track cardiovascular disease, the Cardi Health app features are created according to the guidelines of the American College of Cardiology and the American Heart Association.
Terms and Conditions: https://cardi.health/terms-of-services
Privacy Policy: https://cardi.health/privacy-policy

Step into Kokoa AI, an innovative chat platform where intelligent AI companions truly listen, understand, and engage like real people. Whether you’re seeking encouragement, companionship, or just someone to share your thoughts with, every conversation feels genuine and meaningful.
What Makes Kokoa AI Unique
Explore Distinct Personalities
 Chat with a wide range of AI characters—each with their own backstories, moods, and styles. From playful banter to thoughtful reflection, Kokoa AI matches your tone and emotions effortlessly.
Have Real, Meaningful Conversations
 Talk about what matters to you—your passions, goals, and everyday moments. Kokoa AI keeps each chat relevant, lively, and centered around your interests.

Supportive Companions for Your Goals
 Stay motivated and on track—your AI friends can cheer you on, help you stay organized, and guide you toward your personal goals.
Your Privacy, Protected
 All conversations are secure and confidential, so you can express yourself freely and confidently.
Why Choose Kokoa AI?
Conversations that evolve with you and reflect your mood.
Safe, inspiring, and enjoyable chats anytime, anywhere.
Intelligent, empathetic AI companions who truly understand you.

You’ve memorized origins and insertions, survived practical labs, and can finally pronounce “ischiogluteal bursitis” without choking. Now all that’s standing between you and your PT or PTA license is the NPTE. Don’t worry. We’ve got your back... and your posterior chain.
EZ Prep’s NPTE Study App is the fastest, smartest, and least soul-crushing way to prep for the National Physical Therapy Exam. Whether you’re studying offline, stuck at work, or trying to decompress on the couch without developing forward head posture, this app helps you prep with zero nonsense and zero fluff.
Built by licensed physical therapists and designed to match the latest 2024 NPTE exam content, the app adapts to your performance in real time. The better you do, the harder it gets. The worse you do, the more it helps. That’s how learning should work.
We’ve got both exams in one app. Whether you’re going for your DPT or knocking out the PTA, everything’s covered. Real questions. Real explanations. Real results.
Try it free. No sketchy billing tricks. No motivational messages in Comic Sans. Just smart tools that work. When you're ready, upgrade for full access to Bookmarks, Missed Questions, and a full-length Exam Simulator.
Here’s what’s inside:
• Cardio and Pulmonary
• Musculoskeletal
• Neuromuscular and Nervous System
• Integumentary System
• Metabolic and Endocrine
• Gastrointestinal
• Genitourinary
• Lymphatic System
• System Interactions
• Equipment and Devices
• Therapeutic Modalities
• Safety and Protection
• Professional Responsibilities
• Research Practices
How we make studying suck less:
• Custom onboarding to set your goals, difficulty level, and daily benchmarks
• Study streaks and achievement rewards to keep you going when caffeine wears off
• Instant feedback that explains answers so you don’t have to Google everything
• Timed exam simulator to sharpen your pacing and tolerance for pressure
• Performance tracking that tells you what’s working and what still needs work
We’re so confident in our material that we offer a pass guarantee. Don’t pass? You get your money back and we keep your subscription active until you do. No stress, no fine print games.
EZ Prep is built for real future PTs and PTAs who don’t have time to waste on generic apps and outdated PDFs.
Terms of Use: https://www.eztestprep.com/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://www.eztestprep.com/privacy-policy
Contact us at: support@eztestprep.com
EZ Prep is not affiliated with the FSBPT, APTA, or any licensing body. We just help you crush the NPTE and get back to doing what you’re actually good at, fixing everyone else’s biomechanics. For official exam info, visit www.apta.org/your-practice/licensure/national-physical-therapy-examination

OurFamilyWizard is the #1 co-parenting app trusted by courts and family law professionals across all 50 states in the US, as well as Canada, UK, Australia, and New Zealand. The app has been featured in the New York Times, Parents.com, Verywell Family, NPR, WIRED, the Today Show, and more. 
OurFamilyWizard makes co-parenting easier. We designed these tools to help you reduce conflict, so your kids can thrive after a separation or a divorce. With our powerful and customizable tools, you can free up time, emotional energy, and mental space. 
With all your digital co-parenting interactions rolled up in one secure app, you can keep everything organized and documented. Plus, you can shield your kids from adult conversations they don’t need to see. 
NEW: STAY CONNECTED THROUGH CALLS 
• Stay close when you’re apart 
When you miss your child or they miss you, give them an audio or video call. 
• Connect virtually 
Calls offer an easy solution for virtual visitation, midweek visits, or long-distance co-parenting. 
• Automatic documentation 
With Calls, the details are documented: all dates, times, and in-call activity. All in the same place as your other co-parenting communications. 
SIMPLIFY COMMUNICATION 
• Use just one app 
No more searching for messages or attachments across DMs, phone calls, texts, and emails. Just use one secure app. 
• Track the truth 
Once you send a message, it’s permanent. First-viewed timestamps mean no more arguing about who said what, when, or whether it was seen. 
• Communicate calmly

COORDINATE YOUR CALENDAR 
• Create a parenting time schedule (or custody schedule)

• Encourage reliability 
When everyone shares the same Calendar, mix-ups are a thing of the past. 
• Schedule Change Requests 
Need to make a one-time change to the schedule? Adjust the Calendar with an easy form. 
STREAMLINE YOUR EXPENSES 
• Simplify the math 
Keep clear, secure records of your co-parenting expenses and receipts. 
• Customize categories 
Create new categories, with your own percentage splits. 
• Centralize everything 
With OFWpay, you can reimburse your co-parent in the app—and you can even make scheduled payments for child support. (Or record payments via another method.) 
KEEP A MEANINGFUL JOURNAL 
• Log when you arrive

• Capture memories 
Record parenting observations and special, close moments with photos and text. 
SHARE INFO ABOUT YOUR KIDS 
• Store essential details

• Minimize messaging

DOCUMENTATION AND REPORTS

GRANT YOUR PROS ACCESS

Lawyers

apple-itunes:1454739075.name: Utility OX
apple-itunes:1454739075.description:
Utility construction is tough work. Utility OX makes it run smoother, faster, and more profitable by putting every job detail, schedule, and resource in one place—accessible anytime, anywhere. Utility OX is purpose-built for utility and HDD underground contractors who are done wasting time with whiteboards, spreadsheets, and scattered apps.
No fluff. No feature clutter. Just the right tools your crews will actually use to keep jobs moving, downtime crushed, and profits protected.
Key Features:
Job & Project Management
- Manage every job from kickoff to close-out.
- View jobs on a map, calendar, or list with color-coded status indicators.
- Store all job details, drawings, permits, and documents in one place.
Task & Production Tracking
- Import project drawings as Task Sheets and draw tasks directly on them.
- Assign equipment, materials, and crews to each task.
- Crews log time, progress, and photos right from the field.
- Color-coded statuses show managers what’s done, in progress, or overdue.
- Completed tasks can automatically be added to Red Line drawings. Foremen can also add red lines manually for changes in the field.
Locate Ticket Management
- Organize all locate tickets in one dashboard with map or list view.
- Draw ticket areas on the map and track them with color-coded alerts.
- Attach approvals, white line photos, and clearance updates for compliance.
Bore Logging (HDD)
- Record pilot bores in real time with depth, pitch, and rod count.
- Export bore reports as PDF or Excel profiles for clients or inspectors.
Equipment, Tooling & Materials
- Complete fleet and tooling database with specs, photos, and availability.
- Search by capability (e.g., “reamer for clay”) to cut downtime.
- Schedule equipment, tooling, and materials to jobs or crews.
- NEW: Materials tab with unit costs, pricing, and allocation to jobs.
Crews & Crewmembers
- Keep crew rosters, skills, and certifications organized.
- View crew availability, job history, and productivity at a glance.
Time Clock (NEW)
- Let employees clock in/out and record breaks right from the app.
- Time can be tied to specific jobs or tasks for accurate costing.
- All time data flows into the Daily Production Report and can be exported for payroll and job costing.
Job Walk-Throughs
- Capture pre-job or progress walkthroughs with photos and notes.
- Use voice-to-text to quickly dictate notes in the field.
Production, Revenue & Job Cost Capture
- Track revenue, labor, equipment, and material costs per job.
- Compare bid vs. actual in real time.
- Visual dashboards show profit margins, progress, and cost codes.
- Export job financials to CSV/Excel for billing, payroll, or accounting.
Photo & Document Management
- Capture progress photos, bore logs, and completed work.
- Store permits, safety forms, and client documents alongside job data.
Soil & Dump Site Mapping
- Drop pins to record ground conditions and dump sites.
- Add details like soil type, disposal costs, or accepted materials.
- Entries are shared across all Utility OX users, so if you’re working in a new area you can see soil and dump site data others have logged.
Reporting & Insights
- Export production, cost, and revenue reports with a tap.
- Use data to refine bids, forecast resources, and improve margins.
HDD Calculators
- Built-in calculators for HDD planning and drilling parameters.
Why Contractors Choose Utility OX
- Made for utility contractors – not a generic construction app.
- Crew-first design – simple enough for the field, powerful enough for management.
- Single source of truth – keep jobs, people, and equipment in sync.
